name: Return To Self Genesis
description: Simply put, the ability to return to normal any damage that you create. This ability applies to only your damage, however. You can choose which things to return and which things not to return.
summary: The ability to repair and heal any damage you cause
strengths: Helps out if a lot of collateral damage has been caused by you.
You can choose to heal your surroundings and not your enemy.
You can return the dead back to completely normal and healed. Said people will have no memory of what happened around their death..
weaknesses: Can't heal damage caused by others.
Can be incredibly taxing.

name: Useless Invisibility
description:
User of this unfortunate ability can turn invisible when nobody is watching.
You can stay invisible as long as you want, but if you come to other person's field of view, you'll turn visible.
summary: The ability to be invisible when no one is watching you.
strengths: At least you have superpower.
You'll turn back to visible state only if one who sees you is same species (you'll stay invisible if only animals are "watching" you).
weaknesses: If you are in someone's field of view while invisible, you'll turn visible.

name: Superpower Manifestation
description: This ability allows the user to make any physical power and manifest it into a physical form. These manifestations do not take the form of living creatures more like objects or supernatural forces, unless it was an animal transformation ability. This means the user doesn't possess these powers. Example, The user created heat vision. This ability makes it physical manifestation of heat vision like two red dots. The user can fire those dots as twin fiery beams of death.
summary: The ability to create superhuman abilities in a externalized form.
strengths: Manifest any physical ability
Control those powers
weaknesses: Some manifestation can be unpredictable.

name: Rapid Cell Regeneration
description: This ability doesn't just speed up healing, it allows you to pretty much never get sick at all, Slows down aging to the point that you pretty much live forever theoretically.
summary: The ability to heal from any wound instantaneously.
strengths: Heal Instantaneously.
Never sick
Slowed or stopped aging when the power is active.
weaknesses: You are everlasting thus everyone you know and love will pass, you won't.
You will have to bear the weight of forever for you may possibly live forever.
You might feel misunderstood by those around you because of this ability.

name: Reality Coder
description: This ability allows the user to bring up a virtual keyboard and augmented reality display overlaying their vision. An empty prompt appears before them. They can summon objects and change the properties of things by typing code into the prompt. For example, "import Glock_17" would cause a Glock 17 pistol to appear. Anything can be done, but many functions and objects must be programmed before being used, otherwise the system doesn't know what you're trying to do. Comes with a virtual help file.
summary: The ability to manipulate reality with a programming language
strengths: Can summon virtually anything, and change the properties of objects
Can create programs for any situation and execute them at will
Cannot be seen using it (aside from the user typing at an invisble keyboard)
weaknesses: Must create programs and define functions and objects
Have to memorize everything you've defined or be constantly refering to the help file
Must learn how to write code

name: Shifting Elements
description: A advanced combination of telekinesis and alchemy. Through simple hand movements, you can lift something up, change their shape, size, properties and state of matter.
summary: The ability to change and control all know elements through hand controls
strengths: Makes you very dangerous and powerful.
Because you can control yourself, you can enhance and rebuild yourself.
It enables flight and other powers derived of the main powers.
weaknesses: If you don't understand physics/chemistry, you can't do that much.
The kryptonite of this power is fermium.

name: Ultimate Shapeshifting
description: You can shapeshift into any living, non-living (except corpses and such), or inanimate object you want, even something of different sex! If the thing you turn into has memories (such as elephants, humans, dolphins, or computers), you gain those memories in that form, but only while in that form. Also, when in a form that retains memories, the memories of that person or object (computer, etc. ) update psychically.
summary: The ability to become anything.
strengths: Shapeshift into any living, non-living, or inanimate object you want.
Impersonate anyone you want :P You are indetectable and untrackable.
Disguise yourself as anything from a speck of dirt (not recommended) to a tree to hide from anyone!
weaknesses: Heavy mental stress from memories and such can lead to mental problems. (In 30% of people)
Changing into inanimate objects can lead to temporary side effects, such as half-shifting.

name: Omni Solid Manipulation
description: You have complete control over all solids. It doesn't matter what kind of material it is, as long as it's solid, you can control it. Earth, trees, metal, objects, you name it. You can destroy something and put it back together, stop the momentum/velocity of something. You can even control humans' bodies/motor functions with this power. You could cause a lot of destruction with this power or use it for good, and enforce world peace.
summary: The ability to manipulate anything that is a solid or is solid matter.
strengths: Cause massive destruction and devestation by causing the very terrain to burst asunder.
Control ANY solid matter, no matter how small or large.
Form armor weapons even MINIONS out of solid matter.
weaknesses: You might be worshipped as a god.
If no amount of solid matter is nearby.
You only control solids with this power, nothing else.

name: Shape Shifting
description: With this ability, you can morph yourself into any shape or size.  You can take on the appearance of other people, change into the shape of inanimate objects, and recollect yourself instantly (i.e. if you're glass and you shatter).  Just in case, you will always know how to "reset" into your original form (the way your body looks right now).  You can't increase your mass, but you CAN decrease your mass by leaving some behind.
summary: The ability to morph yourself into any shape or size.
strengths: Make yourself ridiculously good-looking
Spying on people
Morphing into someone else
weaknesses: You'll probably want to keep your ability a secret

name: Regeneration
description: At will, you can rewrite your DNA to take on a completely random, but human appearance. Your height, figure, skin and hair colour can all change. You gain a slightly different personality but keep your memories, due to nature vs. nurture. You automatically use this power when mortally wounded, though, if you die too quickly, you cannot regenerate. If you are about to die of old age, you regenerate into a different form. The new form taken is usually younger, and is always of the same gender.
summary: The ability to reincarnate and heal
strengths: Very difficult to be killed
Can change your appearance as much as you want
Can live forever if you want, unless you suppress your power
weaknesses: Have to watch everyone else die
People will have trouble getting used to your new face
You may prefer a previous appearance, which you can't get back

name: Healing Touch
description: With this ability, you can heal anyone who's afflicted with some sort of illness or wound.  They'll be brought back to 100% health--all you need to do is touch them and they'll instantly be healed.  And of course, you can heal yourself.  No bringing back the dead, though.  Think about it, you might be worried that sexy girl at the bar has something you don't want to catch, but all you've gotta do is give her the healing touch and you're in business!
summary: The ability to completely heal anyone afflicted with any disease or injury.
strengths: Surprise visits to hospitals
You, your family and your friends will always be healthy
Get paid the big bucks to heal people
weaknesses: Everyone who's sick will want you to heal them

name: Shape Shifter Reality
description: You can turn into person you wish and reality will change around you. Your records will change and you will be a new person. Records will appear for your new form for what you may need or want. It means you have your own place and things your new form would own. People would get memories or would be changed to match your new form. Even your history would be new, but old to everyone else. You can be any age or gender or race.
summary: The ability to shape shift your form and make the world believe that is who you are.
strengths: Start a new life you will want.
Be able to live any type of life you wish
Know what it is like to be a new person
weaknesses: Everyone will forget your true form

name: Bio Modification
description: You become whatever you want to be, by changing your actual DNA, not just shape-shifting, any ability you want  can be coded into your DNA. IF you can imagine it, you can have it. Only rule you have to remember, is knowing what you have done before. Because you change your DNA, any and all mods will be transferred to your offspring.
summary: The ability to manipulate your dna to change yourself in any way you desire
strengths: Any superpower is yours when you want it.
Invulnerability to practically anything can be coded in
Can rule everything and everyone
weaknesses: Might create a monstrous image if care isn't taken in
DNA might end up messed up so you will need an undo function
Have to remember what abilities you added

name: Regenerative Hydrokinesis
description: Regenerative hydrokinesis is one of the strongest known healing powers in nature. With it, a person can fully heal any wounds, ailments, or diseases they may have, as well as others they choose.
summary: The ability to control water to become a healing agent
strengths: One of the strongest forms of healing known to exist
Any injury or disease can be fully healed, and severed or malformed limbs fully regenerated in hours
Works as long as you are near, or immersed, in water
weaknesses: Healing is the only thing you can do with this ability
This ability cannot work with impure water

name: Satori
description: This power is used by coming into contact or sending energy waves (radius of 10 Miles). It can heal physical wounds from the slightest scratch, to mutated or severed limbs, cancer, and cure 'in-curable' diseases. It also heals emotional wounds, and can grant ineffable and utter joy and happiness to yourself and others. It can change malign intents into benign intents. It also heals people from their anger, frustration, and any other negative emotions.
summary: The ability to heal wounds, memories, emotions, and give ineffable happiness to yourself and others.
strengths: Extremely Beneficial.
Make this world a better place.
Can cure any negative emotion or physical state.
weaknesses: If your intention is to harm, this power is completely useless.
Hard to focus on other things when power is in use.
The farther away someone is, the less control you have.

name: Lifeforce Mimicry
description: Lifeforce is the force existent in living beings that allows them to live. This power lets you turn into this force to manipulate it. You can bring life to inanimate things, heal, and much more. You can also resist death powers because of your abundant life force. If you wanted to, you could take the life from someone or infuse them with life to make them more powerful. In this form you regenerate from damage and can heal from previous injuries. You can also increase your lifespan.
summary: The ability to transform into and generate lifeforce.
strengths: Heal and regenerate.
Unaffected by death powers or ones that manipulate your lifeforce.
Take life.
weaknesses: Long lifespan does not mean immortality or invunerability.
A standoff with death or a reaper.
Cons cannot be negated.

name: Umbrakinesis
description: The ability to shape shadows into a 3 dimensional form.  The shadow can only stretch so far.  Shadows can connect to other shadows.  You can only manipulate shadows within a certain range, about 10 feet without connecting to another shadow, but the shadows can stretch farther than that range.  The more light there is, the weaker the shadow is.
summary: The ability to manipulate shadows.
strengths: Can suprise and kill an enemy before they even knew what was going on.
Can cut through steel with shadows
weaknesses: Weakened shadows in the sun
Limited range

name: Full Heal
description: Like the description says, heal any wound at the blink of an eye.
summary: The ability to heal any wound at the blink of an eye.
strengths: Heal wounds.
weaknesses: Nothing.

name: Metamorph
description: A metamorph is anyone who can manipulate their own molecular structure. This lets you become anyone or anything as long as they have the same amount of mass. So they couldn't become something much larger than themselves but, by condensing their atoms, they could become smaller. Some metamorphs become immortal by morphing into a younger version of themselves. A word of caution is necessary here. The more they morph they harder it becomes to return to their true form.
summary: The ability to alter your own molecular structure at will
strengths: You can become anyone or anything as long as they have they same amount of mass.
Immortality
Other powers could be gained (turning into a winged demon capable of flight)
weaknesses: The more you morph the harder it is to return to your true form.
When you condense yourself, you are just as heavy. This could give away a diguise (a 140lb vase)
Can only morph yourself not others

name: Tactile Georegeneration
description: With this ability, a person can absorb the energy from the Earth through physical contact, turning it into a powerful form of healing. Everything, from the most minor of injuries to the deadliest of diseases, can be healed, or severed/malformed limbs totally regenerated, in a matter of minutes!! Advanced users of this power can even go as far as slowing down, stopping, or reversing every effect of aging, both internally and externally. You can, however, stop this power to let enemies suffer.
summary: The ability to use the Earth's energy to fully heal yourself or others
strengths: You can be the world's greatest doctor!
This power always strengthens itself, even when not in use, as long as you are in contact with earth
No more aches & pains!!
weaknesses: You need to have physical contact with natural ground for the power to work
You could accidentally heal an enemy if you aren't careful
This power starts off weak, only healing minor injuries at first

name: Stop Time
description: You have the ability to stop time. What is meant by this is that any living thing will be frozen in time, excluding plant life, while you still move at normal time. There is a restriction, you cannot move any living thing except for plant life.
summary: The ability to stop the progress of time
strengths: Avert human and machine disasters
Make bank withdrawls and then go about your business
Do some fun time up-skirting
weaknesses: Living things are frozen, so non living things are still in motion

name: Beast Humanoid Shapeshifting
description: This ability allows you to become any existing animal, in a half-human form. This allows you to shift into forms such as half-tiger, half-lion, half-wolf, half-bull, etc. Makes for some interesting combinations.
summary: The ability to shapeshift to become any animal-human crossbreed.
strengths: You sustain the intellect of man while having the strength, cunning and agility of your animal.
weaknesses: You take on the mentality of the beast more and more the longer you stay in this form.

name: Vitakinesis
description: A person with Vitakinesis can heal themselves when they have pains and cuts. You can also heal others that need it. Or heal plants. And for your information, this is actually a REAL ability. Anyone can use. But don't do it when emotional! ;)
summary: The ability to heal oneself, other people and plants
strengths: Heal yourself when hurt
Don't have to go to the doctor's! :D
Real fun!
weaknesses: Can't use it when emotional!
Don't use it the opposite way (relates to #1)
Same thing as #1, because there are not a lot of cons for this ability

name: Talent Of Healing
description: By simply laying your hands on something, that animal, plants, fungi, or other entity will heal. You also gain a natural knowlege of medicine and can heal a persons auras and other energies. A bonus of this is that you can reverse the aging process and can unlock a persons potential or unlock their abilities.
summary: The ability to have a natural ability to heal people and other things
strengths: Description can't be shortened and pros can't be negated.
Knowledge of medicine
Reverse aging and unlocking potential
weaknesses: None

name: Weapon Evolution
description: Just think of it, you could even pick up a Knife/Dagger and morph it into a Sword/Saber, a Claw Hammer into a Warhammer, a Tomahawk into an Axe, and any small weapon you can think of transform and supersizing it into your very own weapon on your own brutal and fatal arsenal.
summary: The ability to transform and supersize any small weapon into your weapon for combat.
strengths: Lots of different weapons
weaknesses: Evolution has to resemble the original weapon, no forming a big gun out of a toothpick

name: Shape Metamorphosis
description: You can shapeshift into any living or non-living solid matter. However if you change into another person with a different power you won't be able to possess their specific power. Shapeshifting into any animal or mytholgical creature of any size. So you can change from a gigantic dinosaur into a microscopic bacteria. Cool!!
summary: The ability to change yourself into a different shape, person.
strengths: You can be anything and/or anyone you want to be.
You can change into a microscopic bacteria so no-one can see you.
weaknesses: Changing into another person doesn't make your voice sound like their's.
You can't change minor specifics. It's either everything or nothing.

name: New Shift
description:
From particle to stellar red giant, shift into anything in the universe. Split into endless copies of yourself. You could be your own armour, sword, gun. You could shift into becoming a star, replace our sun. Note: Making copies of yourself compromises your density & takes awhile to replenish. Transforming into something as massive as the sun or a blackhole would take hours to develop necessary energy to mimic a true one. You no longer require oxegen. 
You could shift into a whole new universe.
summary: The ability to shape-shift & replicate into absolutely anything in the universe.
strengths: You are the ultimate shape-shifter capable of shifting into any fluid, solid or energy
Mitotically create COPIES of yourself; you could carry weapon that are part of YOU
At rest your body is of amorphous consistency rendering you immune to sharp & blunt trauma
weaknesses: Susceptible to absolute zero temperatures & you have no superhuman form of energy projection
Unless you touch the duplicates of yourself they are stuck in whatever form they've shifted into
When shifted immune to the fluid, solid or energy a duplicate has become not the true element

name: Change Manipulation
description: This ability allows the user to controls the an aspect of change. This involves shapeshifting, evolution, matter transmutation,invisibility etc. The user has absolute power over them. The user can't control the things that he changes except himself. He can also reverse the changes and make any changes positive or negative. he can make things consistent or inconsistent. This power is the master control of all changing powers. The user can even stop change as well.
summary: The ability to control all aspects of physical change.
strengths: Change anything
Neutralize all changelings' powers
weaknesses: Can't control things that change.
Unlike reality warping, the user can't change stuff from a planet to universal scale without...
... killing himself. It takes years of training.

name: Perspective Manipulation
description: Anything you see, no matter how near or far, you may pick up and place it anywhere else in view. To you, it will always be the size it looks when you viewed it from where you are standing, but in reality the further away you place it, the bigger it will become. Move closer to it to see its true size. Want to make a pencil massive? Pick it up and place it in the distance. Want to shrink a tree? Pick it up and move it closer to you.
summary: The ability to manipulate the perspective of objects
strengths: Can grow or shrink anything in view.
Can pick up anything from a distance.
weaknesses: Only works on things in view.
May be hard to restore something to its original size.

name: Pick A Power
description: You simply think of a power and it's yours. But you can change it into any other power you want. And you can only have one at a time. There is no power you can't have. From shape-shifting to acid snot, super hearing to super speed, it's yours. You can even have fun making some up!
summary: The ability to change the power you have.
strengths: You can have any power you want.
You can have any power you want.
You can... oh forget it.
weaknesses: Nothing, and even if you can think of something bad, there is a power to fix it!

name: Nature Wrath
description: You may be able to fly because you can make the winds maintain your weight (just like Storm). You can wrap enimies with vines plus you can wrap trees around yourself to make yourself a monster!
summary: The ability to control all natural things like plants, winds, and etc.
strengths: Animals love you!
You can fly!
You can give your enimies poison ivy!
weaknesses: Your weakness is fire and acid rain so you can't fight weather manipulators.
You are green when power in progress.
You have to practice to level up.

name: Photographic Power Mimicry
description: Once you see a power being used, you mimic that power even if you don't know that it is an actual power. After this, you will completely understand the power that you wield. You can hold limitless powers.
summary: The ability to mimic powers when you see them in action.
strengths: You can mimic powers that you see in action. (Even powers you can't actually see like telepathy)
Gain limitless abilities.
Have complete control over the power.
weaknesses: You have to SEE it in action. (Your vision has to be CLEAR)
You gain the abilities weaknesses if they're vital to the ability being used.
Complete control doesn't effect some abilities. (Intuitive Aptitude, etc. )

name: Healing  Mist
description: The mist will slowly heal all wounds, ailments, diseases, curses, etc of everyone inside the mist.
summary: The ability to produce a mist that heals all those within it
strengths: Heal everyone with a ravaging killer disease, it can't gain immunity to this power.
Bad cut from a rusty knife? No matter! Just produce this mist and everything will be fine.
The holder of this power is essentially immune to all diseases.
weaknesses: It's a slow, slow, slow heal.
The people who want to take advantage of someone with this power for their own gain.

name: Elemental Forces
description: With this power, you can summon, control, heal and dismiss the Elemental Forces at will, all of which are in your complete and utter control. They are all extremely powerful forces of good. The Elemental Forces happen to look like extremely cool, awesome, unique, and original versions the Summons from the various Final Fantasies. They include Odin, Alexander, Belias, Shiva, Bahamut, Hashmal, Fenrir, Ixion, Famfrit, Phoenix, Typhon, Ultima, and Ragnarok.
summary: The ability to summon the Elemental Forces.
strengths: All Elemental Forces have a wide variety of special powers, abilities, skills, and talents.
All Elemental Forces have the Ultimate Attacks that they have in the Final Fantasies.
All Elemental Forces have extremely awesome summoning sequences.
weaknesses: Can only summon one Elemental Force at a time, though they can be instantly swapped out.
Can cause a lot of destruction if not careful.

name: Transdimensional Architect
description: As soon you enter a building you can make any existing room or corridor bigger. You can add new rooms,corridors,staircases,stairways and floors. You can grow or shrink new rooms and corridors. You can give stairways and staircases as many steps as you want. You can rearrange any thing you added. You can't kill or trap anyone. Try and crush someone, he will reappear outside the building. When you leave the building,it reverts back to normal. Anyone who had been in a lost area will be outside.
summary: The ability to temporarily change the inside of any building without making the outside bigger.
strengths: Make that economy hotel room bigger than a palace.
Lose anyone chasing you by making a broom closet near infinite in size.
Put a 5 mile long corridor between yourself and a foe.
weaknesses: The wilderness.
People might start saying "Here comes Captain Building! "

name: Complete Blood Control
description: With this power, the subject can absorb and metabolize blood like a leech through physical contact. Transfusions are also possible. You will be immune to all other blood-based powers such as acid blood, explosive blood, vampirism, etc. You are able to control people like puppets with blood or just plain blow them up from the inside out. You may use your blood as a weapon by shooting it from a cut at high, concussive pressure.
summary: The ability to have complete control of blood
strengths: You will never be HIV positive.
Any destructive blood or blood-based power doesn't affect you.
You have a powerful, biological weapon.
weaknesses: Blood doesn't nourish you.
A regular hemokinetic has more control of blood.
You can still die from blood loss, non-blood based damage/illnesses/toxins, etc.

name: Seeding
description: This power allows the user to grow anything. To use this power you must first acquire a piece of the thing you wish to grow, such as a chip off of a building, a spark plug, or a hair or fingernail clipping. Plant this object in the ground and treat it as you would a seedling. In a matter of weeks (or longer, depending on what you are trying to grow) you will have a fully formed replica of the thing you acquired the "seed" from. Living creatures grown this way will have no memories.
summary: The ability to grow something from anything.
strengths: Grow yourself a car, spacecraft, computer, or a whole building.
Bring extinct creatures and dead people back to life.
weaknesses: Living beings grown this way will have no memories and behave on instinct
Grown humans will have to be taught.
You must care for what you are growing as if it is a plant.

name: Unblockable
description: A person with this power has his path always clear. Unlike unstoppability he cannot ram into objects. Instead the objects such as obstacles will be compelled to move out of your path or open so that you can enter. Even people cannot block your path unless they can resist this power. This power can be perfectly non-lethal in usage. However this only applies to things that can move out of your way or open for you. Unlike Path Maker,Things like walls and trees that are rooted will not move for you.
summary: The ability to never have the path of the road in front of you be impeded
strengths: Locks, drawbridges, and steel doors open before your presence and allow your passage
Cars cannot block your path---ie can't be hit in an accident--the cars will slide to the side
Football---no one can tackle you (from the front)
weaknesses: Cannot be used to attack people since they become compelled to move away from your path
Conventionally immovable objects such as walls or trees

name: Cell Control
description: This is one of the most gruesome and bloody abilities. It allows the user to control their own cells like a metamorph can control their atoms. This allows you to make many genetic weapons. For example, you could change your arm into a fleshy spike tipped with a jagged head of bone. Or you could take your hand and turn it into a whip. You can even change your cells' form from animal to plant. So you could use photosynthesis and other plant-related powers. You can even increase cell generation.
summary: The ability to control your own cells.
strengths: You can make tons of cell weapons (Bone spike shooter)
You can even change your cells' form and increase cell generation.
weaknesses: It's a gruesome and bloody ability.

name: Xenoglossy
description: This literally translates to "foreign tongue". You can understand and speak any human language, like Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, French or Cambodian. Any one of the over 1000 different languages found around the world. You cannot communicate with animals, plants, aliens, etc.
summary: The ability to understand and speak any human language.
strengths: Speak any human language.
Understand any human language.
weaknesses: You can't speak to animals or plants.
You can't speak to aliens either.

name: Nature Zone
description: Creates a zone that promotes the growth of nature. Plants and animals inside the zone will grow faster and healthier. If the area has been cleared of natural wildlife and vegetation, then both will be attracted to return to the area. While the zone is active technological creations will be less effective and man made objects will begin to degrade. Specific plants can even be manipulated to grow faster normal and in a specific way. Animals will also act friendlier to humans.
summary: The ability to create a zone that promotes the growth of nature.
strengths: Cause animals and plants to return to an area.
Manipulate plants to grow faster and in a specific way.
Animals will act friendlier to humans.
weaknesses: Technological creations and man made objects begin to fail.
Others can manipulate plants against you.
Animals can still be dangerous even though they will normally act friendly.

name: Goal Achievement
description: This power allows the user to know every detail of every one of their own goals, as well as every detail of how to achieve specific goals. Example: a shapeshifters goal is to "upgrade" their appearance without making any huge changes, but still satisfying their needs. With this power, the shapeshifter would know exactly how to achieve this specific goal. Combining this power with other powers is an advantage, although this power still works on users without any other powers.
summary: The ability to know exactly how to achieve your goals
strengths: Know every detail of every one of their own goals
Know every detail of how to achieve specific goals
Combining this power with other powers is an advantage
weaknesses: Users without any other powers are more limited as to what goals can be achieved

name: Future Sight
description: Every time you imagine yourself performing a certain action, you see its outcome. The vision is experienced through the POV of your future self with all of your 5 senses. You don't suffer from the physical pain experienced in the vision nor any other negative effects other than the reaction to the content of the future can harm you. You can analyze multiple scenarios simultaneously and branch them from each other. While being in a vision state you are fully aware of your surroundings.
summary: The ability to see the result of any action performed by oneself in the close future
strengths: Get an answer to the every "What if..?" question that has been bugging you
You now live your life like a video game ("Oops, I died. Oh well, I'll try again")
Seeing in the darkness, light-speed reflex...- find new uses by stretching your imagination a little
weaknesses: You may want to try out some scenarios that you wouldn't even consider doing in the real life.
If you know everybody's reaction, people will feel unrealistic to you.
If the unescapable death will come close, you'll know it.

name: Viral Regeneration
description: The Viral Regeneration power allows for rapid repair of injuries. It works by absorbing microbes in the immediate vicinity. They are then reprogrammed by the immune system to repair cellular damage or bodily injuries.
summary: The ability to heal small injuries by reprogramming bacteria to repair them.
strengths: Almost invicible, as any damage will be repaired quickly.
Prevents you from getting sick.
weaknesses: Germ-killing substances can counteract this power.
Can't repair fatal injuries.

name: Resurrection
description: Able to come back to life fully healed after you have died
summary: The ability to come back to life after you die
strengths: Can do whatever you want without fear of death
Live forever
weaknesses: Have to see loved ones die

name: Copy Cat
description: Copy cat is exactly as it is titled. You can copy any power that you see, or hear about within a matter of seconds. However, you can only copy cat 25 powers before it disappears, and you are unable to copy any more powers, so you have to be careful about which powers you want to copy.
summary: The ability to copy any power you hear, or see.
strengths: Can have multiple powers
Can choose which powers you want to copy
weaknesses: It takes you longer than most to master each power
You must HEAR or SEE this power in use
With each power you take in, this power itself gets weaker

name: Mitosis Manipulation
description: This power(also called Mitokinesis) gives the user total control over mitosis(the division and replication of cells). The user can speed up, slow down, concentrate, make efficient, halt, and even REVERSE mitosis in themselves or others. This allows the user to rapidly regenerate as well as harm others by undoing their mitosis or stop people who shapeshift by mitosis. You can even make mitosis more efficient to heal wounds in seconds or slow the aging process down.
summary: The ability to control the process by which cells divide and replicate.
strengths: Heal AND slow the aging process in yourself and others.
Easily wound a foe by reversing the multiplication of their cells to create whole new wounds.
Concentrate mitosis in one place for quick healing or repair.
weaknesses: If your foe has a biological manipulation power.
Most shapeshifters dont rely on mitosis.
In the beginning only basic manipulaation can be done.

name: Shadowy Retreat
description: With this ability, when engulfed in darkness, you have the ability to vanish, and reappear nearby in perfect condition. This eliminates any harm you may have taken, or any illnesses you may have. It does not, however, have the ability to restore broken or lost bones.
summary: The ability to jump into the shadows to completely restore your condition.
strengths: The shadows are now your friend. Hurray :)
weaknesses: Being badly injured on a sunny day. :(

name: Upgrader
description: Whatever you touch when saying "upgrade" (doesn't have to be loud) instantly advances the item to a more modern version as it would be 100 years in the future (doesn't include people or animals). Can work on people when they are using a superpower which upgrades the power.
summary: The ability to upgrade anything you touch.
strengths: Futuristic
Impress your friends
Easy to control
weaknesses: Have to say "upgrade"

name: Imperceptibility
description: Also called Incorporeality, this is the ability to psychically avoid being detected by any of the five conventional senses (sight, touch, hearing, smell, taste). This allows the user to access Invisibility (inability to be seen), Intangibility (inability to be touched, also referred to as Phasing), Inaudibility (inability to be heard), Inodorosity (inability to be smelled) and Inodorosity (inability to be tasted). And usually, the user can choose whether to be partially or entirely undetected.
summary: The ability to evade all of the five senses
strengths: Invisibility
Intangibility
Inaudibility and Inodorosity
weaknesses: Insipidity (how often will a superhuman come along and try to taste you? )
Not imperceptible to those with ESP
If you have to choose between being entirely perceptible and entirely imperceptible

name: Electrical Mimicry
description: Your flesh and blood body is relatively limited. Electricity is much less so. Electrical Mimicry allows you to transform into a human-shaped lightning bolt that can travel through electrical wires, fly, emit bright light, and electrocute things.
summary: The ability to turn your body into electricity
strengths: Fly
Able to go many places you normally couldn't
Able to use electricity to heal your lightning body
weaknesses: Water causes unconsciousness or death
Magnetism is your new gravity
Unable to safely touch people in lightning form

name: Animal Empathy
description: Think of it this way, you wanna be like spider-man without having to be bitten by a radioactive spider. Now you can by being empathic to spiders. But it get's better. You can combine species. Grow limbs with lizard power, have chameleon sight. Have radar sense of a dolphin. Almost anything is possible with this power. You just have to know about the animal and then bam! You can use its power.
summary: The ability to use traits from animals
strengths: A lot of potential
Can use any animal. Even the extinct ones.
Combine powers (spider's eyes with chameleon sight), had one to sneak up on.
weaknesses: You can't turn into the animal.
You can't use mythical creature's power because they don't exist.
You might have to do a lot of reseach before you go into battle with this power.

name: Messianic Aura
description: A person with this power can cause people's good attributes to be dominant while people are in their presence. Even hardened criminals become repentant when under the affects of this power. Anything that has a conscience immediately tries to do good things or what they think is good. It can induce generosity and sharing as well. Even animals are affected by this power and will not attack you. Plants are also affected. Even bacteria and viruses are affected.
summary: The ability to cause good attributes to be dominant in your presence
strengths: Spread peace and win a Nobel Prize
Eventually you can use your reputation to do other things
Works on animals, plants, bacteria, fungi, and viruses--ie you can also stop any disease temporarily
weaknesses: People might want to follow you around
You are also affected by your own power at all times--so no using powers for evil
Only directly affects things nearby you

name: Equilibrium   Healing
description: Equilibrium allows the user to restore and maintain balance in any given situation. This ability is dynamic, altering depending upon the current requirements to maintain balance. In the case of biological damage, it can be used to heal wounds. This ability will naturally try to return biological lifeforms to their peak state. This means it will force regeneration of all damage, no matter how long ago it occurred. Can also heal mental illness. Can be turned on and off.
summary: The ability to restore biological lifeforms to their peak form
strengths: Can heal all damage done to self
Can heal any injury done to others
Can heal even mental illnesses
weaknesses: Healing is involuntary once active
Will naturally heal everyone, even enemies
Extensive healing can leave the user drained

name: Induced Evolution
description: With this power you can evolve or users of this power call; "advance"; things to you own desire by harvesting nearby resources. You can advance weapons to more powerful ones or when your driving a vehicle "advance" it into a airplane or evolve your self where you can breathe underwater. This power is interruptible. The more large and complex a target of "advancing" is, the more time it will take to advance and the more energy it will drain. When you advance something you cannot change it back.
summary: The ability to evolve or "advance" one's self, people, animals, plants, and objects physically and mentally
strengths: Advance a gun into a bazooka
Have flight, breathing and other powers.
Great when you have a getaway car; advance it into a plane
weaknesses: Limited energy no matter what.
Cannot change targets back.
Longer time for more complex and larger targets

name: True Sight
description: True Sight is the ability that lets one see what is really there. Example: If the person who hones this power meets with a shapeshifter, he/she would see past the shapeshifter and see what the person is really like. Also, he/she can see how the person really is. The person who has this ability has eyes the color of gold.
summary: The ability to see what is really there
strengths: You can see past any charade.
Provides mental protection from demons and infernal beings.
You can see how someone really is, contrary to what they say or how they act.
weaknesses: The powers are somewhat involuntary, to avoid this the bearer must wear sunglasses.
You can be affected indirectly.
To get the full extent of the power, eye-to-eye contact is necessary.

name: Ultimate Healing Touch
description: A person with this power has the ultimate healing ability able to heal any biological disease by hyperaccelerating cells and replacing them and simultaneously getting rid of infected cells. However the healing is very potent and will heal any injury even ones that people do not want to heal. If you heal a person too much they will age. Then this power can heal the old age by changing the person's cells into immortal cancer cells that will continuously self replicate. You must take your hand off.
summary: The ability to hyperaccelerate healing for any condition
strengths: You are the ultimate healer
Your healing is always treated as beneficial by any superpower sense so you can heal anyone
You will heal any injury when used even your own
weaknesses: You cannot use this power for very long or else you will overheal yourself
Hyperaccelerated healing will also hasten the cellular regeneration rate thus causing cells to age
You might accidentally heal someone to the point that they turn into cancer cells

name: Healing Breath
description: With this ability, you can heal all wounds or cuts by blowing on them. They regenerate instantly. Your breath is also very pleasing, and has a cool temperature at all times. This, however, ONLY works on wounds, gashes, et cetera.
summary: The ability to heal wounds by blowing on them.
strengths: Breath that heals all types of wounds.
Your breath is very cool and pleasing.
No one will need bandages while you're around.
weaknesses: Cannot heal poison, age, or unexposed wounds.
Attracts the attention of the public.
If you lose your lungs, you will not be able to blow.

name: Animal Mimicry
description: This is the ability to take on the physical attributes of an animal, which causes an animal/human hybridized appearance. This ability can be passed on to other people, if the other individual is capable of supporting the ability. Causes user to experience animalistic personality traits.
summary: The ability to take on the physical attributes of an animal
strengths: Animalistic physical boosts
Able to pass on to others, if they have ability potential
Very cool hybrid forms
weaknesses: Causes animalistic personality traits to manifest
Able to pass on to someone unworthy
Some hybrid forms not so cool

name: Nature Dominance
description: The ability to control nature. If your plants are weak and dying, you can heal them. If you are in a fight, you can use roots to bind people. Call animals to do what you want them to. Ex: ask birds to retrieve something for you, hurt or kill enemies with the power of nature. You are never powerless, unless in a location with no plants, animals or viruses.
summary: The ability to bend nature to your will, except the weather.
strengths: Control nature and animals
Control viruses
weaknesses: If in a sterile environment with no nature, you are powerless
Cannot control the weather

name: Liquid Shift
description: With this power you can change your body into a liquid. In this liquid form you can hide in small or tight places and you can cause people to slip.
summary: The ability to turn your body into a liquid
strengths: You can hide in small places or slide under doors
You can cause people to slip
weaknesses: You can't really fight villains in liquid form

name: Survivability Control
description: So you aquired this power. Now what? You can now control anyone's ability to survive (either by improving it or worsening it). The only requirements is that you have the person in your field of vision, and that you haven't already used it 3 times that day (yes, it's restricted). By improving someone's ability to survive, they no longer need as much water, food, etc. By lessening their survivability, they now have to eat and drink constantly to keep up good health.
summary: The ability to control anyone's ability to survive
strengths: Defeat your enemies easier by making them weaker
Keep your allies healthy in times of crisis
Finally put that small sandwich in the fridge to good use
weaknesses: If you've already used it 3 times the day and you're cornered; you're not in luck.
Cannot use this power on yourself
Cannot prevent anyone near death from dying, only prolong their life a while.

name: Ocean Lordship
description: This is the ability to control everything in the ocean and the ocean itself. This does not mean you can generate things like life. But you can mutate life in the ocean to match a different description. You can also make ocean plants grow at your will.
summary: The ability to control the ocean and everything in it
strengths: You can go to the beach without fear of getting bitten by a shark.
When you go surfing, you can make big waves.
You can ride dolphins.
weaknesses: If there is a tsunami you will be blamed if people know about your power.
When you hear about shark attacks you might fill guilt because you could have stopped it.
People could try to assasinate you because they are jealous of your awesome power.

name: Myth Power: Ananeosis' Amnesty
description: Ananeosis, in Greek myth, is the goddess of renewal and restoration. As such, channeling her allows one to access Rapid Regeneration. In addition, one can psychically heal others to an optimum default state, by touch, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically mend scratched/dented/bent/broken/damaged items, by touch, at will. One can also restore spoiled, rotten, stale or moldy food to a perfectly fresh state, at will. One can even psychically restore lost/repressed memories, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ananeosis' command over the essence of renewal and restoration
strengths: Access Rapid Regeneration and heal others to peak physical health, by touch, at will
Psychically mend broken/damaged items, and restore spoiled/rotten/moldy food to fresh state, at will
Psychically restore memories, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically renew ammunition, food rations, etc into infinite supply until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically suppress/negate others' Healing and/or Rapid Regeneration, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically revive subjects from the dead (can only prevent/undo death's decay) (NCN)

name: Energy Sourcing
description: With this power, you can draw power from large or small but abundant sources of energy, such as turning kinetic energy into physical blasts or healing yourself with energy drawn from living plants or animals in the surrounding animals.
summary: The ability to draw power from large or small but abundant sources of energy.
strengths: Heal yourself.
Use energy for energy blasts or beams.
weaknesses: Might kill plants or animals the that the energy is drawn from.

name: Create Darkness
description: You have the power to create clouds of darkness that are so thick only you can see through (exceptions are people who have night vision or people who create light as a power.) The darker you make the darkness, the more it will drain you. Also, the longer/wider it is, the more it will drain you.
summary: The ability to create a darkness only you can see through
strengths: You can create darkness/shadows whenever you want
Sneaking around/eavesdropping will be so much easier
It will be easier to deal with headaches/migraines
weaknesses: If it's midday and if there's a shadow in a well-lighted area, people will know you're there
If you are against eavesdropping/stealing/spying, it is kinda useless
Most people with this power will be evil

name: Bone Morphing
description: This ability allows the person to morph there bones into weapons or other forms such as a beast or a different human form, for a limited time, the less bones used the more time you can use the ability. This ability can allow you to slice through almost anything.
summary: The ability to morph bones into many weapons or forms
strengths: Have weapons that can cut through steel
Can use up to one hour or more
weaknesses: Can only be used a limited time before having to rest
The more bones you morph, the less time you have to use the power
Rest may take half an hour before reuse

name: Unity Force Manipulation
description: This ability allows the user to manipulate the forces that allow things to unite literally or metaphorically.  Not only, the user can just fuse or defuse stuff, but they can prevent fusion. The user can make things that are assimilated or absorbed by something else not happen or vice versa. This ability also affect communities as well, in a different sense. The force that the user has can even cause a union of humans or animals to disperse or gather at the user's will.
summary: The ability to control the forces that allow things to fuse, assimulate, or connect.
strengths: Fuse or defuse things with a mystical force.
Disperse or gather groups of humans, animals, or other beings.
Cancel absorption, fusing, or combination-based powers of any kind.
weaknesses: None for now.

name: Animal Translator
description: With this power you can talk to animals and understand what they're saying. This power works on all animals including humans so you will be able to understand foreign human languages as well as speak to birds, insects, fish, arachnids, mammals, reptiles, amphibians etc. Being able to talk to animals does not mean that they are under your control but you can ask them to help you in battle and they might help. You can turn this power off so you're not constantly hearing what animals are saying.
summary: The ability to understand what animals are saying and talk to them in their language
strengths: You can understand and talk too all animals
You will understand even human foreign languages
You can turn this power off if you want
weaknesses: The animals are not under your control

name: Shield Of Light
description: This power allows a person to summon the silver pendant with the jade gemstone, that Lucian, leader of the Lycans, wore in 'Underworld'. It is completely indestructible, and can return only to its first wielder if ever misplaced. The source of its power lies in the gemstone at its center, which can be connected to the person's mind at will. They are granted self-regeneration, pyrokinesis, healing, telekinesis, flight and superb fighting skills.
summary: The ability to wield special powers from Lucian's silver pendant
strengths: The pendant can only be worn, and its powers wielded, by a good person.
Some powers, such as pyrokinesis and telekinesis, are very good powers to fight with.
Have partial immortality in addition to superb fighting skills!
weaknesses: Takes time to unlock the pendant's full power.
Some powers, such as pyrokinesis, might be dangerous.

name: Money Tree V7
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time but it produces as much money as you want it to produce in any type of currency. This money tree also cannot be destroyed by anyone other than yourself and the when you break the branches off they turn into swords.
summary: The ability to make a tree that produces an infinite amount of money
strengths: You can have as much money as you want
The tree cannot be destroyed by anyone other than yourself
The branches can turn into swords
weaknesses: You can only have one at a time

name: Hydra Regeneration
description: In Greek Mythology, the Lernean Hydra was a creature that would grow two heads whenever one was cut off. With this power, whenever a head, arm, or leg is severed from your body, two more will grow in its place. When you no longer desire the additional appendages, they will be absorbed into your body. Extra heads provide an increased field of vision, and extra arms have a number of functions. Additional heads do not think independently and are all controlled by a single consciousness.
summary: The ability to mimic the healing abilities of the mythological Hydra.
strengths: Immunity to decapitation and limb loss.
Increased field of vision from extra heads, as well as various applications for extra arms.
Extra heads and limbs are easily disposable if undesired.
weaknesses: Any extra legs will only get in your way (but they can easily be absorbed back into your body).
Generally makes you look like a freak (but again, this can easily be fixed).

name: Focus Sight Regeneration
description: With this ability, you can recover from cuts, bruises, or any other type of wound simply by looking at them. This, however, does not work on other people.
summary: The ability to recover from wounds by simply looking at them.
strengths: Recover from any type of wound by looking at it.
weaknesses: Does not work on other people.
If there's a wound on your back, you can't recover ( Except by using a mirror )

name: Blade Of Life
description: The subject is able to materialize a 1,10 meter long sword, made of thermodynamic and luminous energy and containing ATP, growth hormones, platelets, peptides and other molecules involved in biological processes that regenerate body cells. Stroking with this weapon s. O. Wounded or mutilated, the subject can heal his wounds by encouraging cellular proliferation. Otherwise, this sword can "steal" regenerative molecules, in order to make s. O. Decompose and fade.
summary: The ability to create a pure-energy sword that heal wounds or accelerate cellular decay.
strengths: The sword can be used as a normal sword, because it can instantaneously cut cells with enzymes;
Healing and fading caused by the sword are almost instantaneous.
weaknesses: Tumors and viral illnesses can't be removed, only physical injuries;
Summoning the sword postulates a big metabolism from the subject.

name: Paint Alive
description: Paint anything like animals, people or objects and make them come alive within 5 seconds.
summary: The ability to paint anything and make it come alive.
strengths: Paint the person you love and make them come alive.
Paint money and you will be able to use it everyday.
Paint a house for you to live in.
weaknesses: Can paint weapons to harm people.
Can paint wild animals to cause troubles.
Can paint disaster to kill people.

name: Omnilingualism
description: One with this ability can automatically perceive, understand and communicate (speak, write, etc) in nearly any and every language, at will. English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese, Italian, German, Dutch, African, Greek, Latin, Aramaic, Animal, Plant, Kything, chemical message exchange, computer text, Klingon, Elfin, Gallifreyan, R'lyehian, Body Language, Sign Language, Morse Code, Bee Waggle Dance, etc. For those requiring certain organs one lacks, one can also access Vocal Mimicry.
summary: The ability to perceive and communicate in almost any and every language in existence, at will
strengths: Understand any language (never caught off guard by a language barrier)
Communicate any language (never offend others by pronouncing words/phrases wrong)
Access Vocal Mimicry for any languages that require body parts one does not have
weaknesses: Doesn't translate gibberish into comprehensible language
People always hounding you to translate for them
Communicate in 'nearly' any language (certain languages require alien body parts you don't have)

name: Pseudo Supernatural Magic
description: Not all magical superpowers are actually supernatural, but are based on alternate or futuristic "science" which is unexplainable.
summary: The ability to manipulate the forces of alternate or futuristic science.
strengths: You would be able to manipulate reality and the laws of a universe.
Your powers would be of infinite supply.
It would not be affected by true magic.
weaknesses: You would have no full knowledge of your ability.
You would possibly unintentionally harm others.
If not experienced, you could be temporarily depowered.

name: Cloner
description: You can change and control the clones you create. Also, they have the superpowers of the people they're cloned from.
summary: The ability to clone yourself and others
strengths: Be any person you want
Clone yourself and change your physical or mental features
Embarrass someone by cloning them and making them fart, poot, etc.
weaknesses: The other person is still there, so it might cause confusion

name: Form Replication
description: Shapeshifting only allows for change in shape, but Form Replication allows for a total disguise. It is possible to change one aspect (e. g. Height) but not others. In a total disguise, you have the original's memories, powers, skills, appearance, etc., in addition to your own powers, skills and memories. You can the switch from your normal appearance and your stored disguise, which can be stored for any length of time.
summary: The ability to copy a person entirely
strengths: Perfect disguise
Get another power
Great for immortals
weaknesses: Only one stored disguise at a time
Having the original show up
Requires touch

name: Doppelganger
description: They say that a doppelganger is an evil twin. As a superpower, you can not only become a perfect version of that person, place, or thing, but you can copy their talents as well. Once you see someone or something you would like to copy, their appearance and talents become yours.
summary: The ability to copy the form and talents of a target.
strengths: Take the form of a brilliant scientist and have their brilliance
Become a sports expert or martial arts master
You can even copy fictional characters!
weaknesses: Can only copy someone or something you have seen
Can only copy one form at a time

name: Vicarious Healing
description: A sinister variation on Accelerated Healing, Vicarious Healing still lets the user regenerate from most any wound. However, the damage that would have been yours becomes inflicted upon an object of your own. The healing is more efficient if the object is something close to you, or even better, a picture of yourself. While this may afford healing and nigh-immortality, if you view the object, all the damage it took for you will leave it and return to you.
summary: The ability to have an object take damage for you
strengths: Recover from any wound
Maintain your youth
Jumping head-first into dangerous situations
weaknesses: Works best if it is your own portrait
If you see the object, its damage will return to you
May become jaded and a bit bitter

name: Superhuman Visual Acuity
description: A person with this power has a higher visual acuity that normal letting them see everything in hi-definition. They can even sense some things that are nigh-invisible like spiderwebs due to increased resolving power of their eyes.
summary: The ability to distinguish fine detail at a higher level than regular humans
strengths: See the world in HD
See and avoid spiderwebs
Sense how much dust is floating around in the air
weaknesses: Sometimes you don't want to see certain things in high definition
Can be distracted by looking at weird looking spiderwebs

name: Active Mutation
description: Active Mutation causes a chrysalis to form around the caster, causing a mutation to take place. The extent of the mutation is controlled by the caster, and can be stopped at any time.
summary: The ability to mutate to a more powerful form
strengths: Can mutate back and forth between forms.
Can be stopped at any time
Alters appearence, physical and mental strength, and alters abilities
weaknesses: Stopping mid-mutation causes horrid side effects
Alterations may degrade performance
You are powerless while mutating

name: Money Tree
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time and it grows one hundred dollars (or the equivalent of one hundred US dollars depending on where you are) a day in one dollar bills (or the equivalent). If the money tree gets destroyed or you destroy it, you can create a new one somewhere else.
summary: The ability to make tree that produces money
strengths: You can have a money tree
You can get up to one hundred dollars a day
weaknesses: You can only make one at a time
You can only get one hundred dollars a day and its in singles
People will always be trying to steal it from you

name: Altered Life Experience
description: This power allows to user to experience a part of any person's or animal's life. Say your a kid and don't know what you want to be when you grow up. You can experience the lives of people doing different kinds of jobs. If your wondering what your friend was doing you can get a idea of what they did. You can leave the life experience any time you want and you can't die in a experience you can only feel the pain. No time in the real world will go by while your in the experience.
summary: The ability to experience a part of another person's/animal's life in a slightly different way
strengths: You can experience lives of your friends, family and people you don't know.
You can't die in a experience.
You can even have experiences of dead people and animals.
weaknesses: You can feel pain in the experience.

name: Blood Master
description: One drop of even a small portion of your blood on any living organism makes them your slave-drone. If your blood touches a living thing you know everything the organism knows, see whatever it sees and as a bonus you can access their abilities. They have an undying loyalty toward you and all things your blood has touched. Your blood can be washed off but the effects last forever. Have fun controlling the world.
summary: The ability to control living things with a drop of your blood
strengths: There is no limit to how many people, creatures, plants, viruses etc. you can control
Seeing through other people's, animals', insects' eyes and taking their skills and abilites
Spilling all of your blood onto the earth and becoming the planet
weaknesses: Pricking your finger, cutting yourself, drawing blood constantly will eventually make you weak
Abilities do not include superhuman abilites, only athletic abilities, learned skills, IQ
People will find out who you are and a sniper's bullet will end your reign... or will it?

name: Desire Detection
description: With this ability, the user is able to detect a beings' desires, whether they be human, animal, machine, spirit or something else entirely. However, this only works if they want the user to understand what they desire.
summary: The ability to understand a beings' desires.
strengths: Pets are now much easier to care for.
Language barriers pose no issues.
You won't be the literal genie when trying to help someone.
weaknesses: Useless to uncaring people.
Cannot detect secret desires.
Does not provide the means to fulfill detected desires.

name: Animal Morphing
description: With this ability, you can morph into any living creature.  A cat, a bear, a cow, a giraffe.  You get the idea.
summary: The ability to morph into any animal.
strengths: Changing into a bird and flying
Changing into a lion and chasing people
weaknesses: Try not to get captured

name: Endless Pockets
description: You can store an infinite number of items of any size (elephants, TVs, people, games, etc. ). You are essentially Mary Poppins, except it works with anything you touch. You can store anything in your pockets, lunchbox, backpack, anything. This does not affect the size or shape of the object, or even the weight. You can change the weight, size or shape of the object at will as long as it remains a shape that it would be able to take normally.
summary: The ability to store anything and everything in any container
strengths: "Walk in" storage anywhere!!!
Store everything and anything (including you)
Bring everything everywhere without having to carry something
weaknesses: When you let it get too messy and you can't find anything
Not extremely useful in a fight unless you put the person in your pocket...
In which case you have to either place them there or cover them with the container

name: Light Regeneration
description: You can heal yourself and turn into the light version of you (like in Jak 3). This is possible because of light eco. You have to turn into the light you in order to heal.
summary: The ability to turn into an entity of light and heal yourself completely
strengths: You can heal yourself.
Never go to the hospital again.
Can also heal bones and deseases.
weaknesses: Have to collect light eco clusters or from an open unlimited light eco vent.
Once you run out of light eco, you can no longer heal yourself (unless you get light eco).
You can't have unlimited light eco inside you unless you unlock that cheat.

name: Prototype Blacklight Virus
description: With this power, you are infected by the Blacklight/Mercer Virus. Your main ability is to consume people (ripping them apart and combining their DNA with yours). After doing so, you can copy their powers, gain their memories, and shape-shift into them. You also have super strength, super speed, regeneration, and can turn your body into weapons.
summary: The ability to consume people and steal their memories, powers, skills, and form.
strengths: Have strength and speed. Can walk on walls, glide, and jump really high.
Can turn parts of your body into weapons, like swords, claws, shields, etc.
Can do everything Alex Mercer and James Heller can.
weaknesses: You can still be killed if you sustain to much damage and don't replenish your health

name: Universal Synesthesia
description: With this power you can control sound. You can also sense sound. Not only can you hear it, but you can also see, smell, feel, and taste sound (you can't eat sound since technically, it's not edible, but you can taste it on your tongue). Also, you can form sound into different objects. The sound becomes solid and takes the objects shape, so you can make weapons or walls and stuff. The louder the sound, the stronger the sound-shape-thing.
summary: The ability to control and sense sound and form it into different objects.
strengths: Create weapons and shields.
Smell, see, feel, and taste (if you want), sound
weaknesses: No sound equals no power

name: Angel Eyes
description: Whenever you see a person who is sick, corrupted, insane, cold-hearted or just plain diabolical, the beams of white light will come out of your eyes and they will be completely healed of wounds and/or lust for evil.
summary: The ability to purify and heal a person while staring.
strengths: Could even heal the blind, deaf, and mute.
weaknesses: Must gaze at a person to work.

name: Toy To Real Life Equivalent
description: With this power you can turn toys into their real life equivalents. You can turn HotWheels cars into real full sized versions of the cars. Turn teddy bears into actual bear, monopoly money into real money, toy army men into actual soldiers, Nerf guns into real guns etc. You are unable to turn them back into toys with this power.
summary: The ability to turn toys into their real life equivalents
strengths: You can toys into their real life equivalents
weaknesses: You can't turn them back into toys
Some toys it doesn't work for such as marbles, Slinkies, dart boards etc.

name: Polymorph
description: With this ability a person can forcibly change another person into any animal of their choosing. Such a change is always unpleasant for the person changed. Strangely this power only works on things that can think making animals, plants, and objects immune. This power generally last for a day or two for a normal person, but for exceptional people it lasts hours. A person with a power will still have that power, though on a slightly reduced scale. This power is useless against shapeshifters.
summary: The ability to change people into animals
strengths: Good for non-lethally disabling people
You can choose the animal they turn into
Fun.
weaknesses: Temporary
People still have powers, so beware that super-strong mouse!
Can't work on animals or objects, or yourself

name: Five Senses Manifestation
description: With this ability active, you are able to release your five senses as five different forms of yourself. Touch would take on the form of a human-sized spider with enhanced strength, smell would manifest as large wolf without eyes and a muzzle, hearing would take on the form of a large bat, taste would manifest as a large chameleon with a prehensile tongue capable of inducing paralysis, and sight would manifest as a giant crimson eagle with scalloped wings. The sixth sense is a chimera of all.
summary: The ability to release your five senses as physical forms.
strengths: When in trouble, invoke your five senses for back up.
Communicate with your fives senses using telepathy.
Utilize all five senses at once to call upon the "sixth sense" (precognitive).
weaknesses: Learn to control all five senses.

name: Pokemon Mimicry
description: This is my tribute to "Pokemon". The user gains the abilities of a pokemon. The user will have power over their respective elements. Depending on the pokemon, the user gain more animal senses. The person can become half or full (like that time Ash became a Pikachu). The user can communicate with other pokemon. Like any pokemon, what type you are affects what is your weakness. Even when your human, you will still be affected.
summary: The ability to have the traits or become a Pokemon.
strengths: The power of a pokemon.
Communicate with other pokemon.
Use pokemon moves
weaknesses: Your weakness will depend on what type you are.
You can be captured by a pokeball.

name: All Heart
description: Having this power greatly improves your circulatory system's performance. Your veins get wider, your heart gets bigger, and you have a much larger reservoir of blood. Consequently, you're a little taller and fleshier than most people, and you have a much higher endurance.
summary: The ability to enhance your circulatory system.
strengths: Bigger oxygen reserves in your blood.
Easier to avoid heart attacks and other circulatory problems.
Much harder to bleed to death, seeing as how you probably have an extra liter.
weaknesses: Nothing really, except that you're a bit taller and heavier.
Easy to be targeted by Hemokinetics and such

name: Shadow Clones
description: This lets you make copies of yourself and send them off in directions to confuse opponents
summary: The ability to make ghost copies of yourself
strengths: Good for confusion
Instant party any time and never lonely
Make a fake army to scare opponents
weaknesses: These clones cant really do anything but move
They cant attack or protect you
Anything that strikes them goes through because they are ghosts

name: Super Senses
description: You can hear, see, touch, taste and feel flawlessly. You can listen into any conversation in your office and help spread the gossip. Or read the newspaper by feeling the ink raised on the paper. You can learn how to tune out sounds and voices. Also, you can learn how not to smell bad smells, though it will take much practice to learn how to do that.
summary: The ability to amplify all of your senses
strengths: Your senses are amplified
Can tune out loud sounds
Learn how to not smell bad smells
weaknesses: Bad smells
Loud sounds

name: Corrodium Effect
description: You grow corrodium crystals on your body. Using these crystals you can mutate living organisms that come into proximity of you.
summary: The ability to mimic the properties of corrodium
strengths: Mutate living things
Super strength
Launch corrodium from your body
weaknesses: Some creatures are uneffected by the corrodium

name: Sleeping Recovery
description: A person with this power is able to recover from anything as long as they are given enough sleep. The severity of the conditions determines how much sleep they need. In addition, they will automatically wake up when they are refreshed. Cannot cancel death however.
summary: The ability to heal all wounds when sleeping
strengths: You can heal all your wounds and feel refreshed when you wake up
Even wounds made while you sleep will heal, albeit slower
weaknesses: You cannot do anything while you are asleep
Hospitals will want to experiment on you

name: Cartoon Powers: Ben10
description: With this power you can turn into a member of any fictional alien species from any comic, book, movie, video game, tv show etc. You can stay in alien mode for up to ten minutes and then you can't turn into another one for another ten minutes. You have all of the powers of the aliens along with gaining their average intelligence. After a lot of training you will be able to extend the time that you can stay in alien form for.
summary: The ability to turn into a member of any fictional alien species
strengths: You can turn into a member of any fictional alien species which is over a million different forms
Some of your forms (cybetronian, kryptonian, tetramand) are extremely powerful
weaknesses: You can only stay in alien form for up to ten minutes without training

name: Perfect Vision
description: The one possessing this ability is capable of extracting any information from someone or something just by looking at it. Also enables someone to determine something / someone's weakness very quickly. Also enables the user to gain 360 degrees of vision field.
summary: The ability to gain information just by looking at something / someone
strengths: Very useful ability if you are a spy
Could determine enemies' weakness just by looking at them
weaknesses: Strains your brain and could cause fatal stroke with prolonged use
You might gain a lot of unusable information

name: Shrapnel Dubre
description: You can manipulate metal in all things, but as you draw it out it becomes a spear or shard shape. If you punched the ground, there would be a massive series of metal spikes that would rise out of the ground in a circle around you. Or, you could put your hand on someone's chest, and draw out all the iron in their blood into a little shard which you pull out of their torsos! Or even just put your hand on the ground and pull out a metal javelin and chuck it at someone!  Also your eyes turn metallic
summary: The ability to make metal spikes/spears/shards sprout out of the ground or buildings.
strengths: It's super dangerous/ awesome
Easy to use (the ground is basically everywhere, right? )
Looks cool!
weaknesses: You must touch what you want to 'shardify'
You might get sliced by your own blades
Can't use it in water/outer space

name: Ink Shaping
description: The main function of ink is to create. It's used to create pictures and stories on paper. Someone with Ink Shaping takes that to a new level. They can conjure objects and creatures from ink. Beginners will find it easier to conjure things from ink if the ink is in the form of what they're conjuring. So, if they are trying to conjure a sword, it'd be easier to do so if they have a picture of a sword. All creature conjured from ink are controlled by the Shaper.
summary: The ability to conjure object and creatures from ink
strengths: You can create objects and creatures from ink
It's easy to conjure objects from pictures and tattos
You can control the creatures you conjure.
weaknesses: Conjuring things directly from ink can be difficult.
It's dangerous to conjure more than three thing from ink at a time

name: Biological Absorption
description: Through this power, you are able to absorb the powers of another being. As well as powers, you absorb their energy and DNA, enabling shapeshifting and healing.
summary: The ability to absorb the complete biological structure of another being
strengths: Gain many powers
Enables healing
Shapeshift to max 1 other form to evade pursuers
weaknesses: The process of absorption almost always kills the person being absorbed
Due to the volatile nature of the users DNA, their DNA degrades hundreds of times faster than normal
Because of this, they need to take at least one person a week to stay in top shape.

name: Power Duplication
description: You can duplicate giving the clones a random superpower
summary: The ability to duplicate with super powered clones
strengths: An army of superhumans at your disposal
Can get rid of clones at any time
weaknesses: Clones might get to powerful

name: Marked Omnipresence
description: With this power, you are omnipresent in any area you have been at will. This avoids the problem of seeing things you do not want to and reduces the risk of an Omni Vampire. Unfortunately, you cannot interact with the viewed area.
summary: The ability to be omnipresent in any area you have visited.
strengths: View any area you have visited since acquiring this power.
You can choose what areas you view.
Useful for manipulation; get someone into a place you have been and you can watch them.
weaknesses: If you view an area with an Omni Vampire present, you suffer the consequences.
You must have been there already and some powers can hide what you see, such as Unpredictability.
This power cannot be modified in any way, including Con Negation or an Enhancement power.

name: Big Brother
description: With this power you automatically know when somebody is watching you. Makes it perfect to know when you can't/should use your powers. Also gives you the location of the watcher (deities and higher beings not included).
summary: The ability to know when you're being watched
strengths: You know when you're being watched
You know when you shouldn't use your powers
weaknesses: Doesn't include deities and higher/celestial beings

name: Transfearmation
description: Sure the Scarecrow has developed a fear inducing gas that he uses on his victims. He can induce specific fears or cause his victim to experience their own worst fears. What if you have this power to shapeshift into the worst horrifying monster, demon, alien, mutant, a person, or anything else that most evildoers fear most.
summary: The ability to transform into any person, creature, animal, or a thing that your enemies fear most.
strengths: might be a good use against bullies.
weaknesses: you could give some elders heart attacks

name: Power Of The Bat
description: Aster being bitten by a radioactive fruit bat, the hero or heroine or villain develops abilities of a bat. Abilities include echolocation, enhanced agility, enhanced balance, enhanced hearing, enhanced smell. The person bitten does not take any physical characteristic of a bat and would stilt look like a normal human being. Therefore, no big bat wings or any bat physiology
summary: The ability to have abilities of a bat
strengths: Powers very good for crimefighting or to commit crime
Good for fighting at night as the user does not need eyes to 'see'
weaknesses: Cannot take down powerhouses one on one
