name: Terrestrial Light Pulse
description: There is a light pulse that flows through planets. With your hands and your mind, you can summon up this earthly light pulse to grow the tallest and freshest vegetation on even the most Barren lands. You can clean the lakes and rivers from any pollution. You can even bring back animals and humans back from the dead (as long as they were recently dead).
summary: The ability to use the light pulse of the planet to rejuvenate almost Anything
strengths: You are the replenisher of the Earth and other planets.
You can turn moldy food back into their freshest state.
You can also use it to heal wounds on your self, or others. And bring back people from death.
weaknesses: You can't create a made up plant. Plus a planet has to have some remote sign to sustain some life.
Revive the dead as soon as possible. Because when it completely deteriorates, it's harder to do so.

name: Beat Resoundance
description: When this power is used every sound wave that your ears process with become a potential weapon. All you have to do is focus on the soundwave and it will be at your disposal.    You can make them into any shape or form such as orbs shields disks or just simple raw waves. You can adjust their density to be non damaging to extremely lethal.   If your deaf then this power is of no use to you. Plus anything that can diffuse sound can diffuse your constructs.
summary: The ability to project any sound heard into a solid form
strengths: Have the power of soundwaves at your fingertips
Even use your voice as a weapon
Always be prepared for any defense situation
weaknesses: No use if deaf
Doesn't work on sound diffusing surfaces

name: Ageless
description: With this power, you will never look a day over 30, but your lifespan is indefinite. So long as no outside forces kill you, you can live for thousands of years. Also, you heal 50% faster than normal people, and naturally regrow lost limbs. It takes about a month to regrow a lost finger, and almost a year to get back a lost arm. But that's just a drop in the ocean to you. You may not look so healthy all the time, though. Also, you will be inexplicably fated to meet any others with this power.
summary: The ability to live indefinitely, unaging, with some regenerative capabilities.
strengths: Live indefinitely
Immune to death by "natural causes"
Enhanced regeneration (Note: Other regenerative powers will override this one, though)
weaknesses: Not indestructible
Danger and the paranormal seems to be drawn to you
May develop depression and a cynical attitude from living so long

name: Absorption
description: The power to absorb/be absorbed into materials/minerals. You can also manipulate your body into new shapes--except for your brain, heart and major organs. Ex: You can absorb the materials of a gun. When you are attacked, you can morph your hand into a gun from the stored materials. Or, you can absorb a boulder and turn your body into a rock hard protective suit. Or, make a sword and shield of whatever you want. Or absorb and make wings for yourself. You can do whatever your imagination wants.
summary: The ability to absorb materials/minerals into parts of your own body.
strengths: Can manipulate and change your body into new shapes.
Can move through walls by absorbing your way through them.
Can obsorb non-solid objects.
weaknesses: Powers are temporary.
Shape manipulation is not always exact.
Power requires a large amount of energy.

name: Customed Persona
description: Instantly become a vigilante, costumed defenders and/or villian. You have to think about something (a person/theme etc.) and you will instantly get the costuime and equipment that goes with it. Not a superhero with powers (Green Lantern, Superman), just "real" equipment (Batman etc.)
summary: The ability to instantly assume a costumed persona based on anything, complete with equipment/weapons.
strengths: Instant morphing
Comes with equipment and weapons etc.
weaknesses: Once you assume a persona, it won't have any real powers.
It requires imagination/a good memory

name: Weapon Body
description: Morph your body into tons of different weapons. Shoot bullets from your mouth, or make an AK-47 grow out of your chest. The weapons can't detach from your body, but you only need to want your weapons to fire to do so. You can make lots of different weapons grow out of your body, or make a lot of the same weapons shoot at the same time. You can make energy weapons grow out of your body as well. You can't make actual armor or walls, but the metal or plastic of the weapons you grow can help.
summary: The ability to create weapons on your body
strengths: Never need to carry a gun
Be a living super tank
Act like a shield
weaknesses: Your weapons might get jammed by a superpower
Can only make guns, no swords
Can't make actual armor

name: Symbiotic Suits: The First
description: The First is a symbiotic suit that enhances your strength, your healing time, your reflexes, your speed, your vision, your sense of smell, everything, to that of a superhero's. You basically become super you. If you have any natural powers, they become amplified. By the way, The First replicated (had kids) some of whom were different, and some of whom were the same.
summary: The ability to have every natural skill enhanced.
strengths: Super Everything
Amplified super powers
weaknesses: Weakness: Sonic Vibrations & others with a version of The First
Only applies to natural skills
Symbiote will probably try to take over every once in a while

name: Custom Organism Creation
description: With Custom Organism Creation, you have the power to create your own species of organisms which could eventualy evolve into your allies, viruses, or whatever you want. You control the shape, size, abilities, and features of your organism.
summary: The ability to create new species of organisms
strengths: Create allies to help you in battle.
Create viruses to destroy your enemies.
Use them to accomplish your goals.
weaknesses: Evolution could lead to unintended traits.
Others could raise your organisms under their command.

name: Multiple Changeable Vision
description:
This ability you can see normally and just blink and you can see in x-ray vision, heat vision, microscopic vision, zoom-magnification vision. You can switch between your visual sight by blinking and focusing on which vision you would like to access at that point.
You can not use two different visions at once. E.g X-ray vision and night vision.
summary: The ability to change the way your eyes see.
strengths: Look at the world in multiple ways.
weaknesses: Can't access more than one vision at once.

name: A Friend To All Non Humans
description: Non-human beings will always like you and never attack you, and they will always want to help you at any time. Must have had 'Animal Attraction' for 2 years to gain this.
summary: The ability to be such that no non-human will ever attack one.
strengths: You will have friends everywhere you go.
weaknesses: Humans might wonder why you are surrounded by animals and other creatures.

name: Perceptible Stress
description: Just as infra-red vision displays hot areas as red and cool areas as blue, someone with this power would literally be able to see areas of high and low stress concentration in an object. With this ability, you could tell when and where something was about to fracture (such as a platform or bridge), and assess the safety of a range of things before you used them. An intensely practical power.
summary: The ability to see the mechanical stress in an object as colour gradients.
strengths: Very practical, could be life-saving in a number of situations.
Relatively voluntary, as you need to focus to truly see the stress.
An engineer's dream power. Well, this and anything with steel and explosions.
weaknesses: Watching the inevitable as you see a bridge about to collapse wouldn't be fun...
Not too useful in combat, although spotting stress concentrations in armour could show weaknesses.

name: Sympathetic Vision
description: To use this power, you need to close your eyes and concentrate on a precise person or animal, it doesn't need to be someone or an animal you're familiar with. When you open your eyes again, you'll be able see exactly what that person or animal is seeing. Their eyesight won't be affected and they shouldn't notice anything. Obviously, if that person or animal is blind, not gifted with eyes, sleeping, unconscious or just dead, you won't see anything until you cancel the effect of your power.
summary: The ability to see through the eyes of someone else's.
strengths: Peek into anyone's private life without being noticed.
Works wherever the other person or animal is.
weaknesses: You can't see what's in front of you, so don't move while you use this power!
When the target blinks, you'll see a flash of black which can feel odd at first.

name: Under Blades
description: You can, at will, release these retractable two-foot long metallic blades from under your wrists. The skin between your wrists tears and bleeds, but the blood loss is quickly halted by your healing factor. You can unsheathe blades at once, although you must keep your wrists straight at the moment your blades pass from under your arms. When unsheathed, the blades are entirely within your wrists, allowing you to bend them when they are extended. The blades are made of metal and can slice anything.
summary: The ability to extend large blades protruding from your wrists.
strengths: By grinding your blades against each other, you can fire sparks of energy towards your enemies.
Can use your wrists for swords.
weaknesses: None actually.

name: Immortality
description: Immortality is a gift and a curse. An Immortal is unable to die or even age--when the ability is first manifested, the holder stays that age forever. Their hair and nails continue to grow. Though they cannot die, they are not invunerable nor do they heal faster: if they are hit by a train or decapitated, they must wait for recovery. Users may also develop an aloof mindset or even become despairing.
summary: The ability to be unable to age or die
strengths: Live forever
Do everything you want to do in life
Ultimate adversary
weaknesses: No healing factor
May develop a distant, arrogant mindset
Still feel pain

name: Tactile Florakinesis
description: Florakinesis is the ability to control and manipulate plants. With this power, all you have to do to obtain florakinesis is to touch a plant of your choice and concentrate. You can control any plants that you have touched. Also, if you concentrate as you touch soil, you can cause a plant of your choosing to grow. Unfortunately, this power can only be used once per day, until it develops.
summary: The ability to control plants by touching them
strengths: You can obtain florakinesis by touching plants
Any plants that you have touched can be controlled
Touching soil can cause a plant to grow
weaknesses: It can only be used once per day, until it develops.
You HAVE to touch a plant to control it
Touching poisonous plants is not a good idea!

name: Dna Equivalence
description: When you can turn into any creature that bites you, Mosquitos are way less irritating! Once something bites you, you can turn into it at will, anytime you want. You are still susceptible to anything venomous, but surviving it would have extreme benefits.
summary: The ability to turn into your own equivalent of whatever creature you want, providing it bites you first.
strengths: Sneak around, go werever you want, get bitten by other supers and absorb a fraction of their powers.
Really, who hasn't regretted being human at least once?
weaknesses: You can still get infections. Invest in polysporin and band-aids.
If it can't bite you, you can't morph into it. That lifelong dream of becoming a moth? Not likely.
Anything too powerful that's biting you will probably kill you before you can morph.

name: Immune System Enhancement
description: With this power, your immune system, along with other aspects, is immensely increased to keep you safe. Your white blood cell count skyrockets along with other things and you are immune to AIDS, and poisons. You can breathe out or excrete a poison to kill "germs" and other things, and your body heat can go up to three hundred degrees fahrenheit without harm. You heal quickly and have one hundred times as strong connective tissue.
summary: The ability to have your immune system increased with other aspects.
strengths: Virtually invulnerable to disease.
Heal quickly.
Versatile.
weaknesses: No sick days.

name: Elemental Seance
description: Spirits of the four elements exist all throughout nature, protecting and preserving pieces of their respective elements. Those who wield this power, called Druidic Elementalists or DEs, have the ability to commune with these spirits. In return for helping them to preserve and heal nature, they will assist you. They each posses properties of their elements. A special ability DEs posses is to manifest them physically so that they may assist you. They may also merge with them, but this is a rarity.
summary: The ability to commune with and control the elemental spirits of nature, and allow them to manifest physically.
strengths: You can heal and protect nature.
You have elemental spirits that can aid you in many things, both physical and mental.
You may always have a friend in nature.
weaknesses: You have to make a deal with them to be able to gain their trust and help.
Manifesting them physically takes a lot of energy and may make you tired.
They may turn on you if you go back on your word.

name: Full Frequency Hearing
description: You can tune your ears sort of like a radio. You can have normal hearing or change your ears to a different frequency to pick up police radio and even cell phone conversations. You need to develop the skill to be able to use it correctly. You cannot broadcast yourself, you can only listen to what others are broadcasting.
summary: The ability to hear anything being broadcast on any frequency with your own ears.
strengths: You will never need a radio again.
You can listen to people's cell phone conversations.
You can hear what police are doing.
weaknesses: Takes a few weeks to learn how to tune out some broadcasts.
People might be afraid to talk on a cell phone if they know you are nearby.
You cannot broadcast yourself.

name: Shadowveil
description: This is like Tosen's bankai from Bleach. This lets the person create a black dome or sphere around them and makes everyone not touching the user of this power lose 4 of their 5 senses (only one you keep is touch)... It is a repeating dome so you cant just keep running in a line to escape it
summary: The ability to create an area made of complete darkness
strengths: They lose almost all of their senses unless they can find you and keep hold of you
You can make everyone trapped in it practically useless while you and anyone touching you are fine
Can make your opponents fear you (especially when scared of the dark) and gain great advantage
weaknesses: A big shadow dome thing is rather obvious that something is happening there
Its around yourself and made of darkness so you cant see out until you end it
Anybody that goes in cant leave till its dropped and lose senses unless touching you

name: Genetic Break Through
description: This ability allows the person to see their genetic code and change one part of it permanently. Like, for example, someone could change their code to keep on growing the rest of their life. Another example is that a person could change their code to continually raise the percentage of their brainpower. This ability is so life changing that you can do it only once.
summary: The ability to change one part of your genetic code forever.
strengths: You can unlock a hidden power within your genetic code.
You can change any part of your genetic code.
weaknesses: It is permanent
You can do it only once.

name: Eco Grow
description: Make flowers bloom and trees grow big and strong. With this power with the touch of your hand any dead flower or plant and watch it come to life at an alarming rate.
summary: The ability to touch any plant and have it come to life
strengths: Help grow a garden
Help stop global warming
Grow your pumpkin REALLY BIG for the pumpkin contest :)
weaknesses: Requires touch

name: Fractal Crystalline Body
description: You have all the strengths and weakness of a living crystalline being plus fractal abilities. You regrow any lost body mass and any lost body mass grows into another you. Your new selves have your intelligence but are your slaves and share your fractal abilities. Shattered into 500 pieces you grow a new body and you have 499 new allies. If for some reason you switch back to human form or have this power negated, your crystal clones vanish.
summary: The ability to become a crystalline form with fractal abilities.
strengths: You become an army if someone inflicts damage on you or you jump off a tall building.
It requires total destruction or your existence being erased to kill you.
weaknesses: A power that can freeze, banish or trap you without damaging you.
Someone who could control or manipulate your crystalline body.
Any power that can stop you from damaging yourself.

name: Light/Darkness Expansion
description: This power only works if you have a considerably good or bad alignment. In that case, you can scan any individual's heart to look for a small amount of goodness (if they are not on the good side) or evilness (if they are not on the dark side). If there is some, you can amplify it a lot so that person gets a total change of alignment. You can even use this power to know which alignment someone really is and if someone is a traitor.
summary: The ability to feel the faint amount of goodness/evilness in someone's heart and expand it
strengths: Works on neutral individuals too.
Easily recruit people to the good/dark side.
weaknesses: Only works if you have a huge amount of goodness/evilness in your heart.
The effects are cancelled if you die or if you lose your power.

name: Countdown
description: Whenever you count down from 10 to 0 whatever you were touching when you reached 0 explodes. You are immune to the effects of the explosion though everyone else around you can be injured or even killed. You can blow up enemy bases by touching one of the walls of the base and counting down from 10 to 0. It even works on humans, animals and other living things. It only works if you star counting down from so if you start from 11 nothing happens also if you go past 0 to -1 noting happens.
summary: The ability to cause whatever you're touching to explode when you count down from 10 to 0
strengths: You can cause things to explode by counting down from 10 to 0 and you're immune to the efffects
It even works on living things
If you change your mind midway you can either stop or just keep going past 0 to -1
weaknesses: It happens whenever you count down from 10 to 0 unless you're not touching anything

name: Un Foreign
description: By having this power you can hear all languages as if they were your native language, never again will you be frustrated with not understanding an others language, cant say the same for them though ^_^
summary: The ability to hear all languages as if they were your native language
strengths: Never be confused by another language.
Useful in foreign countries. (Kinda)
All around better comprehension skills.
weaknesses: They may not understand you.
Learning a foreign language will be near impossible.
Not really a battle notable power.

name: 9 Lives
description: You have the power of the urban myth of a cat having nine lives. You get nine chances to live if anything should happen to you. If you die, depending on how severe the injury was, it could take from 9 seconds to 9 hours for you to revive completely healed. You also have some luck to spare your life. If in a death situation, depending on your will to live, you can get out of it without dying, but it's pushing luck & not always reliable. You still age normally and eventually will die permanently.
summary: The ability to have 9 lives & luck of a cat
strengths: Can die 8 times & live before dying one last time forever
Will be healed instantly after coming back to life
Have a bit of get out of death luck
weaknesses: Age normally
May take some time to revive after death
Your luck factor is random & may not work all the time

name: Florakinesis
description: This is a very simple psionic ability. It allows the user to manipulate plants around him as an extension of their own body. However, this ability doesn't allow the user to create plant-life, but does allows you to accelerate plant-growth. You can even promote plant life in an area, as long as their was some there before, creating a sort of super-garden.
summary: The ability to control plant life.
strengths: Controlling plant life.
Tons of interesting plants
Trees are included here
weaknesses: Cannot create plant life from nothing

name: Neuron Revival
description: With this ability, you can make every neuron that ever died in your head to reform and revive. Neurons are not immune to poison damage.

name: Form Shifting
description:
Able to break yourself into anything you want, as long as it's a smaller thing than yourself (eg: a thousand butterflies, leaves, knives, dust... whatever)
Different from shapeshifting, because you shatter when you use it. It has a rule, though. When your small forms scatter, there is one form that is the original you. When the original you is destroyed, the rest of your scattered forms disappear and you die.
summary: The ability to break yourself into pieces and scatter
strengths: This ability is very elegant (when you scatter to a flock of doves, for example)
Amaze everyone and make them think you do magic
You can evade lots of attack
weaknesses: Can't beat forcefields or anything that can contain you
Can't phase, you're still a breakable matter
When you (as a particular form) are damaged, you get damaged as well

name: Animal To Mythical Creature
description: The animal being transformed can only be turned into a mythical creature that is similar to it in some way. Ex: wolves become Lycanthropes or Raiju, foxes become Nekomata, birds become Harpies, Rocs or Griffin, horses and rhinos become Unicorn, Kirin or Centaur, etc. The creature gains all the powers and intelligence of the mythical creature they have become.
summary: The ability to turn ordinary animals into mythical creatures
strengths: You can predict what animal will become which mythical creature(s).
weaknesses: You can't cause an animal to transform into something completely different.
The mythical creatures might not want to listen to you.

name: Fear Powered
description: This power is a variant from pain powered. The up side to this is no one has to feel pain. They just have to be scared. You can gain untold amounts of power from just the slightest hint of fear. Since most of your enemies will be fearless it might be wise to get someone who is scared to come with you. Gain Olympic strength and speed. You never get tired, heal any injury and even come back from the dead. You can gain power empathy with enough terrified victims. You even gain precognitive vision.
summary: The ability to gain power from others when they are scared
strengths: With one scared victim you gain untold power
Faster and stronger
Seeing things way before they happen and knowing when and where they happen
weaknesses: Someone always has to be scared
Hearing screaming all the time is really annoying
"Are you afriad? "

name: Many Arms
description: With this power the user can grow up to 6 additional arms of any kind. This includes things like normal human arms, arms made of stone or fire, pincers, robot arms, animal claws, skeletal arms, and tentacles. When you are done with them, they slide back into your bod and vanish.
summary: The ability to grow different kinds of arms and hands.
strengths: Have up to 6 extra arms of any kind.
Do many things at once.
Grow arms to fit any situation.
weaknesses: You should be shirtless when you use this power if you don't want to ruin your shirt.
You will look grotesque with 6 extra shoulder blades.

name: Phagomorphosis
description: You are what you eat. Actually what you eat becomes part of you. Want gills? Just eat some fish and now you can grow yourself gills. How about something like spitting poison? Then just eat a cobra and it can be done. You eat it and you can grow or have any of its biological attributes, and eating it won't ever kill you. It won't work for plants, and if you vomit you lose all those extra acquired attributes. Thanks to cannibalism you can even regrow limbs--they're still lost from vomiting.
summary: The ability to gain biological attributes from what you eat.
strengths: Just eat an animal and you can have any attribute it has.
You can't die from eating any animal (even a poison dart frog)
You can heal yourself thanks to cannabalism
weaknesses: Only works by eating meat (useless if you're vegan or vegetarian)
You vomit then you lose all the extra parts you acquired
Once you decide to grow a part you cannot simply just "ungrow" it.

name: Superhero 2: Wolverine
description: He's the best there is at what he does. Who is he? Wolverine! With his razor-sharp Adamantium claws, you can slash anything in your path. You also have his regenerative healing factor, and his heightened senses of smell and hearing.
summary: The ability to have the powers of the clawed berserker, Wolverine.
strengths: You have metal bones, which gives you metal claws.
You can regenerate any part of your body.
Ain't a good tracker? Say no more because you can smell anybody's scent.
weaknesses: You'll lose control using your animal instincts.
At first, your hands will bleed once you sheath your claws.
Makes holes in your gloves.

name: Subconscious Hemokenisis
description: A person with this power can subconciously control blood at a sub molecular level. This ability is good since normal Hemokenisis takes an awful lot of concentration. One unique ability of this is that, when the body is injured the midn will subconciously drain blood from nearby people and morph it into carbohydrates & proteins giving energy & repairing body cells in little inder 5 minutes. But this can have a bad side too. People with subconscious hemokenisis can't actually control it.
summary: The ability to subconciously morph blood with the mind
strengths: One can pull of harder hemokinetic based moves at ease.
One has greater control over blood and even some control over water.
One can focus on one thing while his subconscious focuses on another
weaknesses: One can't control it. One can only impose their will on it. One with a weak will will be overcome.
If one depends on it too much for regeneration, they will only be able to live by absorbing blood.
It feeds away at the blood like a leech slowly.

name: Arceusforce: Meadow
description: The user of this ability can channel the harmony of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Grass-type. The user's skin turns green and their irises turn yellow. Under their plant guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Grass-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Grass attacks such as Razor Leaf, Vine Whip, Leaf Storm, Solarbeam and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Grass form.
strengths: The user is resistant to electrical, water, earth and other plant-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of plants for Grass attacks.
The user can feed through photosynthesis in this form.
weaknesses: The user is weak to fire, wind, insect, poison and ice-based attacks.
The power might be too powerful for the user and may even need to unlock it from the default form.

name: Fisher King
description: You uncontrollably shape your surrounding environment in a 3-mile radius according to your emotions. If you feel happy, there will be clear skies and warm weather. If you're upset, then there will be rain. If you're seriously ill, then buildings around you will slowly crumble, cracks will appear in the ground and rivers will become poisoned. Areas where you spend large amounts of regular time will slowly and permanently shift to reflect your personality.
summary: The ability to shape your environment according to your emotions and status
strengths: When you're in a good mood, everyone nearby gets sunny warm weather
If you learn how to control your emotions, you can control this to an extent
Can form an area that suits you perfectly
weaknesses: People may get pissed at constant rain if you're an emo
No one wants devastating tornadoes and thunderstorms if you're in a murderous rage
Weather forecasts are pretty much useless for you

name: Sp: Healing Presence
description: 'SP' stands for 'Sharing Presence'. With this ability, you heal other people/creatures in your area. You are also healed by the amount healed with this ability. For example, if five people are in your area, they are healed, and you are healed for the total amount recovered by the five people. This ability can be turned off.
summary: The ability to heal others in your presence, and be healed back by the amount healed to others.
strengths: Basically, you are healed for healing other people.
Can be turned off.
weaknesses: Forgetting to turn it off in the wrong situations.

name: Botanist
description: With this power you become a master Botanist, gaining the power to create sentient plants out of sunlight. You can naturally store sunlight within your body but can not use it for anything else except creating plants. Once you have collected enough sunlight you just point at a substance that the plant you are thinking of can grow in and it will appear. Each sentient plant can have special characteristics such as being able to shoot freezing seeds or explode.
summary: The ability to create special plants using only sunlight.
strengths: The plants are sentient and will defend you and obey your commands.
Can grow Sunflowers which have the ability to produce extra sunlight to use.
Plants are extra effective against the undead.
weaknesses: Need to have sunlight or this power is useless.
Stronger plants require larger amounts of sunlight.
Nearly all of the plants are fixed to the spot that you summon them.

name: Injury Transplantation
description: You transfer physical injuries and diseases from yourself to another person and/or back again. If someone is dying of multiple injuries, split the load among many people who can cope with minor pains. If an enemy stabs you in a fight, grab hold of them and transfer the wound to them. You have to be touching the person for it to work. Can be passed along a chain of touching people if need be. Symptoms are identical but smaller/weaker people may be actually harmed more than you by some injuries.
summary: The ability to shift injuries and afflictions from another to yourself, and vice versa.
strengths: Able to 'heal' yourself or others.
Everything you get hit with in a fight, they get hit with.
Practical everyday use if you run out of plasters.
weaknesses: You must be touching or connected to the person via other people's nervous systems.
If you heal yourself, you harm others.
May unintentionally overload another weaker person and kill them.

name: Hybrid
description: Permanently change yourself into an anything/human hybrid. You could be an animal-human, a mythic-human, a computer-human, or any other hybrid you can imagine. This only has one use on yourself, but if you become adept enough at it, you may be able to turn other people into them, but most likely you won't get to pick what they are.
summary: The ability to permanently change yourself into an anything/human hybrid
strengths: Become any kind of hybrid you can imagine and stay that way even if the power is drained!
May gain other powers, plus an extended lifespan and highly detailed control over transformation
Become adept enough and you can use this power on other people
weaknesses: Cannot revert yourself unless you have another power or such
Only one use per person
Cannot control what other people will become

name: Pain Transfer
description: With this ability you can take the pain from one person and send it to your enemy.   To use it you must be touching the source of pain and staring to your objective. You can also transfer your own wounds and pain, healing yourself.   There are limitations on the transfer of wounds, for example, if you transfer a wound in the arm to an enemy, the wound will be transmitted to the same arm.
summary: The ability to transfer pain and wounds from person to person.
strengths: You can heal your allies or friends.
You can damage your enemies.
weaknesses: The pain you transfer passes through your body, so you feel it, too.
Must be staring your foe.
Pain can only be transferred to foes who can feel it.

name: Liquid Extraction
description: To use this power, you simply have to apply pressure to a living or non-living thing and all the liquid it contains will be forced out of it. The more liquid there is, the longer it will take. Just like Dehydration, the object will dry up, but the released liquid can still be reabsorbed by its original "container".
summary: The ability to release all the liquid contained inside an object you press.
strengths: Squeeze an orange, a lemon, or any kind of fruit until all the delicious juice is extracted!
This is an effective way to get 100% of the last drops of ketchup at the bottom of the bottle.
No need to twist and wring a wet fabric, which will crease. Just press the water out.
weaknesses: You can try this on a human or an animal if you want, but it's going to be gross...
Don't accidentally use it while drinking, shampooing or using a pen. You'll spill everything.
The liquid can still be reabsorbed, unless the sudden dehydration caused enough damage.

name: Black Blood
description: One can control the flow of one's blood (colored black), which one can mentally pour out of one's pores and shape into weapons or armor, hardening shortly after contact with air. If cut, the blood will harden over the wound, eliminating the need for bandages. Secreting large amounts of blood will weaken you as if you had lost that blood. Cannot be reabsorbed.
summary: The ability to secrete your blood out of your pores, where it hardens into armor or claws.
strengths: Can make very hard blades or armor in a variety of shapes.
One can seal up any wound or hold any broken bone together.
One can create blades as thin as a molecule.
weaknesses: Once the blood leaves the body, it cannot be reabsorbed and crumbles after a few hours.
Black colored blood is somewhat conspicuous.
Extensive use can lead to weakness or death from blood loss.

name: Mythical Monster Morphosis
description: The ability to morph into the commonly known monsters of mythology, e.g. dragons, zombies, vampires, chimeras, krakens, medusas, nymphs, sirens, ogres, behemoths, you name it.  Also, as you morph into the mythological creature, you take on their power and nature too. For example, as a vampire, you can morph into a bat and have an unsatiable lust for the consumption of human blood, but you are weak to holy water, a stake in the heart and sunlight.
summary: The ability to morph into the legendary beasts of mythology.
strengths: Morph in and out of any mythological monster.
Take on the power of the monster you morph into too.
weaknesses: Monsters must be commonly recognised, can't just imagine new monsters up.
Take on the weaknesses of the monsters you morph into too.

name: All Fuse
description: Can fuse two objects found in the area and make them into one object. Cannot be an object that is alive or strapped/nailed down (houses, trees).
summary: The ability to fuse any objects into another object.
strengths: Multiple items may be used.
Can choose if it turns into a weapon or something else (i.e. furniture)
Can be returned to original items used for combination.
weaknesses: If using multiple items, must wait longer for end product.

name: Personal Zodiac Signs Creator
description: This power allows you to make a set of twelve animals/people/hybrids/objects into your own zodiac. You will be able to transform or gain appendages from any of the twelve. If you want to, you could create a single power for each of them that you would have as well (bird-invisibilty?) You may also create spiritual embodiments of these creatures to help you in battle.
summary: The ability to create your own 12 animal zodiac and have various powers.
strengths: Shapeshift into any of your zodiac signs.
Make special powers for each of them that you would have as well.
Create up to 12 spirits of any sign that will aid you in battle.
weaknesses: You have only access to one sign/power at a time
Real animals/people/objects/hybrids cannot be controlled.
You can only make twelve.

name: Write New Laws Into Reality
description: A person with this power can write new laws into reality as long as the new laws do not interfere with any old laws. This is very important. If your new law in any shape or form contradict existing laws the object in question which the new law is about will be erased from existence The new law becomes a permanent part of reality after 10 years--if it hasn't been negated. Can only write one law concerning anything-no covering loopholes that way.
summary: The ability to rewrite reality with new laws
strengths: Write a new law in reality
After 10 years the new law becomes established as reality and cannot be negated
weaknesses: Can only write 1 new law for about any given topic
People can find loopholes within your laws
Cannot become omnipotent since it conflicts with existing laws

name: Clairvoyant Interpretation
description: One with this ability has a useful one at his disposal. Any word that he cannot understand, or does not know the definition of will appear before his eyes. Can't hear? The words appear before your eyes to READ. Somebody says a big word you don't know how to spell? The spelling appears before your eyes. Someone speaking in a different language? The subtitled interpretation appears for your reading pleasure. And if you don't understand a word? A plain and simple definition appears for you to see.
summary: The ability to visualize words one cannot comprehend
strengths: Visualize words instead of having to interpret what you hear
Understand different languages (even bar codes, Braille, sign language or the like)
If you can't understand a dictionary definition, this power can even simplify THOSE
weaknesses: Doesn't allow you to communicate in the language you don't understand (only understand them)
Doesn't allow you to remember anything you see (commit it to memory or study it on your own)

name: Dollar Bill Shift
description: With this power you can change your dollar bills into other dollar bills (1s to 100s, 5s, to 10s etc. ) or into other forms of currency. When you change a dollar into another form of currency you can't change the value.
summary: The ability to change bills into other bills
strengths: You can change dollar bills into other bills or into other forms of currency
weaknesses: When changing one form of currency into another the value has to be the same

name: Television Synchronization
description: With this ability you can copy the powers and skills of people in TV shows. These shows can be live-action, sitcoms, cartoons, anime, etc. The show you're using must have come on television at some point in time.
summary: The ability to do anything associated with television shows.
strengths: The show "Heroes".
The show "True Blood".
Every anime you have seen.
weaknesses: You MUST know the name of the show.
You can't do anything extreme (like being God).
If a person knows more about a show than you, they might find some weaknesses.

name: Money Tree V3
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time and it grows five thousand dollars (or the equivalent of five thousand US dollars depending on where you are) a day in ten dollar bills (or the equivalent). If the money tree gets destroyed or you destroy it, you can create a new one somewhere else. Also if you're attacked you can use the branches as weapons to defend yourself.
summary: The ability to create a tree that produces money
strengths: You can create a money tree that produces 5000 dollars a day
You can use the branches as weapons
weaknesses: You can only have one at a time
You can only have up to 5000 dollars

name: Future Assisstance
description: Basically, a spiritual form of yourself in 10 years will stand by your side at all times and tell you just about anything. It can tell you what to do and what not to do. And everything else that it knows but only at your command. Only you can see and hear it, no one else.
summary: The ability to have your future-self's spirit tell you anything it knows.
strengths: Overcome almost any obstacle.
Have some great ideas from the future.
Only you will know about its presence.
weaknesses: If your future-self is at the age of when it dies, you will lose the ability.
Your future-self doesn't know everything.

name: Longevity
description: This ability allows the person to live longer than a normal human being.  Although this ability sounds similar to regeneration, it is not.  People with this ability can still be killed.
summary: The ability to live long
strengths: Live long
Never age from a specific age
weaknesses: Can still be killed
Lose love ones

name: Scapegoat Effect
description: With this power, the person chooses another person to receive the damage they get. However, they must have a strand of that person's hair or some part with their DNA, like blood or sweat, in order to transfer the effect. You can even transfer death. If you pulled out your heart, the scapegoat's heart will fail while you are perfectly safe until the other person's body is cremated or destroyed completely.
summary: The ability to have other people take the damage you get
strengths: You can use other people as shields, or you can transfer the damage to the enemy
Attacking yourself hurts others while you receive no pain or injury
Killing yourself only transfers damage to others
weaknesses: Does not protect against age or indirect effects, such as shrinking
Must need the person's DNA to work-not really that hard, unless you're up against a masked person

name: Death Note
description: When someone's name is written in a deathgod's (shinigami) note book that person will die.  The owner of the note book needs to imagine the face of the victim while writing the name.  By default the victim dies from a hearth attack 40 seconds after writing the name. But the time & cause of death can be defined by writing them next to the name.
summary: The ability to kill by writing someone's full name in a deathgod's note book
strengths: You posses the perfect homicide tool
Certain death of your targets, and no obvious way to trace you caused it
You can do something about the human over population by killing the bad guys
weaknesses: You're followed by a creepy deathgod as long you're the owner of the note book
Genius level investigators will be trying to find out who you are
Killing many people can't be good for your karma

name: Vitamaniacal Form
description: With this ability, you can transform into a monstrous-like creature which grows and gains power from life. You absorb life with tentacles, and you also have the ability to ingrain yourself with the ground to absorb it. As you grow, you even gain the abilities to suck in life, heal living things around you, and become more regenerative. Once you revert to normal, however, you lose the effects of this ability.
summary: The ability to change into a state which grows and gains power from absorbing life.
strengths: Grow and gain abilities, such as draining tentacles, draining breath, ingrain, and healing.
You become more regenerative the more life you absorb.
It's difficult to take damage while in this form.
weaknesses: Once you revert to normal, you lose the effects of this ability.
You have no defense towards emotional damage.
This form is extremely reckless.

name: Sense Steal
description: Quite like the proverb "see no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil". You can take people's senses by holding your hands over someone's ears to steal their hearing, over their eyes for sight and cover their mouth for voice.
summary: The ability to steal someone's sight, hearing or voice.
strengths: Defeat enemies.
Funny
weaknesses: Can be taken back with a simple spell.

name: Omnipotent Ganger
description: You can create up to millions and millions of your self at once. You can make your replicates either holographic illusions, temporal clones, or actual real people of your self in full flesh, blood, and bone. You can also rejoin the clones back to you and you can gain multiple memories from their experience.
summary: The ability to use double ganger in it's most godlike form.
strengths: You can make as much clones as you can think of. With no end.
You can gain memories of any of their experience when you rejoin (at will).
It is your choice whether or not you make a real clone to live by his, or her own life.
weaknesses: Your clones won't have superpowers, unless if you (the source) have another superpower to begin with
Some of your clones would miss behave (depending on your personality).

name: Scavenger Sight
description: Scavenger Sight allows you to see the worth of any object. This could mean either how much money you could get for the object, or how to the object can be used beneficially for you. Objects that are useful to you will glow to attract your attention, but the glow can only be seen by you. Objects inside containers will still glow to show you there is something useful but you will not know what it is until you open the container.
summary: The ability to see the worth of objects.
strengths: See the value of any object.
See how an object would be useful to you.
Find useful objects by their "glow" before you even know they are there.
weaknesses: Always seeing the "glow" of objects.
Just seeing useful objects doesn't mean that you will be able to get the objects to use them.
Can not tell what an object inside a container is by its glow until you see it.

name: Hyper Metabolism
description: With a Hyper Metabolism, one can heal from injury or disease faster than regular humans. They will still be subject to all human vulnerabilities, although his immunity to diseases, toxins, or even alcohol poisoning is extraordinary. It can burn off a large amount of calories, forcing the subject's body into a better shape and keeping on going.
summary: The ability to possess a faster metabolism than normal.
strengths: Becomes morbidly obese to perfect fitness in seconds
Having lots of energy coursing through body
Having enhanced physical prowess when needed
weaknesses: Most subjects with this power cannot turn it off
Still have to eat

name: Mythical Creature Taming
description: Dragons, chimera, unicorn, hydra, etc. Any mythical beast is possible. When the mythical creature is tamed he/she will be completely loyal to you and follow all reasonable orders. Ex: the creature won't kill itself but it will give up scales, fangs, etc. This power is completely voluntary in use due to the 5 creature limit. Once 5 mythical creatures are tamed, you cannot tame any more even if one of the mythical creatures you have tamed dies. Can only be gained by mastering Animal Trainer.
summary: The ability to tame up to 5 mythical creatures
strengths: You can have 5 powerful creatures at what is pretty much your beck and call.
Some rare versions of this power allow you total control of the creatures but that is rare.
weaknesses: You still cannot ride a unicorn if you are not a pure-hearted virgin. No making this power stronger.
Mythical creatures are intelligent and may ask the reason behind your orders from time to time.
Angels, demons, and a few others are beyond this power's strength to control. No Con Negation.

name: Plant Humanoid Evolution
description: You basically cause plants to become bipedal humanoids. They can talk in human languages as well as think for themselves. They will retain whatever abilities they had as plants such getting nutrients from the ground, making food from sunlight. The appearance of the humanoid plant differs based on what they looked like as a plant. If their lifespan as a plant was shorter than that of a human's it will expand to be at least that of the average human's, longer if it was originally longer.
summary: The ability to cause plants to evolve into bipedal humanoids
strengths: If you prefer plants more than people, now they can talk and play with you.
If you tried to take care of plants they will honor you.
weaknesses: People will gawk as the humanoid plant might still have things such as petals or leaves.
Not having been nice to plants.
They might decide to conquer the world as they can reproduce faster.

name: Quantum Loop
description: Break all or part of yourself into mini cells instantly when receiving any physical strike and form into any shape when needed. When appears in quantum form, one possesses the ability to control over an amount of gravity and magnetic force.  Able to wrap around your enemy to either suffocate, block their vision, or causes sudden gravity and magnetic power to crush them to the floor.  After transformation, an eye has to be kept to ensure vision or it will all depend on other senses to react.
summary: The ability to decompose our own body into quantum size at will.
strengths: Receive no physical damage.
High speed and wide range of activity.
Flexible and has multi-task purpose.
weaknesses: Complete transformation will leave you touch.
Vulnerable to extreme temperatures.

name: Alternate Temporal Optics
description: This power is the ability to view alternate timelines optically. Doing so the user can see what is happening in many different timelines all at once. In addition the user has the ability to travel backwards in the time line to even see what happened in the past so they can tell what triggers what. The scope of the users vision still applies to other timelines so you have to shift your view to see more, however you can use any other optic viewing abilities to view alternate timelines.
summary: The ability to view other timelines and gain knowledge of them.
strengths: See what triggers what in different timelines.
Becomes very deadly/useful in combination with time travel and timeline skipping.
You can gain information that could lead to building advanced technology.
weaknesses: Viewing too many timelines at once causes sensory overload.
You require a visual protection power to view timelines the same if they have been altered.
It takes time to view timelines that greatly deviate from our own.

name: X Ray Vision
description: Good old X-Ray Vision, you can see through different matter and be able to control the depth that you can see. So to look at someone (like a female) you don't just look through her, you can just look through her clothes, which could prove interesting.
summary: The ability to see through different matter.
strengths: See through solid objects
See through clothes
See into "the box" and know what the mystery item is.
weaknesses: Seeing through a door thinking it was open and running into it.
Seeing through clothes and seeing things that shouldn't be there.

name: Assassin's Eagle Vision
description: Here's an example of how to use it: You are at a concert, and you want to know how many people have blonde hair. Activate this power and pick a color. Everyone at the concert that has blonde hair will be shining with that color.
summary: The ability to determine what is and what isn't through sight.
strengths: Find out who is an enemy and who isn't.
See through illusions.
Intelligence gathering.
weaknesses: Your vision is a little bit blurry so you might bump into a few things.
You naturally focus on whatever is shining, so you might not pay attention to your surroundings.

name: Magnanimous Seeds
description: The subject acquires a specific power by touching or holding in their hands one or more seeds of a particular plant species. From the moment the person acquires the power, the plant grows on their own body and influences the effect of the power. An example: if the subject comes in contact with the seed of an oak tree, they'll be able to move objects with thought. The power depends on the personal meaning that the subject gives to the plant, but also on the chemical composition of the seed.
summary: The ability to gain a superpower by touching one or more seeds of a specific tree.
strengths: A very wide range of acquirable powers, as various as existing plant species;
weaknesses: If the plant is removed from your skin you will lost the power;
Keeping the plant on your body alive is not the easiest thing.

name: Rapid Myological System
description: You grow more muscle and burn more calories within a week of exercising. Every muscle in your body improves with every kind of exercise you do. You also improve the hardness of your muscles. If any muscle in your body is torn, sliced or bruised,  it will automatically regenerate and heal within minutes or seconds (depending on the severity of the damage).
summary: The ability to generate muscle growth in a short time and repair torn attendance in seconds.
strengths: Your muscles are dramatically bigger from exercises you do within a week.
Your muscles are five times harder and well sculpted within a month.
Any damaged muscle within your body will repair itself as good as new (literally).
weaknesses: If the damage is severe, it will take a little longer to repair itself.
Depending how much protein you eat, you will be quite heavy.
If you fast too much, your muscles will shrink only slightly (not dramatically).

name: Disease Manipulation
description: A person who has this ability can store any pathogen (disease-causing bacteria) inside themselves and release it at will. However, it is very difficult to single out a single disease, and the ability activates during stress.
summary: The ability to absorb, dispel, and manipulate illness
strengths: Extremely effective in fights
Could subdue an army
weaknesses: User usually winds up releasing a single conglomerate, deadly disease
Activates with stress unconsciously

name: Card Blade Thrower
description: With this power when you throw cards they turn into blades until they hit the ground. You cannot turn them back into cards until they hit the ground. It can be any kind of card, playing cards, greeting cards, business cards, trading cards etc.
summary: The ability to turn cards into blades when you throw them
strengths: Whenever you throw cards they turn into super sharp blades
weaknesses: It happens whenever you throw a card
The blades can't turn back into cards until they hit the ground

name: Lycanthropy
description: Our word lycanthropy comes from an old story about a king who was turned into a wolf. The ability itself isn't so extreme. The user merely becomes a bipedal humanoid with a muzzle, fur coat, claws, and enhanced physical attributes. They are twice as strong, twice as fast, and their hearing and smell are 10 times as acute. Yeah. Merely.
summary: The ability to shape-shift into a wolf-like form
strengths: Scary
Lots of power
Great combat ability
weaknesses: Can be overwhelmed by intense smells
Activates under extreme duress
Can fall into bezerker rages

name: Personality Phrases
description: You can change one's personality. For example, you can give somebody "Heart of an eagle". This is life-changing.
summary: The ability to change one's personality with phrases
strengths: Change personality with phrases
Improve one's life
weaknesses: Saying a phrase into the mirror will backfire it upon yourself. (good or bad? )

name: Counterfeit Doppleganger
description: This power is just like any cloning power out there. Except you can only create one clone. And the clone doesn't look like you, act like you, think like you or even dress like you. At. All! Well, they still are the same gender as you. When you're done, you can unsummon your "clone". You cannot change how he/she looks like, the same one will always appear.
summary: The ability to create a "double" of yourself, except he/she doesn't resemble you at all.
strengths: The avantage compared to other cloning powers is you don't have to explain why there are two of you.
The clone will generally be on your side since you can unsummon them whenever you want.
weaknesses: You can only create one clone and he/she won't even look like you.
Your clone may look more handsome/beautiful than you.
tags: was edited as it was just a unimaginative combination of two unrelated powers

name: Aura Wolf
description:
You will be able to change between a human and a wolf! 
You can manipulate aura in either form and sense the aura in all things living. You can live forever, simply by changing your form at least once a day! 
Aura wolves also can use their aura to heal exponentially faster than regular medicine. Plus, you have all the regular abilities of a wolf such as enhanced smelling, strength and reflexes!!!
summary: The ability to be an aura-wolf
strengths: You can change your form whenever you want to and live forever
Be a wolf!
Manipulate Aura(make aura-weapons, fly, heal, use as projectiles, etc... )
weaknesses: Aura exhaustion can occur
Don't change daily, don't live forever

name: Emotional Gas Emission
description: The gases you emit have different effects depending on how you feel. If you feel happy or joyful, you might emit laughing gas. If you want someone to go to sleep or die, you might emit sleeping gas or poisonous gas. Some gases can cause diseases or create hallucinations. Some of them even have the power to heal.
summary: The ability to emit different gasses depending on your mood.
strengths: You can activate this power by simply blowing the gas out of your mouth.
You aren't affected by the gases if you don't want to be.
The gases are invisible so no one can see them and run away from them
weaknesses: Sometimes, this power activates automatically by coming out from your pores.
It can also activate when you fart, but not all the time.
Could affect yourself

name: Periodical Elemental Shift
description: This ability you are able to shift/morph into any pure substance; that of which is found on the periodic table of elements. However since your being is solid you will have the appearance of the solid form of that element.
summary: The ability to shift into any pure elemental substance on the periodic table of elements.
strengths: Conduct electricity as copper or zinc.
weaknesses: As a magnetic element, suspectable to magnetism.
Can kill people yo love as a radioactive element like uranium.

name: Night Fury
description: You can turn into a 'Night Fury' dragon at will, a species from 'How to Train your Dragon'. You have vastly heightened senses, especially sight and hearing due to large eyes and bat-like ears. You have very powerful healing/regenerative abilities, and can breathe bright blue fire up to 3,000 degrees Celsius, which is hot enough to cause sublimation instead of melting.
summary: The ability to transform at will into a 'Night Fury' dragon
strengths: You are a very rare and powerful type of dragon, with unmatched aerial abilities and reflexes
Your abilities are natural, and so don't require practice to harness
weaknesses: You could change forms unintentionally when stressed, angered, scared, etc.
You only partially retain human thought and reasoning

name: Money Tree V5
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time and it grows one hundred thousand dollars (or the equivalent of one hundred thousand American dollars depending on where you are) a day in fifty dollar bills (or the equivalent). If the money tree gets destroyed or you destroy it, you can create a new one somewhere else. Also if you're attacked you can use the unbreakable branches as weapons to defend yourself.
summary: The ability to make a tree that produces even more money than Money Tree V4 allows you to produce
strengths: You can make a tree that produces up to 100,000 dollars a day
You can use the branches as weapons
Said branches are indestructible
weaknesses: You can only make one at a time
You can only have up to 100,000 dollars

name: Heart Of Light
description: The Heart of Light is a pendant radiating a mysterious aura, capable of resurrecting just about any/everyone. You can even resurrect yourself, heal someone who's sick or injured, and erase a person's evil curse.
summary: The ability to be instantly resurrected and erase person's evil influence.
strengths: It can also resurrect a hero.
weaknesses: None.

name: Serpentry
description: With this ability, you can transform into any serpent / snake at will. This includes Pythons, King Cobras, Anacondas, etc. You also gain all of their characteristics, including scales, venom, etcetera etcetera. You also have the ability to control them, and speak to them, giving them orders.
summary: The ability to transform into, and control any type of serpent.
strengths: You can shock people by turning into different types of snakes.
Even when you're not in snake form, you can control snakes.
weaknesses: It might not be a good idea to bring snakes around other people, just a thought.

name: Creature Bonding
description: First you think of the animals, plants etc. Then, put your hand in a stop position and point it somewhere. That is the place the thing will go.
summary: The ability to merge two or more creatures together into one
strengths: No matter the distance between the animals you can merge them.
It doesn't matter if they aren't animals; they can be plants, fungi, bacteria, spirits & prehisoric
weaknesses: They always come out different when you merge the same animals
You can't take the animals back out after you join them
You can't bond non-living things.

name: Combining Robot Physiology
description: This power allows you separate and recombine like a combining robot. Your head, legs, arms, and torso are capable of separating, either all at once or individually, and becoming individual creatures capable of locomotion and under your control. They are organic, and are in all ways like normal living creatures except in that they combine to form you. You are aware of everything the see, hear, smell, feel, or taste.
summary: The ability to separate yourself into individual creatures and reform.
strengths: Send a body part to scout the an area, and seperate to get through places you're too big to.
Seperate to avoid attacks, surround the enemy, or stealthily change position.
Keep from bleeding to death by seperating from your injuerd limb.
weaknesses: The independant pieces of you can get hurt and die on their own, costing you limbs.
Make sure one body part brings your cloths with you.
They're freaky little critters.

name: Video Eyes
description: With this power you can record anything you see into a video that you watch later all you have to do to watch it is stand in front of a TV or DVD player and think about the video's name for a while and it will eventually appear on the screen
summary: The ability to record videos with your eyes
strengths: Can take videos without a video camera
This camera's water proof
weaknesses: It might take a while for the video to appear on the TV
You have to remember the name to the video

name: Ultimate Weapon(Sword)
description: Everything has an origin-a time where it was created. This ultimate weapon made in the shape of a sword cuts anything at its origin. When you attempt to hit anything with the sword, instead of slicing your target into bits it will instead slice it at its origin. That means when you attack someone, they will be killed as a baby and will have never have existed in the first place. A paradox will occur and time shifts back and replays everything without the existence of what you destroyed.
summary: The ability to wield the ulitmate blade that cuts anything from its origin
strengths: It can effectively make anything to have never existed in the first place
When placed inside its sheath, it gives the wielder protection against time alterations
The sword will always exist, so it is possible to find the sword again
weaknesses: Erases everyone's memories and then restarts everything without the existence of what you destroyed
This means you only have one shot at using this power, also makes it pointless to name the blade
If you killed someone's father, then their offspring will also have never existed

name: Metazoa Forming
description: You can create any animal-based life form. You can create wildlife based on present day animals, animals from the past, and animals from fiction stories.
summary: The ability to create animal life
strengths: Can create any type of animal-based ecosystem
weaknesses: Can cause catastrophic effects if the past, present, and fiction meet.

name: Dhampirism
description: A dhampir is normally a half-human half vampire crossbreed. With this power you have the powers of a vampire, but due to having half human blood, you don't have their traditional weaknesses. In other words, you have a really, really long lifespan, faster healing,  hypnotism, etc. Anything a vampire can do, you can do. Crosses, garlic, holy water, etc all affect you as much as they do a normal human being.
summary: The ability to the powers of vampires without the usual weaknesses
strengths: Powers of a vampire.
No vampiric weaknesses.
weaknesses: Can still be killed or die of old age.
Will often be mistaken for a vampire.

name: Animal Attraction
description: Someone with this power is treated as a friend by all nonhuman animals and will never be harmed by them. You cannot have both this and Animal Intimidation at the same time (this part cannot be removed by any power).
summary: The ability to have animals be so attracted to one that they treat one with reverence
strengths: Always have friends no matter where you go.
Someone chasing you? Not anymore! Run into a bear's den and the bear will guard you with its life.
If you're an animal lover.
weaknesses: Animals might decide to snuggle up to you when you don't want them to.
If you hate animals.

name: Yin Yang Touch
description: By making physical contact with matter (living or inanimate), you can use the forces of Yin and Yang on it. You can protect something from damage with yin power, and if it's a living thing you can heal it. If you use yang, you can make things take damage based on their composition (crumble, erode, rust, etc.), and if it's a living thing you can make it get sick. This is not the same as Yin and Yang Manipulation.
summary: The ability to harm or help anything by touching it.
strengths: Yin can protect things from harm temporarily, and if used on living things can even heal them
Yin can destroy things worse the longer you touch it; if used on living things, they get sick
Can be used on living and inanimate things
weaknesses: Not the same as Yin and Yang Manipulation (no blasts, behavior manipulation, etc.)
Requires touch
Sometimes you can't turn it off (one hand always produces yin, one always produces yang)

name: Forced Liquid Shift
description: With this power you can turn other people into a puddle of liquid. Once in puddle form the person is no longer sentient and you can trap them in a bottle or put them under a bright light and cause them to evaporate or something. When you're done messing with the person you can return them to their normal form (or not).
summary: The ability to other people into liquids
strengths: You can turn your enemies into liquid and then put them in a bottle or something
weaknesses: If you do decide to turn them back into human form they will probably try to hurt you

name: Rose Possession
description: This power channels your inner power to launch a rose at the target. The rose will envelope the target in thorny vines that have a special toxin that invades all bodily functions. Another rose will automatically appear in your hand, acting as a remote control for the target, thus making them your slave. Think of what you want the target to do with the second rose in hand, and it will happen.
summary: The ability to control living things with roses.
strengths: Can control your enemies.
Comes in any color you can imagine.
If you choose, the rose and the vines can grow internally so they are not seen.
weaknesses: Kills the target if not taken out.
The second rose is a rose none the less so if you want the target to live, take care of it.

name: Money Tree V4
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time and it grows ten thousand dollars (or the equivalent of ten thousand US dollars depending on where you are) a day in twenty dollar bills (or the equivalent). If the money tree gets destroyed or you destroy it, you can create a new one somewhere else. Also if you're attacked you can use the branches as weapons to defend yourself.
summary: The ability to produce a tree that creates even more money than the third version of Money Tree
strengths: You can create a tree that produces money
You can get up to ten thousand dollars a day
You can use the branches as weapons
weaknesses: You can only get up to ten thousand dollars a day
You can only create one at a time

name: Rise Of The 3 Headed Dragon
description: With this power you can turn into a three headed dragon. You can fly, are super strong and have sharp teeth in all three of your heads. One of your heads can shoot lightning bolts, the second one shoots poison that kills on contact and the third one shoots a green goo that melts through anything.
summary: The ability to turn into a 3 headed dragon
strengths: You can turn into the three headed dragon
You can shoot lightning, poison and green acid slime
weaknesses: You can be killed
You can't speak any human languages unless you have the power "Dragon Language"

name: Explosive Sight
description: This ability allows you, with a glance, to force something to explode or shatter. This works for anything solid, as it doesn't affect liquid or gas. This is unable to be controlled, so it has to be contained using a special mask, which allows control over the power, and you don't have to look like a freak, as it is a plastic sheet which can be simply placed over your face.
summary: The ability to explode things just by looking at them
strengths: Able to explode anything with a glance
You waste no effort using this power
The mask doesn't look awful, unless you are horrifically ugly
weaknesses: Uncontrollable without mask
Could accidentally kill others

name: Emerald Light
description: The rays of emerald light will heal and regenerate any living thing within the range of the power. The user will become nigh invulnerable while the power is being used. Once the power runs dry it will take a few hours to recharge.
summary: The ability to shine bright miraculous rays of emerald light
strengths: Super healing for user and surrounding allies
User becomes nigh invulnerable for a short time
Full regeneration of lost limbs and various body parts
weaknesses: After use it takes a few hours to recharge
Any cybernetic being may become full human again against their will
If the target of the power is dead they can't be brought back.

name: Beast Boy
description: You can turn into any animal, even mythical creatures, but only for at most 30 minutes at a time. If you are an animal for 14 minutes, then there is a 14 min. wait. So, if you're an animal for the whole 30 minutes, you would have to wait the whole 30 min. You can switch animals on the move.
summary: The ability to turn into any animal for at most 30 minutes
strengths: You can turn into any animal
Helpful in combat
You are able to switch animals on the move
weaknesses: There can be a long wait
Max time is 30 min.

name: Speech Empowerment
description: When someone with this power hears a speech or debate, he/she will be able to do what is said in that speech. You have to listen to the whole speech, understand it and the received powers vanish after a day. You can get multiple powers.
summary: The ability to gain powers from someone's speech
strengths: Get powers from speeches and debates
Can get multiple powers
weaknesses: Need to hear the speech/debate from beginning to end
Need to understand the speech/debate
Powers will last for a day

name: Sense Eliminator
description: With this power you can eliminate any four of a person's five senses (taste, sight, smell, touch, hearing). You can change which four you want to delete every time you use the power and you can restore the person's senses whenever you want.
summary: The ability to eliminate four of a person's five senses
strengths: You can delete any four of a person's five senses
You can restore the person's senses whenever you want
weaknesses: You cannot delete all five of a person's senses

name: Night Vision
description: No more fumbling for that light switch.  You can see perfectly in any level of darkness.  Even in the darkest of caves, seeing clearly is no problem.
summary: The ability to see clearly in the dark.
strengths: At night, you can still see everything
If you're afraid of the dark, you're cured.
If you live in the country, you can see deer.
weaknesses: Haunted houses might bore you
If you like to sleep in the dark, you'll still see everything

name: Delete This Selfless
description: First, you do your victory pose. Then, you start multiplying quickly. Moments later, your multiple duplicates rise right beside you and they begin to pummel the enemy from side to side in a blur as the opponent is beaten before a splat and a scream is heard.
summary: The ability to utterly multiply and pummel your opponent.
strengths: Could be a good thing when you are outnumbered.
weaknesses: Nothing bad here.

name: You're A Fictional Character
description: With this power you can turn anybody you want into a fictional character by saying their full name, the name of the character and then say "Poof! ". EX: "John Doe, Bugs Bunny, Poof! " To turn them back you say the name of the character, the persons name and then poof. EX: "Bugs Bunny, John Doe, Poof! "
summary: The ability to change people into fictional characters
strengths: You can turn people into fictional character
You don't even have to snap (snap didn't fit in the title so oh well)
weaknesses: Nothing really

name: Lock Pick Fingers
description: With this power you can turn all ten of your fingers into lock picks, which can open any lock ever made, except for those that are sealed by magic. When you've finished all your lock picking antics, you can turn your lock picks back into fingers.
summary: The ability to turn your fingers into lock picks
strengths: You can turn your fingers into lock picks and then back into normal fingers
You can open any lock except for those sealed with magic
weaknesses: You can't open locks that are sealed by magic

name: Detective's Clairsentience
description: You just have to touch the cadaver of a man or an animal to have a vision of the murderer, and to have a vague idea of who he is and where you can find him.
summary: The ability to know the murderer of a man or an animal by touching its cadaver.
strengths: Best. Detective. Ever.
Exhume the body of JFK, and finally have the answer.
weaknesses: If you don't want to solve crimes, the this power is of no use to you.
You only have a vague idea to where the murderer is.

name: Spec Swap
description: A person with spec swap can change the specialty of any other power they posses. An power can be changed to an Offensive Spec or a Defensive spec or to any number of different specialties. Heal Spec or Damage Spec could make a power heal or hurt rather than what it was normally intended to do. Specs could include ranged, accuracy, area of effect, or speed. A poison spec would not work unless poison was a part of the power originally.
summary: The ability to change the specialty of a power.
strengths: Swap specs to what is needed currently.
Make a power heal or damage instead of what it normally does.
Have multiple specs to switch between.
weaknesses: Using a spec, such as Offensive, would make the Defensive side of the power weaker.
Takes time to change specs, but training can reduce the time.
Can't add on to a power, such as specializing in poison, without it already existing in the power.

name: Black  Out
description: Whenever this power is activated you release a cloud of black smoke around you that is like a dark fog. Your eyes eventually evolve to see through this giving you an added bonus of night vision, but only after being exposed to it for a while. However that being the case your eyes will become extremely sensitive to light in general.
summary: The ability to emit a cloud of darkness around you like a smoke bomb
strengths: Ninja vanish
Can see in the dark
weaknesses: Light
Equals
Bad

name: Sleep Absorption
description: This allows you to suck the energy anyone gained from their sleep through touch. You can take as much energy as you want but no more than what they gained during their lifetime. If you take too much, the victim will get symptoms of sleep deprivation, but you will be able to stay awake, heal faster, enhance your memory and have an energy boost among other things. Symptoms include dizziness, hallucinations, increased blood pressure, immunity deficiency, loss of memory, dementia and even death.
summary: The ability to absorb the energy anyone gained during their sleep.
strengths: Gain all the benefits of sleeping without losing your time.
You will never feel the need to sleep again. You could do so much more and gain so much time.
You have control over the activation of this ability.
weaknesses: You could severely incapacitate or even kill someone with this ability.
You will never have dreams or nightmares. Daydreams will never beat that feeling of unconsciousness.
It will take a lot of sleep before that person recovers what they lost.

name: Crystal Growth
description: The crystal can be any kind of crystal. It will grow from any size to however large and any shape you want it to be at a rate of 27 cubic centimetres per second.
summary: The ability to cause crystals to grow by touching the crystals
strengths: Can always have weapons with you.
Crystals won't set off metal detectors.
weaknesses: It will take some time to get weapons and items of the needed size.
Always need to have some kind of cryystal around for this power to be effective.
Can't change the properties of the crystals except for size and shape with this power.

name: Anesthetize
description: You could stop feeling pain. Blind, deafen, numb people.  You may make someone not sense anything but pain. Like a numbing medicine, only all-around. Cut off a hindering sense, too.
summary: The ability to remove senses.
strengths: Can fight without the trouble of pain.
Make your enemies senseless and kill them with ease.
Make people know only pain.
weaknesses: When you anesthetize yourself, you won't know if a vital part has been hit.

name: Godparent Intuition
description: With this power, you can bestow superpowers on any infant. The power/s will slowly develop as the child grows up and they will become aware of their abilities when they are ready to handle them.
