You are free to choose who gets what superpower and you can put limitations on any of them. However, this is the only power you can possess and it doesn't work on yourself. You can bestow a superpower on an infant only before they reach the age of 1. They can have multiple powers as well.
summary: The ability to bestow any superpower on any infant
strengths: Help kids out by giving them superpowers
Be a sort of fairy-godmother/father
You are extremely powerful in your own way
weaknesses: You don't know if the child will grow up to use the power for evil
Might ruin a kid's life
You might give them the wrong power for their personality

name: Abomination Materialization
description: This ability allows the user create animals and beast that beyond the laws of nature. They are freaks, but they are powerful. The user doesn't get full control at first, but eventually they will.
summary: The ability to create horrific creature that do not fit in the natural order.
strengths: Make abominations
Eventually Control them
weaknesses: They will kill if you cannot control them.

name: Mercury Mimicry
description: A person with this power can turn into a mercury based form that can alter its phase and body physiology at will. In the mercury form, they have all the properties of mercury in the given form, as well as resistance to heat and a sort of heat detection capability. However, all the properties of mercury are copied, including toxicity and diamagnetism. I.e. can not touch people without poisoning them and is repelled by strong magnets. You can regenerate or grow larger by consuming mercury.
summary: The ability to turn into a mercury based form which can change its phase or shape at will
strengths: Gives you heat detection capability----think thermometers
Alterable form--Liquid, solid, and gas and alterable body physiology
You are dangerous to touch and bulletproof and heatproof and can regenerate by absorbing mercury
weaknesses: Too dangerous in mercury form ie can't grab someone to safety because of mercury poisoning
Can be called thermometer man as an insult
Affected by magnets

name: Song Of Healing
description: With this power, you have the ability to heal tormented souls with a song. Upon being healed and departing from this world, the soul leaves behind a mask. These masks allow you to transform into the mask's owner as they were just before death, granting you access to all of their abilities. People will recognize you as that person, but you will not have their memories or personality, so be careful. The masks can be taken off at any time and can be worn by anyone.
summary: The ability to heal tormented souls and turn them into masks.
strengths: Potentially unlimited mask transformations.
Perfect disguises.
Masks can be removed at any time or even given to other people.
weaknesses: You do not have memory of the mask owner's life.
People will believe that owner of the mask is dead, so be careful.
This power does not allow you to see, locate, or communicate with tortured souls.

name: Swarm Transformation
description: At will, you can transform yourself into a swarm of flying, sting insects. You now control them all completely as a hive mind. You can reform only when the majority of the swarm is gathered together and shapes a humanoid form. If any insects are killed, then upon reforming the corresponding mass will be missing from your body, such as nails and hair, though you will quickly regenerate. If too many bugs are killed, you are killed too. A few bugs can be released at will to spy.
summary: The ability to fragment into a swarm of insects
strengths: You can easily spy on others
It is pretty difficult to kill a massive swarm of flying insects
In a dense humanoid form of flies, you can lift and move objects
weaknesses: Your insects are vulnerable to insect poison, fire, being eaten, etc.
You leave behind any clothes you were wearing, so you reform nude
Experiencing dying as a bug could traumatise you

name: External Power Evolution
description: With this power, you can touch a person and evolve it. This works by making the power one step better and then removing the old copy. This also refreshes it from any side effects not related to the power itself and restores it to it's normal condition, including cleansing it of the Condition Change powers. For example, if you used this on Regeneration, the subject may experience a faster healing factor and removal of pain. Unfortunately, this only works for normally acquired powers.
summary: The ability to improve another's power by stealing them.
strengths: Improve the powers of allies.
Gain as many powers as you want.
Help an ally who is struggling under the effects of a Condition Change power.
weaknesses: Requires touch.
Each user can only use this once on each of a target's powers.
Con Negation does not work for this.

name: Animal Shift V2
description: With this power you can turn humans into any kind of animal. You can turn the person you turned into an animal into other animals as well and then back into a human when you're done. This power only works on humans not animals that were always animals.
summary: The ability to turn humans into any kind of animal
strengths: You can turn humans into any kind of animal
weaknesses: This power only works on humans not animals or aliens

name: Treant
description: Treants are mythological humanoid trees. With this power you can control any foreign Treants that you may find and have them serve you. You can also create Treants from the trees around you. You can also turn yourself into a Treant, causing your skin to turn into wood and you to grow larger (and allowing you to communicate with plants).
summary: The ability to have control over and manipulate Treants.
strengths: Control any Treants that are around you.
Create your own Treants from the trees around you.
Become a Treant yourself and gain their enhanced attributes.
weaknesses: Weakens when away from nature.
Foreign Treants are harder to control.
You are subject to the weaknesses that come with being part tree.

name: Vine Manipulation
description: Users can create, shape and manipulate vines. The vines are created only under the attendance of trees(i mean big trees like Banyan Tree). For offense, the user can strangle the enemy and for defense they can move from one place to another using good number of vines.
summary: The ability to create vines in trees and control them
strengths: The power has both offensive and defensive powers
You will be in great advantage if u are surrounded by trees
User can create vines on trees and manipulate them
weaknesses: The number of vines the user can create is limited
Users are powerless in areas without trees
Great disadvantage against fire and ice users.

name: Retrocognition
description: Many great mysteries in history are unsolved. A Retrocognitive can see visions of the past---anywhere from 900 million years ago to 1 minute ago. This may seem worthless. However, the user usually has amazing control over this, letting them see what other people have done, what happened in specific rooms, or even embarassing events from a person's life.
summary: The ability to induce visions of the past
strengths: Can see what other people have done
Can see what happened in military rooms
Seeing what she was really doing that one time
weaknesses: Cannot see what they're doing
Must have a good idea of what you're looking for
Not liking what you see

name: Necroplasmic Matter Manipulati
description: With this ability, you can control any kind of matter that is dead (ie. Was previously alive). Whether it be human, animal, plant, or anything else in between, you can use said matter and mold it together into different shapes and forms to your will. Think the Green Lantern, but with dead matter.
summary: The ability to manipulate and mold dead matter
strengths: A virtually endless supply of matter to mold
Limited only by your imagination
weaknesses: Matter will rot and deteriorate at varying degrees
May not smell so great sometimes, either

name: Trackway Perception
description: This power enables you to visually see what has been touched by anything or anyone in the form of glowing traces (footprints, handprints, pawprints,...) on any solid surface they made contact with. The more recent the trace is, the clearer it is. The user of this ability knows instinctively which traces belong to the same entity, effectively distinguishing all the trackways, but one won't know exactly who or what left them and has to discover it oneself.
summary: The ability to see the traces left by any animal, object or human on any surface
strengths: You can easily trace anyone or anything by following.
Discover what has been manipulated and find the culprit.
weaknesses: Nope, gases or liquids are not solid surfaces.

name: Chromaturgy
description: Luxin can take on many different shades from the electromagnetic spectrum, and each color has its own unique properties. People who use Luxin are called Drafters, and most Drafters can only cast a single color of Luxin. More powerful Drafters known as Bichromes can use two colors of Luxin, and people who can use three or more colors are known as Polychromes. Superchromats have extremely acute vision when it come to colors. The inverse of those who are colorblind, they can see minute differences.
summary: The ability to harness light and create a substance from it, called Luxin.
strengths: Luxin can be used to create literally anything, from swords, to shields, to fireballs.
Limitless amounts of Luxin, as it comes from colored light.
You get cool colored shapes in your iris.
weaknesses: Can only draft more than 1 color if you're a bi or polychrome
Can only draft a limited number of times in your life.
If you draft too much in your lifetime, you'll go insane.

name: Animalizing
description: This ability allows you to change other people into animal/human hybrids. You get to choose what animal the hybrid will be and if it will have two or four legs. When you activate this power, the person grows fur or scales just like the animal they are turning into, then (if you chose four legs) extra legs and animal body parts (snout, claws, etc.) that are the right size for the body. The change will always be uncomfortable for the person undergoing it, and the change is permanent.
summary: The ability to change people into animal/human hybrids
strengths: Superheroes keep their powers when you use it on them
Turn supervillains into little mice
Mess with people
weaknesses: It's permanent and you might regret it.
If you use it on yourself, you lose the power
Supervillains keep their powers when you use it on them

name: Which Blade
description: Every time you take out this weapon, it is different. From the lameness of a pencil to the power of Excalibur, this weapon is totally unpredictable. You can get any weapon with a blade or point, so no spoons or guns, unless they have a machete on them. If your sword breaks, you can put the handle in the sheath and it will come out as a new sword, one that hasn't been broken. If your sheath breaks, then it is stuck as is. If you make a new one, it won't change the blade.
summary: The ability to wield a sword that changes each time you unsheathe it.
strengths: Any sharp weapon
Chance of mythical/legendary swords
If your sword breaks, you can put the handle in the sheath and it will come out as a new sword.
weaknesses: No way to predict or control what sword you get
Chance of pencils, pens, arrowheads or other useless ones
If your sheath breaks, then it is stuck as is. If you make a new one, it won't change the blade.

name: Existential Frequency Shifting
description: This power allows you to tune into someone's existential frequency. By doing so, that person becomes the only one who can see, hear, or touch you, or more generally interact with you -- anybody else who doesn't match that frequency will just phase through you, won't even notice you and won't have any effect on you. That person is also the only one you can interact with. So, from your point of view, you are in a copy of the real world but devoid of population, except for you and that person.
summary: The ability to target someone so that person is the only one who can interact with you.
strengths: Your frequency can be changed randomly. It'll have a slight chance to match someone's in the world.
Anyone who doesn't match your frequency can't do anything to you, since you don't "exist" to them.
They can't even detect you or cancel your power.
weaknesses: You can only interact with the person (or people, in rare cases) who matches your new frequency.
You can feel very lonely, seeing the world as an empty place.
To cancel it, you must match the universal frequency. If you don't realize it, it can mean trouble.

name: The Giving Tree
description: When you use this power, a seed or seeds will appear in your hands. The seeds will have a small image of what it will make. When you plant the seeds they will grow unnaturaly fast, fully grown in less the five minutes. You can even control what its full size is. You can choose what they bear. It can be anything from oranges to money to machine guns.
summary: The ability to create seeds for any sort of tree
strengths: Can create almost anything
Trees are cool
weaknesses: Trees can be chopped down
Can create ALMOST anything

name: Drain Vision
description: With this power, you can fire pink-colored rays from your eyes at the opponent. These rays drain their life entirely to replenish your health with frightening results – the enemy will spend the rest of their life living as a shriveld up old coot.
summary: The ability to fire rays from your eyes that will drain someone's life force.
strengths: Could look young and healthy again.
weaknesses: Draining your opponent can take up to 20 minutes

name: Enhanced Senses
description: With this power, you would see, hear, smell, taste, and touch with more clarity, accuracy, and detail than usual.
summary: The ability to have better senses
strengths: Better senses
weaknesses: Bad smells and tastes, bright lights, loud noises

name: Induced Shapeshifting
description: Shapeshifting is a great power, but it has the limitation of only affecting you. With this power, you are able to make others shapeshift by touching them. If you die or lose this power, they will revert. You may choose whether they can change between their forms at will or not.
summary: The ability to make other people shapeshift.
strengths: Make others more attractive to you.
Heal others, including reversing age.
Help your friends/allies in acts of infiltration.
weaknesses: Cannot use it on yourself.
Requires touch.
Consciousness and power are always retained.

name: Death
description: This power enables you to kill anything in the world, from people to animals to plants to even molecules. This power is deadly and is a great offensive power. Anyone who has this power could be unstoppable. The affects of this power vary on what you use it on, but everything will die in its own way. This power is the most deadly of all and the only way that you can stop it is to kill the user, and that won't be as easy as it sounds.
summary: The ability to kill anyone or anything with the wave of a hand, the blink of an eye or a tilt of the head.
strengths: Can kill anything.
Great offensive use.
You are pretty much unstoppable.
weaknesses: May be too powerful for some.

name: Umbrium (Deadly Metal)
description: Umbrium can harm shadows and the effect of harming a shadow is that the effect rebounds back onto the shadow's owner. Ex. Cut the arm off the shadow and the arm will fall off the person. High-level users of this power can manipulate umbrium into any shape they choose while low-level users can only make rough shapes.
summary: The ability to create and control a jet-black metal that can harm shadows and darkness
strengths: Umbrium can be dangerous to your enemy if you can get to their shadow.
weaknesses: Do not accidentally harm your own shadow with Umbrium. EVER.
Umbrium can still be blocked with ordinary objects.
Umbrium can only harm things by cutting shadows.

name: Lifestyle Effect Persistence
description: Ever had one day when you did god things, like eat healthily? With this ability, you can record such a day and continue experiencing the effects after resuming your old lifestyle.
summary: The ability to experience the effects of continually living the lifestyle of one day.
strengths: Studying is easier; while you may not acquire new knowledge, you do remember it.
Living healthily is easy; just record on a day of healthy living.
The things that are bad for you can now be enjoyed.
weaknesses: Can only live the benefits of one day's lifestyle at a time.
You experience the bad as well.
You must record while living that day.

name: Reaper's Contract
description: When you are present when a person is about to die, you enter into a separate dimension with the person where you can offer them the chance to become your slave in exchange for them being completely healed. You do not have to be honest while making the deal. You can have as many slaves as possible, but each person can only make the deal once.
summary: The ability to keep somebody from dying in exchange for them becoming your slave.
strengths: Save people from death.
Have slaves to do your work.
Have all the knowledge and skills of the slaves at your disposal.
weaknesses: You will appear evil for having slaves.
May not have many slaves due to lack of deaths.
Person must willingly agree.

name: Transformation To Summoning
description: You will be able to turn a power in which you transform into something, into a power where you summon it. Like if you are able to shapeshift into a vehicle, you would be able to summon a vehicle. This effect can be reversed.
summary: The ability to change a transforming power into a summoning one.
strengths: If you are able to transform into many things.
weaknesses: They may not listen.
You may want to transform into them.

name: Vita Visum
description: With this power, you can activate a 'mode' of vision that enables you to see a human being's current life span. You can increase or decrease this number, as if setting a clock. You cannot drop the number precisely to zero. You are able to detect any alterations to the number. The countdown falls by its own unit of time, and can vary from person to person. The number of changes you can make is limited for a period of time due to potential strain.
summary: The ability to see and control the life span of others.
strengths: Control over how long a person has to live
Easier personal time management with those who matter.
weaknesses: Cannot determine the exact method by which someone is destined to die.
No control over the lifespan if simply looking at a photograph - the image must be fresh.
Not immune to effects; still vulnerable to attack and eye strain/damage when activated.

name: Pheromone Production
description: A pheromone is a chemical that produces a physiological response when smelled. A person with Pheromone Production can pump out huge amounts of state-influencing pheromones, making anyone who sniffs them miserable, delirious with happiness, enraged, alert, drowsy, or any other powerful emotion or state. This ability's strength depends on the user's nutrition and the recipient's sense of smell.
summary: The ability to produce state-changing pheromones
strengths: Can be used on a massive scale
Make an entire room fall asleep and then leave
Make anyone feel sad, happy, sleepy, in love etc.
weaknesses: Can run out of pheromone
Strong winds can blow the pheromone away
People with colds

name: Acausality Curse
description: This power turns the causal timeline of someone's life into an acausal one, meaning A to B to C... Y to Z can become Z to L to G to A... This power has limits. When your victim is unrecognizable at some point in the past, your power cuts off. Shape shifters are unaffected. Time travelers can just travel to the past before you affected them. Reality changers can ignore this power. However, those who can be affected by this power will be continually confused and helpless.
summary: The ability to scramble and rearrange the moments of a person's life
strengths: Immortals who can't time travel, shape shift or change reality. Good Luck to them.
Make an immortal wish he were dead.
weaknesses: Any power that can restore causal existence to your victim.
May drive a victim crazy.
You don't know how many years back in the past you can affect a mortal victim.

name: Shadow Of The Wolf
description: Shadowulf's name inspired this, so give him some credit. Using this you can use the Shadow of the Wolf. Doing so gives you a wolf's speed, strength and ferocity. Some side effects include your hair growing at a faster rate, eating raw meat, and wanting people to scratch your stomach.
summary: The ability to use the Shadow of the Wolf.
strengths: Boost of speed.
Ferocious strength.
weaknesses: Craving for raw meat.
Hair grows at a faster rate.

name: Blindsight (Blind Sight)
description: Also called Blind Sight, Blind Sense or Sightless Sight, this is the power to see without truly seeing. One can do this one of three ways. 1) the user can see the shapes of objects and subjects as a psionic outline rather than the true shape; 2)the user's eyes simply acts as a mode of awareness and points subconsciously in the direction of obstacles, so the user looks like he can see; 3) the user's sight capacity is inverted (when his eyes are closed he can see, but when they're open he's blind)
summary: The ability to use numerous methods to see without truly seeing
strengths: Weird ways of being able to see catch people off guard
Still see perfectly
May be accompanied by some other visual aspect (telescopic, infrared, lightless, ultraviolet, etc. )
weaknesses: Immature people might mess with you, cause they think you're blind (which you technically are)
The second variation requires some getting used to
The third variation may get confusing IF you can't turn it off (sleeping would be hard)

name: Weakness Inducing
description: With this power, you can give your target a weakness. It works on everything: humans, animals, plants, objects etc. They can be as complex or simple as you want, but one at a time. You can change the weakness and give multiple things/persons the same weakness. The effects will wear off when they leave your range (10 miles).
summary: The ability to give the target a weakness.
strengths: Give anything a weakness
you can change the weakness
You can give multiple things/persons the same weakness
weaknesses: Can only give someone/something one weakness
Weakness will fade when you're out of range

name: Great Impersonator
description: You can disguise yourself perfectly to look like someone else, but they have to be human. You even sound & act like that person. You can look like a celebrity to world leaders to whomever else. Downside is you only know the known facts about that person, not their personal knowledge.
summary: The ability to become a perfect look-alike
strengths: Become famous
Win look-alike contests
weaknesses: Crazed fans will follow you if you disguise yourself as a celebrity
You only know the facts about the person, not there personal knowledge

name: Pain Suck
description: Pretty simple. You can take out pain and injuries from someone, store them inside you (you don't feel anything) and when you are attacked, you can inflict the pain and injuries on your foe.
summary: The ability to take people's pain and inflict it on others
strengths: Can heal others
weaknesses: Cannot heal self

name: Lycanokinesis
description:
Lycanothropy Lycanthropic Psychokinesis. "Shift" the characteristic of transformation into a different animal. Accelerate to start (ex. Werewolf before a full moon) or speed up a shift. Cancel cancel or stop a shift. Reversal reverse or temporarily undo a shift
Transfer steal a shift from one person and give it to someone else including yourself; you can only hold one shift at a time (no werecat ear with werewolf nose)and must transfer back 100% or else you get perma-shifted (non-manipulatabe
summary: The ability to manipulate "shifts" (lycanthropy) by acceleration, canceling, reversal, or even transferring
strengths: You can shapeshift or cause others to shapeshift
You can transfer entire shifts or just parts like eyes or claws of the shift
Keep a werewolf from transforming at full moon or accelerate it so they transform earlier
weaknesses: You need someone that can change into something else to manipulate a shift
You can only hold onto one shift transformation if you transfer one to yourself
If transfering a shift from yourself back to the source you need to make sure to transfer it 100% ,q

name: Synchronous Event Inducement
description: The user will have the ability to make anything happen at the same time and location. An example would be if the user saw one man about to fall and saw crate of poisonous scorpions about to be opened in a different location. The user can make it that both these events happen all together in the same spot in a perfect, synchronized fashion. Now the man falls in an opened crate of scorpions. A cruel scenario, but an example none the less.
summary: The ability to cause two or more things to happen at the same place and time.
strengths: Create instant chaos
Make things happen faster
With training, bring events from different realities and timelines to one place.
weaknesses: Events that are brought from different realities and timeline will disappear.

name: Undead Shapeshifting
description: One with this ability has much potential to discover. They can assume the form of a zombie (with powers like a life sense and anatomical automatism), or a mummy (with powers like sand control, prehensile bandages), a vampire (with enhanced strength, speed, etc. And thirst for blood), a lich (with the power to summon other undead) or even a ghost (with the powers included in imperceptibility, as well as the ability to levitate, possess foes and manifest your presence in spooky ways).
summary: The ability to assume the form and abilities of any type of undead at all
strengths: All undead have reduced needs (no need to eat, sleep or breathe, except zombies and vampires)
Immunity to psionics, radiation, poison, disease, sonic attacks and sleep inducing
Shapeshift into the zombie version of various animals as well
weaknesses: Necromantic effects
Holy symbols, garlic and holy water when in vampire form (and vulnerability to sunlight until fed)
Tends to scare folks (think torches and pitchforks)

name: Face Carver
description: By carving eyes on an object, you can give that object the gift of sight. By carving a nose or nostrils on an object, you can give that object the gift of smell. By carving a mouth on an object, you can give that object the gift of speech. By carving ears on an object, you can give that object the gift of hearing. It only works on objects, not on plants, animals or human beings, dead or alive, unless they are processed into objects.
summary: The ability to make objects see, hear, smell or talk by carving eyes, ears, a nose or a mouth, respectively.
strengths: You can create sentient pumpkins.
You can discuss with everyday objects.
You can make objects spy on people undetected.
weaknesses: It's not a guarantee that objects will be loyal to you.
Despite having a mouth, they can't eat, because they don't have a butthole to defecate.
You can only carve the main organs present on a human face.
tags: was edited as it was just a unimaginative combination of two unrelated powers

name: Hemokinesis
description: The user can detect and manipulate anything in his/her circulatory system. One also have a very active bloodstream that destroys any blood-travelling pathogen, cardiotoxin or blood-attacking nanites entering its area. It's also possible to alter/stop the flow of blood, clotting, heartbeat, and white count; both their own blood as well as other people's. Blood manipulators can also use theirs and others' blood to form weapons, such as whips, needles, blades and the like.
summary: The ability to control blood and have an active bloodstream
strengths: Bleeding is not a problem
Can create clots to cripple or kill with a touch
Blood weapons.
weaknesses: Difficult to master

name: Vocal Mimicry
description: Sound effects men have nothing on a Vocal Mimic. Using their voice, they can reproduce sounds with eerie accuracy, from a gunshot to another person's voice to a flock of birds taking off. The user must have at least heard the sound once, and their vocal cords have the same limits as anyone else's.
summary: The ability to mimic sounds with extreme mimicry
strengths: Can mimic voices
Anything from a gunshot to flock of birds taking off
Mimicking public officals on the phone
weaknesses: Must have heard it at least once
Accuracy depends on how well you remember it
Vocal cords have same physical limits

name: Forced Shared Healing
description: Whenever a living being is healing from an injury or an illness, you can steal a portion of their regeneration capacity to heal yourself. You are not copying their healing mechanism; you are just taking some of the energy involved. In essence, you are slowing down their progress in repairing a wound or curing an illness. It works whether the healing process is natural or supernatural. It also works if the targeted organism is fighting against an illness but isn't getting better anyway.
summary: The ability to heal by channeling a portion of someone else's healing process.
strengths: You can heal extremely fast if you use this on someone with a regeneration or a resurrection power.
You can delay instantaneous healing abilities or cause them to only heal gradually.
With experience, you can channel as much as 78% of someone's healing capacity.
weaknesses: Doesn't work on invulnerable beings since they can't be injured and, therefore, don't need to heal.
It works in cases of immunity to a disease, but you won't heal much as they aren't really ill.
It doesn't work on a healthy and sane person, nor on someone who can't fight against their disease.

name: Missile Launcher Arms
description: With this power you can turn both of your arms into small missile launchers. You can launch an unlimited amount of missiles from both of your arms.
summary: The ability to turn your arms into small missile launchers
strengths: You can turn your arms into missile launchers
You have an unlimited amount of missiles
weaknesses: Any damage sustained in missile launcher mode is transferred over to arm mode

name: Golden Apples
description: In Norse mythology, Idun was the goddess who safeguarded the Golden Apples.  One bite from this fruit and the gods would maintain their immortality and power.  If a mere mortal ate this, they would become a god.  The trade-off is that it must be eaten once a year, otherwise you will grow old and die!
summary: The ability to generate the enchanted food of the Norse Gods.
strengths: Generate the ultimate elixir
Become superstrong, invulnerable, and eternally young!
Can give this power to others
weaknesses: Must eat once a year
The wrong person may eat the apple
Can start Armageddon or make people fear you (or both)

name: Demonic Weaponry: Scar
description: Scar is one of the more destructive Demonic Weapons. It resembles a butchers knife, but with no hilt. It is pure metal, with silk wrapped around where the hilt should be. It is said anything it touches will stop growing, and die. If you were to cut a man's wrist with it, even just a shallow cut, where it cut would become nothing but dead cells. There are few who meet this blade and live to spread the tales of it.
summary: The ability to use the demonic weapon Scar.
strengths: Powerful knife.
Works on plants, animals, and humans: anything that lives.
Appears like a normal butcher's knife
weaknesses: Useless on nonliving things, such as puppets or powers.
Corrupts the soul; need a power to become aware of this.

name: Fear Sight
description: With this superpower, you can shift into a persons biggest fear. You don't get any abilities of the person's biggest fear, and you can only look like the persons fear for an hour. If you look into multiple people's eyes, they will each see you as there own greatest fear.
summary: The ability to change into a person's biggest fear by looking into their eyes.
strengths: The person you use this on could become scared and flee.
You can use this on multiple people.
weaknesses: You can only look like a person's fear for an hour at a time.
You do not gain any abilities of that person's fear.
If the person has no fear, there will be no affect.

name: Appearance Switcher
description: You may change the piece(s) of clothing you have on at the time to anything you have seen or heard about.
summary: The ability to change the article of clothing you have on.
strengths: Never have to buy clothes.
FREE CLOTHES!
weaknesses: You can only change the clothes you are wearing.
Have to have seen or heard about them.

name: Detrital Affinity
description:
You have moderate kinetic control over decaying leaves, animals, wood, feces, rusted metals, and the like, and dust; more indistinguishable from original form for more precise control. Dust from asphalt, concrete, or other inviolable materials is out of the scope of control. Although, you can advance deterioration visibly in any non-living or dead objects with concentration and time. 
You also have a form of touch-initiated claircognizance with waste. (eg Dried blood is good for tracking. )
summary: The ability to advance and command decayed or decaying materials and dust.
strengths: Drive away unwanted people with waves of trash, corpses, and whatnots.
Be a forensic expert.
Clean your house instantly in all those hard-to-reach places!
weaknesses: It's hard to avoid becoming terribly filthy.
Dust can't hurt your enemies.
Groping gross things might be too much to get what you want to know.

name: Reality Shift Comic Style
description: Every wanted to be like super man on a comic page? Well now you can! This power lets to user turn the world around them into a comic 2D platform. First person and third person views make it look like a real comic and people talk using word bubbles like in the comics. This means to user will have to go into third person view to read what people are saying.
summary: The ability to make the world around you look like a comic strip
strengths: Finally live in a comic
The user can make the story and change it around if they want
weaknesses: Have to read others words
May take some time gettin guse to seeing yourself from a distance

name: Necrokinesis
description: Necrokinesis is a torture power that allows you to cause people, plants or animal flesh to rot even though they are alive. This power however cannot kill anyone. It is only used for torture and takes what would seem like forever to completely rot someone's body and, if they can't die from this, then why bother trying to go that far in the torment; you have other things to do.
summary: The ability to cause people, plants, or animals to decay while they are STILL alive.
strengths: You can cause another person's flesh to rot right off their bones
It's one of the most gruesome of torture
The rotten-flesh cannot heal (exception of superhealing)
weaknesses: It's a torture power, so it cannot ever kill someone (even if 80% of their body has decomposed)
At first, the decaying is fast, but as time passes, it slows down more and more and more
Putrification stinks (carry nose plugs at all times)

name: Spawn
description: In order for this power to work, you must shed at least one drop of blood. From that blood, an exact copy of you is made. Same age, intelligence etc. You can multiply infinitely. No one is for for sure who is the original. You can drain yourself of blood & from that can spawn who knows how many of yourself. The negative is you can't re-absorb your copies, meaning whatever skills they learned you won't have.
summary: The ability to create & multiply yourself
strengths: Multiply yourself infinitely
weaknesses: Must shed blood to make a copy
Can't absorb your copies

name: Myth Weapon: Grimpage Eclair
description: The user gains the power to summon the Grimpage Eclair, a weapon formed into the shape of a rod. The small rod doesn't seem like much, but it does pack quite a punch, able to break holes in solid stone, but when the user is in danger, it transforms, this weapon grows another four feet, the tip becoming jagged before a blade rips from the sides of the top, a double bladed dark pink Scythe, truly a wicked weapon to demolish one's foes with. It has a ''sister'' weapon, but that's another story.
summary: The ability to summon the Grimpage Eclair, a weapon said to cut the very bonds of life.
strengths: Despite the small, two feet size of it in the weapon's first form, it still packs a wallop.
In it's transformed state, it is more than capable of cleaving though foes like butter.
With it's bloody and almost magical roots, it is able to cut the flesh, with the soul.
weaknesses: With it's two foot range, unless the user moves in close, it's not going to be able to hit.
The second form only comes out when the user is in real danger, the user can't fake it.
In it's second form, the blades are extremely sharp, the user must be careful not to harm themself.

name: Farsight
description: Did you ever want to see what your best friend is doing? With this power you can!
summary: The ability to see things from far away
strengths: See what other people are doing
Spy on your crush
See where your foes are
weaknesses: None

name: Myth Power: Nectar And Ambrosia
description: Nectar (Nektar) and Ambrosia, in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the respective Food and Drink of the Gods, of the same names. As such, channeling them allows one to turn normal food into delicious Ambrosia (which heals, cleans wounds and has all vital nutrients needed for any species--mortal or immortal--to survive), by touch. In addition, one can turn normal drink into succulent Nectar (which preserves age and enhances physical beauty), by touch. One can even negate said effects at will.
summary: The ability to channel Nectar and Ambrosia's command over the essence of the food and drink of the gods
strengths: Eat the divine delicacies of the Olympians, which taste heavenly (and have rejuvenating properties)
Eaten together, they can bestow temporary immortality (preventing aging, permanent injury and death)
One can turn off the immortalizing effects at will (if a foe gets his hands on it)
weaknesses: Nectar and Ambrosia must BOTH be ingested to achieve the effect of immortality (NCN)
Nectar-and-Ambrosia-Bestowed Immortality only lasts for as long as the power is active (NCN)
MythPower: Hebe's Blessing and MythPower: Ganymede's Gain allow negation of this ability (NCN)

name: Animal Merging
description: You can merge your biology with any one animal & become an animal/humanoid hybrid. You will take on the animal's characteristics. It only lasts for an hour & your animal side might start to take over.
summary: The ability to merge with any animal
strengths: Merge with any animal
Take on their characteristics
weaknesses: Only lasts for a hour
Animal side might take over

name: Frieza Forms
description: With this power, as your power grows, you are able to turn into different forms, created by your imagination.
summary: The ability to be able to become a different form as your power grows.
strengths: Create different forms.
weaknesses: Other than a different look, it is nothing different.
No real combat use.......

name: Soul Animorphic Hidden Power
description: This ability unlocks the seal that keeps your soul from unleashing those unknown abilities you have been holding onto and have been unable to use. These abilities are limited and based off of your personality and feelings.
summary: The ability to unleash your inner soul's animal abilities
strengths: Have the enhanced abilities of the animal you resemble the most
Ability to heal over time
Allows your stamina to be so enhanced you can fight for a week
weaknesses: Activates only when in a desperate situation
May have unknown side effects such as memory loss
May become uncontrollable and those around that you care for may get hurt

name: Animal Splicer
description: This ability takes two or more animals and combine their DNA to make a new organism. Anything is possible, just be creative. Once this creature is created, it listens to any command you say.
summary: The ability to take two or more animals and combine them into one organism, giving you control over it.
strengths: Transportation is easy
It requires no tools in doing this, just your hands
You have an army of creatures to do your bidding
weaknesses: If no animal is in sight then this power is not activated

name: Synesthetic Inundation
description: One with this ability should use it carefully. Also called Synesthetic Overload, it allows the listener to hear the sound the user produces, but also makes them perceive it as visible light. In effect, when the user screams, he not only produces loud (not sonic, but loud) sound, he also produces blindingly-bright light in the foe's sight range. This effect can often be turned off at will.
summary: The ability to induce a synesthetic overload of the senses
strengths: Your scream can be a weapon without it being sonic in capacity
Induce synesthesia in others, ONLY for the purpose of them being blinded by your voice
Can be turned off at will
weaknesses: If the power CAN'T be turned off at will, makes conversation VERY awkward
Only affects beings that can hear
Covering the ears protects one from this ability, but also blinds them until power is turned off

name: Animal Shift
description: With this power you can turn one animals into another one, you can turn cows into zebras, dogs into cats etc. You can change the species of a single animal as many times as you want. You cannot use this power on humans - super or not - or aliens.
summary: The ability to turn animals into other animals
strengths: You can change the species of animals
weaknesses: This power has no effect on humans, aliens or superhumans

name: Living Toys
description: With this power, you can bring any of your toys to life (including ones that don't have faces or human/animal characteristics, such as Slinkys, toy cars, stuffed animal hot dogs etc. ) Once alive, however, the toys are not under your control but you can turn them back to normal toys when you're done with them. This power only affects toys that are owned by you, not just any toy you see.
summary: The ability to bring your toys to life
strengths: You can bring your toys to life.
weaknesses: They are not under your control.
The toy has to be owned by you.

name: Plant Speak
description: You can communicate with plants with this powers. That includes bushes, trees etc. You can find out what happened somewhere of which only the plants were witness.
summary: The ability to communicate with plants.
strengths: Talk to plants.
weaknesses: They might talk too much and affect your sanity

name: Thunder Clapper
description: With this power you can make deafening thunder whenever you clap your hands. You cannot turn this power off so it happens every time you clap your hands. The thunder can be heard by everybody in a hundred mile radius.
summary: The ability to make thunder by clapping
strengths: You can cause deafening thunder to sound whenever you clap your hands
The thunder can be heard by everybody in a hundred mile radius
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power off
If you don't have hands this power is useless

name: Siren's Signal
description: This ability allows you to emit a sound that can only be heard by a person of your choosing. This sound sounds like a siren song and calls the person to your location. No matter where in the world the person is, they will be inexplicably drawn to you.
summary: The ability to call any person to your location by emmiting a sound only they can hear
strengths: Find anyone world-wide
weaknesses: Might take awhile for the person to reach you
Might take a dangerous route to reach you
Doesn't hypnotize people, just attracts them

name: Soul Exchange
description: This is a slighty dark power, but ultimatly not an evil one. It allows the user to give someone almost anything they want, in exchange for their soul. After they die, they will become your servant for as long as you have their soul. So, if they died a year after you made the deal, then they must serve you for a year after they die. You will have total power over them, even controlling their shape. After their service is paid, they will go on to the afterlife.
summary: The ability to make soul-exchanges
strengths: Granting the wishes of many people, for a fair price.
This power won't affect the target's judgement in the afterlife.
weaknesses: It seems like an unholy power
Contact is necessary to make the deal

name: Living Insect Repellant
description: With this ability, you can repel all insects (even if they're supersized). You repel blood sucking insects especially well. Insects hate the way you smell, but no human or animal can perceive the smell. You can repel fleas. You can not repel arachnids or leeches unless you practice a lot. Mosquitos will stay away from you.
summary: The ability to repel all insects (even supersized ones).
strengths: You can repel all insects, even supersized ones.
You don't smell any different to people or animals.
You will never have an insect bite again.
weaknesses: Might take decades of practice before you repel arachnids and/or leeches.

name: Money Tree V2
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time and it grows one thousand dollars (or the equivalent of one thousand US dollars depending on where you are) a day in five dollar bills (or the equivalent). If the money tree gets destroyed or you destroy it, you can create a new one somewhere else.
summary: The ability to make a tree that produces more money
strengths: You can cause a money tree to sprout out of the ground
You can get up to one thousand dollars a day
weaknesses: You only get up to one thousand dollars a day
You can only have one tree at a time
People will always be trying to steal it from you

name: Touch Of Pain
description: This sounds lame at first, but you can poke the exact place in the brain that kills.  You can temporarily stop people's hearts.  You can cause headaches, or pains anywhere.
summary: The ability to poke/touch/push/etc someone anywhere - even internally.
strengths: You can cause pain anywhere in your oponent.
You can kill your oponent instantly.
You can neutralise your oponent.
weaknesses: One poke per person per day.
More than one poke and the energy drain is too much.

name: Call Of The Wild
description: When the chips are down, you can use this power to call every single animal in a 10-mile radius to aid you in combat, as long as the animal wouldn't die leaving its habitat, for example a fish, it would come to you as quickly as possible. You would also be able to give them commands and they will understand you.
summary: The ability to call for help to every single animal in the surrounding area
strengths: Get help from a lot of animals
Animals are strong
weaknesses: Maybe there isn't a lot of animals nearby
Maybe they're all weak

name: Ebony Whip
description: It may look like a regular whip, except for the tones of nanoliquid. Whenever you use it, it assumes features which seem to be revolving around both shadow and phantom. With the phantom powers, you are able to remove and control an opponent's powers using a ghastly force by wrapping them around it, and in shadow form, you are able to change her size and shape at will, forming tentacles, and hardening it to punish foes and break through anything.
summary: The ability to morph it and use it to punish your foes from upclose or afar.
strengths: Can fire medium-sized black spikes from the whip.
Could wrap your enemy around your whip, then spin until the victim's bones fly out of their body.
weaknesses: It will not work against water/ice-type opponents.

name: 3rd Person Vision
description: With this ability you can view yourself as if from a third person perspective. You will still be able to move normally, but see everything from a different perspective. You will see yourself as if from a bystanders point of view and can change where you are looking from (i. E. Height, angle, zoom).
summary: The ability to view yourself from a 3rd person point of view
strengths: Be able to see everything around you
Can still move normally
weaknesses: Coordination is slightly impaired, until your vision return's to normal

name: Myth Exchange
description: With this power you have the ability to change the attributes or aspects of any mythological or fictional creature with that of another mythological or fictional creature. Such as making zombies only be hurt by silver while werewolfs will hunger for brains. Also Zeus could be made master of the seas while Hades could be made to suck blood like a vampire. You can change one creature without having to affect any similar creature or creature you got the attribute from.
summary: The ability to switch the attributes and aspects of mythological and fictional creatures.
strengths: Swap attributes of mythological creatures to ones that you can more easily handle.
Create new mythological creatures by mixing attributes.
If you become a mythological creature (zombie, etc. ) you can use this on yourself.
weaknesses: Can only swap the attributes of two species (e.g. werewolf), or Gods etc. at a time.
Angering an Olympian by changing its power.
The attribute or aspect you switch to may not be any better for you than the one you switched from.

name: Drill Hands
description: With this power you can turn you hands into drills whenever you want. The drills are super powerful and can drill holes through almost anything. You can also change the size of the drills to increase power and to make bigger holes.
summary: The ability to turn your hands into drills
strengths: You can turn your hands into drills
They can drill through almost anything
You can make the drills bigger or smaller for more power or to make bigger holes
weaknesses: Drilling large holes can be tiring

name: Plant Immunity
description: Any harm caused by plants has no effect on the holder of this power. Poisons, leaves, tree trunks, vines, etc. Nothing originating from plants will have any harmful effect.
summary: The ability to be immune to harm caused by plants
strengths: Can run through poison oak with no worries!
Don't have to worry about plant food while in the wilderness.
weaknesses: Animals can still hurt you.
Part-animal part-plants are borderline for immunity.

name: Blood To Water
description: With this power you can turn any amount of blood into pure drinking water. You can use this power while the blood is still in the person which would kill them due to all of their blood becoming water. Or you can use it when the blood is already outside of the person in order to drink.
summary: The ability to turn blood into water
strengths: You can kill people by turning all of their blood into water
You can cut yourself or somebody else and turn the blood into drinking water for you too drink
weaknesses: People might think you're a vampire

name: Toy Model To Living Being
description: Whether it is a doll or a plastic model it will still turn into the living being it is modeled after. It also does not matter whether it is modeled after a human, animal, plant or mythical creature. The new living being will have no memories and no skills other than walking, talking, and thinking unless it was affected by a power that caused it to be sentient then it will keep any skills and memories it had.
summary: The ability to turn models of living beings into actual living beings
strengths: Works on toys affected by Living Toys. Also affects dolls created by Living Doll Creation.
weaknesses: New humans will not have IDs in national databases.
This power cannot reverse itself.
Will need to feed new living beings.

name: Theme Generation
description: Unlike Theme Manager, this power lets you create themed items with out changing other objects. This power lets you create new matter by thinking of a certain theme, and an object you want that follows that theme. At first this power is only capable of creating hand held items, but more complex things can be made as skill grows. All items created must follow the same theme, so if you want to switch themes, all previous items must be changed or deleted first.
summary: The ability to create items that follow a certain theme.
strengths: Create new items that follow a useful theme.
Skill can be developed to create larger more complex objects.
Large variety of themes to use.
weaknesses: All current items created must follow a single theme.
Only small personal items can be created at beginner level.
Needs user to be creative to achieve full potential.

name: D&D Transformation
description: You must have actually played as a PC with the character and it must not be overpowered (although it can be overpowered if you were using content from a d&d book published by wizards of the coast) also you don't get that character's gear you're still are wearing your own clothes. (sorry no uber sword)
summary: The ability to transform into your d&d character(s)
strengths: Most normal people have 1 to 9 hp you can have hundreds
You are uber
weaknesses: You only get your characters physical stats so no change to int and wis
You must follow the same rules as the character you turn into (Ex: Spells per Day).

name: Population Density Control
description: A person with this power can control population density. Causing more people to come and go away from any area at will. The effect is not instantaneous but happens really quickly after the user uses the power. This power is a sort of signaling power combined with reality manipulation and probability manipulation that causes more people to appear where you are. Also this power does not only work on humans, you can increase the population of rats or other animals as well.
summary: The ability to control population density
strengths: Can increase turnout at any event
Can decrease the amount of people surrounding you
Can work to increase the population density of any type of living creature that exists
weaknesses: Cannot control who is in the population that arrives or goes away
Cannot control the people or animals in the population that you bring to your location
Not instantaneous

name: Ally Shift
description: WIth this power you can turn into anybody who has ever helped you in a fight. You get all of their powers and skill while keeping your intelligence level and knowledge. This power only lets you turn into people who have helped you in a fight not any of your friends. You can stay in ally mode for as long as you want and when you're done you can turn back to your normal form.
summary: The ability to turn into any of your allies
strengths: You can turn into anybody who has ever helped you in a fight and you get all of their powers
You retain your intelligence level
You can stay in ally mode for as long as you want
weaknesses: It doesn't apply to all of your friends only the ones who have helped you in a fight

name: "Speak Animals!" V2
description: With this power you can give animal's the ability to speak any human language. It doesn't have to be a language you know all you have to do it point at an animal and say "Speak Animal! " and the animal will instantly learn every human language.
summary: The ability to give animals the ability to speak any human language
strengths: You can give animals the ability to speak any human language
You can use this power on as many animals as you want
weaknesses: Does not work on humans
You cannot reverse the effects of this power
Only works with human languages

name: Gelatin
description: You can secrete a clear gelatin from specialized glands in your skin and control it telepathically. You can alter its form and properties. For example you could alter it into a highly flammable solid shape. You could even give it healing properties or cause it to produce another element.
summary: The ability to secrete and telepathically control a gelatin like substance
strengths: Amazing potential to do anything
You can give it healing properties
no concentration required
weaknesses: potentialy Dangerous until you are experienced
if this got in the hands of a villain

name: Ghiorso Extempore
description: A unrestricted power that allows the wielder to create a superpowered soldier out of nothing but the surrounding materials, with very little effort. The superhumans are unique and have personality identical to an average human being. The wielder has no control over their state of health, and cannot instantly kill them or revive them. Powers of instant death, resurrection, and omni-anything cannot be used.
summary: The ability to spawn superhuman slaves at will.
strengths: Instant Army
Personal Superhuman Bodyguards
weaknesses: Sentience of Creations- probability they can turn against the weilder

name: Stooge Division
description: With this power the user can, with a touch, cause someone to divide into two identical copies of themselves. However, each copy will only have half the intelligence of the original. If you then divide one of these copies that copies intelligence will be split two ways. You can keep dividing clones as long as you want, until you have turned one clever person into a large group of barely functional imbeciles.
summary: The ability to divide a persons intelligence across clone bodies.
strengths: Divide one smart person into twenty dumb ones.
It turns one person into a group.
weaknesses: It turns one enemy into a group.
It may take some time to whittle down someone exceptionally intelligent.
You have to keep track of which clones your're dividing.

name: Viper Trap
description: With this power all you have to do is choose a place in your vicinity that isn't being observed (under a table, behind a couch, the inside of a box) and a poisonous snake will materialize there, coiled and ready to strike.   The viper will attack the first living thing that disturbs its hiding place.
summary: The ability to hide a live viper anywhere that isn't being observed.
strengths: Place an angry viper near someone you want dead.
Multiple snakes may be materilized at once.
weaknesses: The snake does not obey you, and does not just go away once it's bitten someone.
It strikes the first living thing to disturb it's hiding place, not who you want it to bite.
The place you materilize the snake must be currently unobserved.

name: Age Capability Mimicry
description: At different points in an organisms' life cycle, they may have capabilities lacked in another. With this power, one can manifest such abilities at will. Examples include the regenerative capabilities of a fetus, the enhanced intelligence and learning capabilities of an infant or a teenager's resistance to weight gain. A capability is simply any biological trait specific to one or a few age/s.
summary: The ability to manifest any capability one would have at any point in their life cycle, at will.
strengths: Manifest capabilities you had when younger or will have when older.
Occurs at will; no unwanted capabilities.
Even applies to age-restricted superpowers.
weaknesses: You must possess the trait at some point in life, past, present or future, in order to use it.
You cannot use traits of possible evolution of human capabilities, at least until more experienced.
The traits are only as powerful as they are normally.

name: Rise Of The Minotaur
description: With this power you can shapeshift into a minotaur. You will grow to seven feet tall, have long sharp horns, super strength as well as a complimentary battle axe.
summary: The ability to turn into a minotaur
strengths: You can turn into a minotaur
Free battle axe
super strength, horns, head of a bull
weaknesses: People might mistake you for the actual mythological beast and try to kill you or capture you

name: Cat Copying
description: If you bite someone while being a cat you'll make them that cat you took the form of, but only happens when you're the highest level of being allergic to cats.
summary: The ability to turn into any kind of cat.
strengths: Animals respect you even if there more powerful then you.
weaknesses: Dogs will hate you if you end up with this power.

name: Black Breath
description: One with this ability breathes out a deadly black cloud of an unknown substance, which can be concentrated to three levels; stun, knock-out or kill. The first level "stun" is a thin cloud of the substance which only dazes targets; the second level "knock-out" does just that, knocking foes unconscious; the third setting, however, is much more potent. It is capable of killing plant and animal life, as well as corroding matter to an extent (rusting metals, rotting wood, tainting water, etc. )
summary: The ability to breathe out a deadly black mist
strengths: Three levels: stun, incapacitate, kill
Can usually be turned on and off at will
Sometimes effect is empathic and only effects those you don't like or those who threaten you
weaknesses: If the power can't be suppressed (sometimes it does happen)
If the power is always at a weak level
If the power is always at a strong level

name: Supernatural Virus
description: With this power, you can create a disease or affliction that is non-biological in nature. As such, powers such as regeneration will not work against this power. The only way the affliction can be cured is through magic or other supernatural types of healing.
summary: The ability to make a virus out of supernatural elements like magic that is incurable by regular methods
strengths: You can design the effects of the virus
No doctor can cure the disease, except non-mainstream doctors
weaknesses: You are susceptible to your own virus, so it might spread to yourself over time
You need time to create a new virus and time to modify existing viruses
Viruses can be resisted by magical immunity

name: Optic Chromamorphism
description: While more or less completely useless, this power does have a very impressive name. This ability comes in several variations. Some wielders of this ability may only be able to change their eyes between two colors. Some may be able to change either eye to a different color. Some may be able to go mirror. Some may only be able to change their iris colour, others may be able to change their whites or pupils. And so on.
summary: The ability to change one's eye color.
strengths: Could help with disguises.
Scare the hell out of people by turning your eye's blood red.
Be the life of parties!
weaknesses: May not be able to control it.
Can be very limited.
More or less completely useless.

name: Phytokinesis
description: Also called Leaf Manipulation. Using this power, you can control leaves. Not whole trees, not flowers, leaves. You can pull them off of trees and stir them into a flurry to distract foes, or make them paper-thin and razor-sharp to use as throwing blades. You can even stop them mid-fall, fuse them together into rudimentary tools and weapons (like joining five at the stem to make a leaf ninja star) and the like
summary: The ability to control and manipulate leaves
strengths: Leaves can be moved to your will
They can also be made razor-sharp and paper-thin, to be used as little blades
Can change their color, texture, density, weight, and species
weaknesses: Can't control entire plants (Cant even control flowers)
Stronger Agrokinetics tend to outdo your Phytokinetic prowess
Fire, Ice and Lack of Moisture can screw up your leaves

name: Revive The Dead
description: With a Simple Touch You Can Bring Recenty Deceased People and Animals Back to Life
summary: The ability to bring Dead People and Animals Back to Life
strengths: You Can Revive your Dead Friends.
If You Hit a Dog with your Car you can Bring the  Dead Dog Back.
If You Brought a HOT Babe Back She'd be Forever Grateful
weaknesses: If Vegans Take you to a SlaughterHouse.....etc
If the Dog you Hit was Really Damaged
Being asked to Revive People that should Stay Dead !

name: Weaving
description: With this power you can weave anything and it will become real. Anything from dogs and cats to swords and guns, people to plants. Anything made is the same size as woven. This power is completely voluntary for use.
summary: The ability to create real objects and beings by weaving them
strengths: Make anything you want by weaving it.
Voluntary in case of weaving something scary.
weaknesses: Can take months to weave something.
Have to weave for months for a lifesize human.
Unaffected by enhancements, Con Negation, and similar powers.

name: Morph Summoning
description: This power doesn't allow shapeshifting, but it does allow shapeshifters. The user has the power to summon creatures called morphs. Morphs are small, transparent, colored blobs. They have one opening for a mouth(they can speak, but only repeating what people say)and two eyes. They can shapeshift into whatever they can think of, and(when in blob form)they float around, trailing tinyer blobs behind them. They are totally loyal to you, and will obey anyone you give them to, but will always obey you.
summary: The ability to summon small, shapeshifting creatures.
strengths: They can shapeshift into anything(roughly their size)and float around.
They can communicate with you, have great personalities, and make great pets.
They are always loyal to you and, as blobs, can't really get hurt.
weaknesses: They can't shapeshift into anything really bigger than them.
They're little mischievous tricksters at times.

name: Morph Arms
description: To create anything with your arms, for example: you can make your hands a horse to ride on.
summary: The ability to create stuff with your arms
strengths: You can be creative
It will help your life
You acn use it to prank
weaknesses: You can get tangled
If it doesn't exist, it won't be created and you will be hurt
If your riding something that you can't carry, you will get hurt

name: Fractal Cube Creation
description: This power allows you to create nonmetallic/noncrystalline cubes that you can hold in your hand but that can grow into giant cubes or rectangles of massive size if you will it. You can throw a cube behind yourself to make a wall to slow down pursuers. Throw one between a foe's legs and knock him down. Use one to block an entire corridor. Use one as a temporary shield against an attack. Massive shapes can be reverted back to a single cube by your touch.
summary: The ability to create cubes that self-replicate or collapse back on themselves.
strengths: In theory fractal objects don't have an upper size limit.
A cube with who knows how many uses.
If you were shrunk to ant size then a regular-sized cube becomes a massive cube.
weaknesses: No damaging offensive capabilities-you could only knock someone done.
If this power malfunctions. See pro #1.

name: Primal Impact
description: Primal Impact deals a heavy amount of damage; it can really mess up certain enemies. Unless this attack misses, you might know who's friend or foe.
summary: The ability to go into an infinite rage, unleashing your inner animal.
strengths: When you try to become an rabid animal and not transform into one.
Might even scare off some bullies.
weaknesses: You might wind up losing control of this ability and living off in the jungle forever.

name: Retreating Healer
description: When you leave a battle you are 1/3% healed, this includes burns,poisons, etc.
summary: The ability to be partially healed when you leave the battle.
strengths: Become healed.
weaknesses: You are partially healed.
You are healed by about 1/3 or less.

name: The Bizarro Effect
description: Just like Superman and Bizarro but your bizarro versions only exist for a hour. Behavior and powers get flipped around. IQ does also unless IQ of the subject was average. You have to focus on a subject for a 30 seconds and then you've got a opposite of that person. Not all powers are made opposite(e. G. Superman and Bizarro). One or more might stay the same.
summary: The ability to create short-lived opposite versions of people.
strengths: Temporary allies with counter powers to foes you're facing.
A opposite version of a insane foe to help you fight the insane foe.
A villainous version of the most law-abiding foe you have.
weaknesses: Someone uses this power on use you.
There are powers that stop cloning or duplication.
If you're a villain you know that villains can turn on each other.

name: Necro Possesion
description: With Necro Possesion you can take any deceased corpse and make them do anything. This ability is not only limited to humans but animals as well. This power can work on skeletons as well.
summary: The ability to control the undead.
strengths: Undefeatable army
Revive friends
Manipulate the undead
weaknesses: Does not work on cremated bodies
Takes time to master

name: Contract Nullification
description: With this power, you can break any sort of obligation. If your true love was bitten by a vampire, you can sever his/her blood contract and they don't have to obey whoever bit them. Contracted demons are sent back to the demon realm. Not usable against Mythpower: Styx Bond since that will undoubtedly destroy every promises that ever existed, so to prevent that it will not work. Things that have already been done because of the contract are not negated.
summary: The ability to nullify any contract, promise, or obligation
strengths: Take out huge loans then nullify the contract
Severe magical contracts
Save people from fulfilling undesired conditions
weaknesses: People will still go after you for not keeping "promises"

name: Bullets To Paintballs
description: With this power you can turn any kind of bullets into any color paintball. This is useful if your are being chased by someone with a gun you can just turn all their bullets into paintballs. Or if you're already being shot at you can just turn the oncoming bullets into paintballs. You are unable to turn paintballs into bullets with this power.
summary: The ability to turn bullets into paintballs
strengths: You can turn bullets into paintballs
weaknesses: You are unable to turn the paintballs back into bullets

name: Hydra Morph
description: With this ability, you can transform into a Hydra, a creature with nine heads and a poisonous breath. Every time a Hydra's head is sliced off, it is replaced with two additional heads. A Hydra's breath is so virulent that it kills nearly everything it touches, and is breathed as a dark, purple cloud of poison.
summary: The ability to transform into the Hydra, a creature with nine heads and a poisonous breath.
strengths: Grow back two heads every time one is cut off.
Your breath can kill anything; it can easily kill any average human.
You can revert to your normal form at any given time.
weaknesses: Your heads cannot grow back if they are singed while regenerating.
Your form resets itself once you revert to normal.

name: Figure Bluffing
description: If you say your a doctor that can heal all cases and at least 1,000 people believe that, then you are able to become that figure you made up.
summary: The ability to be able to turn into a figure of your imagination if others believe you are really that.
strengths: If you can convince others easily.
weaknesses: It would be kinda hard convincing others that you are a godly figure.
You can only create 3 figures a day.

name: Action Figure Shifting
description: With this power you can turn any action figure or doll into the person/character that they are based on. If the character has any special powers or abilities the action figure gains them as well. The action figures also grow to the normal height of the character. You are not able to control the figures but you can turn them back into inanimate objects whenever you want.
summary: The ability to turn action figures into the people they are based on
strengths: You can turn action figures/dolls into the people or characters that they represent
You can turn them back whenever you want
weaknesses: You cannot control the animated action figures

name: Money Tree V6
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time and it grows one million dollars (or the equivalent of one million American dollars depending on where you are) a day in one hundred dollar bills (or the equivalent). If the money tree gets destroyed or you destroy it, you can create a new one somewhere else. Also if you're attacked you can use the unbreakable branches as weapons to defend yourself.
summary: The ability to create a tree that produces a lot of money
strengths: You can produce a money tree that produces up to one million dollars a day
You can use the branches as weapons
weaknesses: You can only make one at a time
You can only have up to 1,000,000 dollars
It can be destroyed

name: I Can Hear You
description: With this power whenever someone is talking about you no matter where they are in the universe you will know what they're saying. This includes hearing plans against you, if people are going to throw you a surprise party, if people like/don't like you etc. It only works if they say your full name (first and last not middle) and you can't turn it off
summary: The ability to know what people are saying about you
strengths: You can hear what people are saying about you whenever they talk about you
weaknesses: You can't turn it off
If they don't say your first and last name you can't hear it

name: Cryptid Mimicry
description: Cryptids are mystical animals that the general populace are not aware of and only a certain group of people acknowledge or know they exist. With this power, the user ( who must believe in the existence cryptids and have knowledge about them ) can take on the characteristic of a cryptid of their choice. This power only allows the user to mimic on cryptid at a time.
summary: The ability to take on the characteristic of a cryptid
strengths: Can become unstoppable
Different cryptid transformation bring different powers in to play
weaknesses: Need to have a wide knowledge about cryptids
Cannot combine characteristics of two cryptids together

name: Gift Of Ubiquity
description: When you really want to do something, but think you can't do it, a doppelganger appears and does what you wanted to do, while acting the same way you would. The tasks must be possible for you, and the doppelganger disappears when they are done. However, you won't realize they are, except for material traces and witness testimonies. Because of the very nature of this power, it becomes tricky to use once you know about it, as it's only activated when you really think you can't do something.
summary: The ability to have a doppelganger do what you deeply want to do, unbeknownst to you.
strengths: Have things done, in spite of the fact that you think you can't do them.
Works no matter how far the distance between you and the doppelganger.
If you have other superpowers, the doppelganger can use them.
weaknesses: No transfer of knowledge. Anything the doppelganger experiences while it exists, you don't.
When you realize you have this power, it becomes tricky to activate.
Only one doppelganger can exist at a time and it won't know what previous ones learnt by themselves.

name: Thirteen Treasures: Crockery
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. These items will bear any food that the user may wish for upon command.
summary: The ability to use the crock and dish of Rhygenydd the Cleric
strengths: Any food you might wish for!
weaknesses: Can only summon a plateful at a time.

name: Morphine
description: A person with this ability can take away the pain of anyone who is hurt physically. Although it is rather useful in emergency situations, the wounded person would still have to seek medical attention for their injuries.
summary: The ability to take away a person's physical pain
strengths: If the person is in a lot of pain, it'll stop them from screaming all the time
The injured can be more cooperative
weaknesses: If its bad enough, the healer can feel the pain
If the healer does not know basic first aid, the person can still die from the wounds

name: Infrared Vision
description: Though one can see perfectly in the dark and figure out the temperature of things, a lot of time will be needed to learn how to figure out the exact temperature of things. No more will the military need goggles and bulky equipment to see in the dark!
summary: The ability to see the temperature of objects /see in complete darkness.
strengths: With experience, you can (usually) tell if someone's lying or not by how how warm they get.
As long as you're quiet, you can score perfect points in nighttime water gun fights.
You can tell if someone's dead or not without 'touching the evidence'.
weaknesses: You can never see things like regular people can (in true color).
Little or no depth perception!
Objects with similar colors and temperatures won't be seen well or at all.

name: Pain
description: You can use any and all powers you've ever heard of for 12 hours a day. No matter what the power. You can be the most powerful being on the block. Do what ever you want. Have fun with it, impress everyone around. Women will love you and even your enemies will be impressed with you. You will pay a heavy heavy price for it all. What you do will come with pure pain. How ever powerful you are in your 12 hrs, That's how much pain you'll be subject to in your 12 hour payment time.
summary: The ability to use any power you've ever heard of, for the price of feeling pure pain.
strengths: Do what ever you want. Be as powerful as you want. You have all day use multifuple powers at once.
You can use any power you've ever heard of. Be a perfect undefeated hero.
If you love pain, then you'll love this power. Used in Moderation you can do good things with it.
weaknesses: Pay for it in pain, what you use is reflected on you in equal doses.
You can never kill anyone, if you do you'll suffer an eternity in pain and you'll live unable to die
You quite possible will kill yourself before you ever kill anyone else anyway.

name: Poisoned
description: When you opponent lands a hit on you, they then become poisoned, but 30% of the time it will not poison them. If they hit you again and they are poisoned, then the poison worsens.
summary: The ability to have a 70% chance to poison a foe when they land a hit on you.
strengths: This poison can only be healed naturally.
weaknesses: People with Poison Immunity.
30% of the time it doesn't work.
Only works with physical attacks.

name: Optic Delay
description: When used, it can prevent the subject from seeing things up to few seconds after it has happened, and so one can easily evade the subjects vision for a few seconds. This ability can affect more than one person at a time and lasts as long as one chooses to. This power can backfire
summary: The ability to disrupt a subject's optic vision temporarily and "rewind" it to a few moments in the past.
strengths: Evade a foe's attacks.
Get a chance to flee.
Affects mutiple subjects and can last as long as one chooses.
weaknesses: Can backfire.
Can take some time to learn how to use this ability on mutiple subjects.
Can take some time to learn how to turn on and off.

name: Bloodlines (Special Type)
