description: You can pass along a power with this power and it is permanently decided which power when you use this power the first time. That one power and this power are unstealable and unmimicable as well as the knowledge of one technique being transferred. You still keep the powers and knowledge of the technique after transfer. Transfer requires 1mL of blood consumed and must require your approval. This power is not negatable, unalterable and can be used multiple times.
summary: The ability to pass along one power and one technique through the blood
strengths: Can use multiple times.
This power is passed along attached to the other power.
The technique is your coice.
weaknesses: Other power is still alterable.
The recipient could be unhappy about which technique you give and attack you.

name: Background Music
description: You can choose if this can be heard by others or not. You don't choose the music, your mood and the current event determine the soundtrack. However, it can be switched off, dimmed, or amplified.
summary: The ability to have background music play to different events in your life.
strengths: Become an instant song master!
A skip and a dance to a merry tune!
You can be James Bond, Jackie Chan, or the Pink Panther!
weaknesses: You might end up bobbing your head to a catchy tune and be sent to a mental hospital.
You might end up wallowing in self-pity.

name: I Am Batman
description: With this power you can turn into any version of Batman from any of the comics, TV shows, movies, radio dramas etc. You have all of his memories combined with yours and you have all of his skills, abilities and equipment however you retain your personality.
summary: The ability to turn into Batman
strengths: You can become Batman
weaknesses: Having the memories of two people might be hard to handle

name: Wild Cat
description: With this power you can change domestic house cats into jungle cats. You change your little tabby cat into a ferocious tiger or your siamese into a lion and so on and so forth. The cats that you change become under your control however you cannot turn them back into house cats.
summary: The ability to change domestic house cats into jungle cats
strengths: You can turn house cats into jungle cats
They are under your control
weaknesses: You cannot reverse the affects of this power

name: Healer 6: Hearing Aid
description: With this ability, anyone within 25 kilometers has their hearing restored to expected levels, regardless of cause. This ability repairs the normal auditory organs to normal working order and repairs relevant brain damage. In all cases, you are able to hear what is heard by those healed at will. In addition, you may enhance your own sense of hearing by the same amount, but naturally this will degrade over time. Range increase by 1 meter each year of possession and may be switched off at will.
summary: The ability to restore hearing and gain clairaudience as well as enhanced hearing.
strengths: Restore hearing to the deaf.
Enhance your own hearing and hear through the ears of those healed if needed.
Has a base range of 25 kilometers which increases by 1 meter for each year of possession.
weaknesses: Will only help the deaf or hearing impaired.
Limited range.
Unlike other healing powers, this cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: Serpent Fingers
description: The supers fingers, toes, and any other desired digits, extend out to twice the standard length while morphing into snakes or a snake like form. Each can act independent of the super, or act in accordance to the supers will. Snakes can be; venomous (causes necrosis of flesh), constricting (3x users strength), Paralytic Neuro Toxin, or has an Ultra Strong Biting (x3 users bite, and diamond hard teeth). Snakes can extend out to 3 meters per tier and regenerate in minutes when cut.
summary: The ability to transforms finger (and toes if desired) into vicious snakes under the supers control.
strengths: Snakes can be used as mid ranged independent attackers, or directed. They will actively defend.
Adds additional attack methods. Can support the users weight, allowing brachiating between points.
Digits recover 1% of length every 15 seconds. At higher levels head hair and full limbs also change.
weaknesses: There is a 1% chance per tier of gaining an insanity Due to the serpents ability to be independent.
This power is disturbing to many people/beings, especially the ophidiopho minded. May scare allies.
There is a very real potential for shock from loosing a snake. A 5% chance of causing a freakout.

name: Agony Vision
description: Your power works by stimulating the pain center of virtually any humanoid, a synaptic scan calibrates it for each species. Traditional forms of punishment can overwhelm the nervous system, after a time the brain ceases to feel anything. However, agony vision possesses sensors that continually shift the stimulation from one nerve cluster to another, keeping the subject in a constant state of agony, hence its name.
summary: The ability to fire intense beams from your eyes to cause enemies extreme pain.
strengths: You can use this ability to interrogate, submit and torture your enemies.
weaknesses: If this power reflects on a mirror you too can go into a constant state of pain.

name: Rise Of The Behemoth
description: With this power you can turn into a behemoth; a giant eight foot tall monster with jet black fur. You have razor sharp claws and teeth, plus a long powerful tail. You also have extremely powerful legs that allow you to jump over twenty feet.
summary: The ability to turn into the mythical behemoth
strengths: You are super strong
You have razor sharp claws and teeth
weaknesses: You might be attacked because people might think you're a monster

name: Inner Beauty Painting
description: A person with this power has the ability to paint someone's inner beauty. For example they can paint even the most ugly person into a beautiful rendition if they have a good heart. However if a person is evil or has a bad heart the user cannot paint them beautifully no matter how beautiful they are in outer appearance. The user becomes automatically proficient in artistic skills when they activate this power.
summary: The ability to paint a person's inner beauty
strengths: Can immediately know if a person is good or not
Goes beyond disguises
Make money selling portraits
weaknesses: People will hunt you down for the chance to be painted
Many people will be upset if you paint them badly
Prevents you from painting an evil person in a good way

name: Animal Form
description: With this power you become permanently half of an animal of your choosing. The animal must be an non-mutated animal of your home planet. Once an animal has been picked it can not be changed without losing and regaining this power. If this power is lost, a ghost of the animal you picked will attempt to find you and return this to you. This power works if you become a robot, zombie, ghost, energy being, another animal, statue, Et cetera
summary: The ability to remain half animal even when changed into another form.
strengths: Always become half animal of your choosing.
Works even if you are transformed into something else.
If power is lost a ghost animal will make its way to you to return the power.
weaknesses: Can not change animal until the power is lost and regained.
Will never be fully human again.
If you pick a lame animal you may be stuck with it for a while.

name: Fractal Shrapnel Grenadier
description: You can create shrapnel grenades of a fractal nature. If an opponent gets hit with even one single piece of shrapnel, that single piece will grow into a disc. This disc will grow inward causing internal injuries. Amputation of a limb or beheading is possible also. The shrapnel of a grenade is crystalline. The blade can grow in any opponent that can be hurt by the shrapnel regardless of what your opponent is made of. Your grenade can hurt you if you're too close to it.
summary: The ability to create and throw shrapnel grenades of a fractal nature.
strengths: A grenade that becomes multiple deadly discs.
A disc will grow inside anyone who got struck by the shrapnel.
If you have another power to protect yourself from a grenade, you can just drop one at your feet.
weaknesses: Anyone with the power to absorb or block the shrapnel.
Someone made of a hard substance.
Someone to whom internal injuries or beheading wouldn't matter.

name: Vampiric Superiority
description: A vampire with this power is of such a high level that other vampires automatically do what they're told by the vampire with this power. Due to the nature of this power, only a vampire or part-vampire can have this power. If two beings with this power try to give a command to the same being, the one who is more powerful gets their command followed first.
summary: The ability to give orders to vampires and have the orders followed
strengths: You get servants who will follow your every command.
Works for vampires, dhampirs, and werepyres.
You're immune to the commands of someone else with this power, regardless of strength.
weaknesses: Vampires are generally awake only in the night time.
Only works for the beings mentioned in the second pro.
You don't want to meet someone with this power who's more powerful.

name: Ash
description: Whenever you burn something, it turns into an ash that can give people temporary powers. These are the powers: Controlled telescopic (long range) vision, one vision into the future that you can bring up at will, healing, super hearing, energy blasts, and super strength. When you have the powers, you have white eyes. The more ash you use, the longer your powers last. To use the ash, the user puts the ash into their eyes. This doesn't hurt.
summary: The ability to produce an ash with magical powers.
strengths: You can have many different powers
Can give others powers
weaknesses: Someone could steal the ash
Powers are temporary
Future vision is one time use only. To use again, must use ash again.

name: X Tinction Reversal
description: With this power you can bring entire extinct species back into existence. When you use this power you just say the name of the species and then revive and then one hundred members of that species will appear wherever you want. You can use this power on as many species as you want.
summary: The ability to bring extinct species back into existence
strengths: You can bring extinct species back to life
You can use this power on as many species as you want
weaknesses: The animals you resurrect are not under your control

name: Jack In The Head
description: To activate this power, you must sing "Pop! Goes the Weasel". At a random moment during the song, the top of your head will suddenly open and your brain, which will be shaped and dressed like a jester, will pop out of it, still attached to your skull by a bundle of nerves and blood vessels shaped into a spring. You can also control your brain jester to make it move to some degree and grab things. As long as your brain is attached to your body, you'll survive.
summary: The ability to have your jester-shaped brain pop out of your head after singing "Pop! Goes the Weasel".
strengths: Freak people out by showing them your brain and making it move.
Just push your brain back into your skull and close the top of your head to deactivate this power.
You can make you brain grab things.
weaknesses: The brain jester won't be able to go far from your head because of the "spring".
Obviously, your brain will be exposed to various dangers.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Uniquely Possessed
description: With this power, you can become anyone that you have ever wanted to be. You could even become the president, a famous person, or anyone else. The only problem is once you pick someone, then go to someone else, you can never be that first person again.
summary: The ability to be anyone you have want to be, once.
strengths: You could become very popular.
You could see what someone was thinking.
weaknesses: Once you leave being someone, you are risking of ever being able to go back to yourself again.
Once you pick someone, then pick someone else, you can never be that person again.
The exception for this is if you go back to yourself.

name: Living Doll Creation
description: The living doll can look like whatever you want it to look like as long as its basic shape is humanoid. It can be anywhere from the size of an ordinary doll to as big as a 2-metre-tall human. The doll will be able to move and think on its own without outside help and can be powered by a fuel cell, nuclear power, mana, etc whatever you wish for it to be powered by. Also, the living doll is always subject to the 3 Laws of Robotics and its first master will be its creator.
summary: The ability to create a living doll that can move and think on its own
strengths: You can create your own companion who can be your maid, butler, soldier, etc.
The living doll can be made of metal with gears (robot), with felt and stuffing (child's doll), etc.
You can sell the living dolls.
weaknesses: If you sell the living doll it can now harm you if told to by its new master.
Your creation(s) might fall in love with you. May be a pro.
Note: You can add wings,horns, fangs, claws, pointed ears,etc as long as the basic body is humanoid.

name: Myth Power: Achlys' Access
description: Achlys (Akhlys), in Greek myth, was the goddess of misery, obscurity, Eternal Night (a death-mist, preceding even Chaos, that clouds dying eyes) and poison. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive sadness, at will. In addition, one can absorb sadness to gain physical power, at will. One can also psychically produce a 'death-mist' which induces suspended animation, at will. One can even withstand, as well as psychically perceive and manipulate poison/venom/toxins, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Achlys' command over the essence of sadness/misery, obscurity, the Eternal Night and poison
strengths: Psychically perceive sadness, and absorb it to gain physical power, at will
Psychically produce a 'death-mist' which induces a trance of suspended animation, at will
Withstand, as well as psychically perceive and manipulate poison/venom/toxins, at will
weaknesses: Pro #2 cannot be channeled into a touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot erase identities from subjects' minds, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Aniothability, Poison Immunity, Poison Neutralization, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Max Spider Power
description: you will have spiderman's power also adding Venom coming from your palm, Digestive Enzymes Coming from your mouth, Tarantula Hair Growing on your arm, Ability to dig as fast as a trap door spider.
summary: The ability to have all abilities of all species of spiders
strengths: With your tarantula hair you can blind your enemies
With your digestive enzymes you can melt anything
With Your Venom you can paralyze or kill your enemies
weaknesses: Weird Craving to eat flies
Wierd Craving to eat small mammals
You'll Ocassionally Blind

name: Blessing Of Dionysus
description: Dionysus is the Greek god of wine. His blessing gives you powers over all that he rules. This means you can control grapevines and conjure drinks of all sorts. You can also cause people to go mad and insane. You can turn yourself and others into tigers, as they are Dionysus' sacred animals. Also, in your presence, grapevines will grow very rapidly.
summary: The ability to have the blessing of Dionysus
strengths: You can control grapevines and conjure drinks.
You can turn into a tiger and explore the jungle.
Insanity is now your greatest weapon
weaknesses: Rapidly growing grapevines will usually give you away

name: Chinese Zodiac Morphs
description: This is the ability to change into all Chinese Zodiac animals, from the simple small rat, to the allpowerful dragon! It's still like shape-shifting, but you can only change into twelve animals, including the dragon.

strengths: Ram into things with the ox
Eat people if in snake form, except if your shorter than 16 feet
ALL POWERFUL DRAGON!!!!!
weaknesses: Can only change into twelve animals
Only one thing can fly. Dragon.
If your snake form can swim, thats the only one that swims

name: Prevention
description: This ability completely and utterly prevents you from ever becoming any and all kind and type of zombie, werewolf, and vampire, as well as also completely and utterly preventing you from becoming petrified, or mutating into a mindless and/or bloodthirsty monster or creature.
summary: The ability to be immune to transformations into any kind or type of monster or creature.
strengths: Never worry about becoming a monster, vampire, werewolf, or zombie.
Complete & utter immunity to the effects of petrification.
Can instantly, perfectly, and permanently cure people with your blood who are monsters.
weaknesses: Monsters, creatures, vampires, and werewolves might want to destroy you.

name: Egyptian Staff
description: An egyptian magician's staff is his most valuable possesion. The tradition staff is about five feet long, pitch black, and covered with gold Egyptian symbols. The staff has many powers. Magic can be stored or collected within it. It also has morphing powers. It can be morphed into any animal(all of which obey the wielder)and also can shrink into an 8 inch black rod, so it can be stored more easily. The symbols have powers too. When the wielder presses and concentrates on them they become real
summary: The ability to wield an egyptian magician's staff.
strengths: Weilding a magical staff
It has many powers
It can morph into animals and shrink to be stored more easily
weaknesses: Have to learn Egyptian to use the symbols

name: Inner Beauty Perception
description: Just like Hal Larson, you can see people's inner beauty. If they have a good soul, they will appear beautiful/handsome to you. If they are ugly on the inside, it will show on the outside. Also, if someone's appearance has been altered through make-up or surgery, or because of an accident, you will see through that. As a result, you cannot be deceived by cloners, shape-shifters, invisibility, illusions when they affect someone's appearance, body modelers, and any appearance-altering powers.
summary: The ability to see people for who they truly are.
strengths: You can easily assess how likely a girl/guy will cheat on you or if she/he is a libertine.
You can measure how trustworthy someone is.
You can see through appearance-altering powers.
weaknesses: You can switch this power off, but, after a while, it may be confusing as to whether it's off or on.
If you date someone based on how they look on the inside, doesn't it mean you've become shallow?

name: Lion's Heart
description: This person had his own heart removed and replaced with a lion's heart. Because of this, they have gained the strength of a lion, the speed of a lion, the sense of smell of a lion and the eyesight of a lion.
summary: The ability to get the abilities of a lion because the user possesses a lion's heart
strengths: Is as strong as a lion
Can easily chase and catch criminals
weaknesses: Might get a craving for very raw meat

name: I Am Iron Man
description: With this power you can turn into the invincible Iron Man to fight crime.
summary: The ability to turn into Iron Man
strengths: You have a lot of weaponry
You have a lot of protection
Fame
weaknesses: Metal Manipulators
Technopaths and Electricity Manipulators
You're not actually Tony Stark, so you're still broke...

name: Vampiramorphosis
description: Like Dracula, you are able to change your form into a large bat, a wolf or a thick, dark fog. This power can only be used during the night.
summary: The ability to change into: a bat, a wolf, or a dense black cloud. Only works at night.
strengths: As a bat you can fly
As a wolf you have great strength, speed and sensory perception
As a mist you can sneak by undetected
weaknesses: It only works at night
Transformation takes a couple of minutes in which time you are vulnerable
You have a weakness to all things holy (ie relics, churches, holy water, etc)

name: Transforming Dragon Master #3
description: As the pinnacle of the transforming masters of martial arts you have the power to become any dragon of any culture. Within the movements of your art you could transform your limbs or morph into full dragon form at will. You innately know each fight style when you begin practice or battle. Where it began with focus & style with #1 & #2, Dragon Master #3 is about determination to end a battle. Be forewarned, however. Dragons at their very heart are unsavory beasts.
summary: The ability to transform into any Dragon through use martial arts
strengths: Dependant upon your moves & style you could be any dragon from any culture in the world
Breathe fire, scaled skin, extra strength, animal instincts, advanced sight, unrivaled fight skill
Dragon Master #3 forms can be combined with Dragon Master#1 and #2 forms
weaknesses: Full dragon forms or neither friendly nor controllable
Each ending punch, kick or move is accompanied with violent fire whether you breathe it or not
Some dragons forms are inherently evil even if you have benevolent intentions

name: Body Split
description: With this power, you can separte yourself many times. You can also split them anyway you like, such as spilting your head in two, chopping your mid section, or spliting your arm into three. Each part can be controlled menatlly and you are able to use all of your senses through that part, e. I. You arm can smell, taste, see, and hear. You can also reaggrange yourselve in anyway you see fit.

strengths: Never lose at Twister
Spy on any one without them knowing
Scare people with floating body parts
weaknesses: You must have all of your parts together or you'll be stuck separated
Any part lost can not be repaired
All parts must return within a two hour time span

name: Poison Of The Demon Snake
description: With this power you can create and control a green liquid substance, which causes anyone that touches it to suffer deadly allergic reactions. This "smart" toxin affects directly the most important parts of the body, destroying anyone from inside out. Once someone is affected by this power it's incurable by normal means. After generating the substance, you can't touch it too, because you are not immune to it. This ability is more recommended to villains.
summary: The ability to create and control a liquid poisonous substance, which causes deadly allergic reactions on anyone.
strengths: This is the ultimate poison, incurable and deadly.

You can make the liquid substance appear anywhere, as long as this place is nearby you.
weaknesses: You are not immune to your own power, which makes this ability really dangerous.
People with Liquid Control are able to control the substance too.
Won't work on invulnerable people and can be cured by healing powers.

name: Precognitive Whittling
description: Whittling is when you carve shapes out of wood. With this power you can whittle the future. It does not matter if you can whittle or not; when you slip into a trance you are able to become a master whittler. You cannot whittle until you have a knife and a block of wood, so you will stay in that trance until you have finished the whittle. The range of the precognition is about an hour to a couple of years.
summary: The ability to whittle the future
strengths: You can whittle the future
You are a masterful whittler in the trance
weaknesses: You do need to have a knife and some wood
You won't come out of the trance until you have whittled the event

name: Gun Shift
description: With this power you can change any kind of gun into any other kind of gun and change any ammo into any other kind of ammo. It ever works with toy guns such a Nerf Guns or paintball guns. You cannot turn guns into fictional guns from TV, books, comics, or movies.
summary: The ability to turn guns into any other kind of gun
strengths: You can change any kind of gun into any other kind of gun
You can change any kind of ammo into any other kind of ammo
You can use this power as many times as you want on a gun
weaknesses: You cannot turns guns into fictional guns

name: Spider Mimicry
description: At will, you can turn into a spider-human hybrid and back. You remain the same size, but gain enlarged canines laced with a paralysing venom, four black-haired large spider-legs sprout from your back, small black hairs grow over parts of your body and your strength is enhanced. Your eyes turn shiny black and your movement-based vision is improved. Your extra legs are strong enough to support your body and throw a person. Using them, you can climb up walls
summary: The ability to transform into a spider-like hybrid
strengths: Can climb up walls
Your intimidating appearance will end most fights before they start
weaknesses: If made too angry, you may accidentally transform
You will appear frightening to others
You can't web-swing

name: Plant Growth
description: Food shortages are the cause of many of the world's problems. A Plant Stimulator can make a field full of seedlings become adult plants in less than 10 seconds. If those plants are fruit-bearing, then those fruits become huge and very nutritious--apples the size of softballs, pumpkins the size of exercise balls, etc. This is not Plant Manipulation; the user cannot direct the growth of the plants. They also cannot make the plant wither back to its original state.
summary: The ability to make plants grow to maturity very quickly
strengths: Make whole crops of seedlings become adults in seconds
Fruits of these plants become huge and nutritious
Good for farming
weaknesses: Cannot direct the growth
Cannot manipulate plants
Cannot reverse the process

name: Sense Balancer
description: Imagine that everyone on the planet has 40 points for all of their senses: Sight, Hearing, Touch, and Smell/Taste. 10 points is the average for each sense. Well, with this ability you can freely add or subtract points to or from each sense. This can be done instantaneously. However, you can't add to the original total of 40. There's a ton of uses for this. Become an awesome sniper. See with sonar. Sense air pressure and predict the weather... Maybe. Make foodgasms EVEN BETTER!!
summary: The ability to balance power between your senses
strengths: Can adapt easily to most challenges
Predict the weather probably
FOOD..... GASM
weaknesses: Mostly only good for spying
Leaves you open to certain attacks

name: Location, Location.....
description: You are able to choose a location (no bigger than a city) that you are not able to be defeated at. You can be hit, but you are resistant to it or are healed or something.

strengths: Never be defeated at a decided location.
weaknesses: This isn't exactly immunity, so you can still die because of personal reasons (poison,burns,etc. )
You can still feel pain.
Just put one foot outside of location and you can be defeated.

name: Poison Spit
description: With this power you can spit poison up to forty feet the poison is deadly and instantly kills whatever living thing it touches
summary: The ability to spit poison
strengths: You can kill people from up to forty feet away
weaknesses: You need to have good aim

name: Good Clone Generator
description: With this power you can generate "good" versions of criminals, super villains, bullies, monsters and other jerks. The clones are not under your control but are generally helpful and love to do good deeds. You cannot get rid of the clones once you generate them. This could even be useful if you're a villain. You can make a good version of yourself to make yourself look good to the public eye and you can discredit other villains and make them look bad (good) in front of bigger and badder villain.
summary: The ability to create good clones of criminals, super villains, bullies and other baddies
strengths: You can create good clones of evil/bad/mean people
They love to do good deeds
weaknesses: They're not under your control
You can't unsummon them

name: Evolutionary Distortion
description: Can change animals into prehistoric beasts and turn modern plants into a prehistoric environment. A lizard or bird world resemble dinosaurs, mammals would resemble their ice age cousins. The flora of a desert could turn into a jungle or forest.
summary: The ability to change modern fauna and flora into a prehistoric chaos
strengths: Can create new species that resemble prehistoric animals
Can be controlled as long as the person is alive
weaknesses: Can mess up the modern ecosystem and can cause a new age of animals
The worst animals or plants would consume a city within a matter of months or days
If the user dies then they would consume the planet within months or years

name: Urban Legend Materialization
description: With this power, you can make urban legends come true.  You also have limited control over the legend itself by materializing your interpretations of the urban legend. You can access any urban legend you know of from any place. Also, you can have the legend materialize to everyone or haunt specific people. An urban legend can be any rumor that a large group of people have heard of, another example would be the chain mail people send.
summary: The ability to make urban legends real and control certain factors of urban legends
strengths: You can scare people and do many other things
This power can work selectively and can be used on any urban legend
Materialize the urban legend to scare the creators of the original chain mail
weaknesses: If you are not careful, you can kill yourself or others
Some legends can drive people insane
Legends have the same weaknesses as their description

name: Finger Blades
description: Your fingernails will grow longer, sharper and be practically indestructible.
summary: The ability to turn fingernails into long unbreakable, sharp blades.
strengths: Great for "fist fights"
Good for can opening
You'll never need a knife to cut things again
weaknesses: You can only cut your nales with your nails
You can't scratch anything on your body while you have this power or else you'll cut yourself
Bad for people with a cutting problem

name: Creature Of Quartz
description: This ability allows you to transform any living creature into a quartz creature through touch. Quartz creatures retain thier natural shapes, but are now made of living quartz. The creatures you create are under your control.
summary: The ability to turn any living creature into a quartz creature
strengths: Turn any living thing into quartz
Control your quartz creatures
weaknesses: Must touch the creature for it to work

name: Rise Of The Ent
description: With this power you can turn into a anthropomorphic tree creature called an Ent. As an Ent you are extremely wise and strong. Also one with this power can live for hundreds of years even when not in Ent form. If you become extremely angry even the sound of your voice can cause great destruction.
summary: The ability to turn into an Ent
strengths: You can turn into a giant super strong super smart Ent
You can live for hundreds of years
If you get very angry even the sound of your voice will cause great destruction
weaknesses: You can be killed by fires or saws or beavers

name: Immunity Granting Blood
description: Just by drinking your blood, others can gain total immunity to any disease, syndrome, or virus you had in the past or currently. This works even if you had the disease for one second, then was cured by someone else with a healing power.
summary: The ability to grant others immunity to any disease or virus one has had by having them drink one's blood
strengths: Lower chance of allies getting sick.
weaknesses: If you've never been sick.
You need to have been sick for this power to be useful.

name: Hydrocarbokinisis
description: Ever wanted to make any molecule you want? With this power, you can. You can manipulate hydrocarbon based chemicals like oil, gasoline, and carbon dioxide and reshape them. Any molecule you can imagine you can make. You can only control small amounts of hydrogen, hydrocarbons and carbon based molecules. You can not control living things. You can, however, make antifreeze, medicine, fuel, or even a poison. You might even make NZT. Requires organic chemistry knowledge. What you make can backfire.
summary: The ability to control hydrocarbons, hydrogen and other carbon based molecules.
strengths: Make gasoline from oil, hydrogen and carbon dioxide.
Make medicine, fuels, and poisons.
Explore new molecules.
weaknesses: Need a hydrogen source(like water) and organic chemistry knowledge.
What you make could backfire.
Need to combine with nitrogen manipulating powers for full potential.

name: Hud Vision
description: Basically, at will someone with this power can see an HUD as needed. An HUD or 'Heads-Up Display' is what you see when playing certain video games, mostly real-time strategy games such as Age of Mythology. The HUD seen with this power will contain information known about a situation, person, place, object, etc. It will also show one-man strategies for hopefully getting through the situation.
summary: The ability to see a Heads-Up Display at any time with one's eyes
strengths: You now have the ability to see like some characters out of some video games.
Another example of an HUD in a video game is Metroid games where you see from Samus's view.
The display will appear to be slightly holographic (might be con).
weaknesses: Only gives information you already know.
Will not give strategies for teams.

name: Wound Licking
description: One with this ability gains a NICE little set of capabilities. First off, of course, he can heal wounds by licking them (cuts, bruises, broken bones, tumors, etc. ). However, his tongue and mouth are also adapted to the point that the user is incapable of getting sick by ingesting poisons/acid. Not to mention, if the user licks a subject who ISN'T wounded, the subject is jolted with a wicked biological backlash (foe's nerves fire off at the same time)
summary: The ability to heal wounds by licking them
strengths: Heal physical wounds
Ingesting acids/poisons won't harm you (and tastes are different, so nasty things don't taste bad)
If you lick sbjects who aren't wounded, they suffer backlash, temporarily paralyzing them
weaknesses: Licking people is creepy
Some user's don't get different tastes (licking wounds tastes HORRIBLE)
Some user's don't become immune to acids/poisons (you can only heal)

name: Power Bluffing
description: This power temporarily becomes another power-any power you've heard of and understand-if you can bluff an opponent into believing you have that power. This temporary new power last only as long as you are near the opponent you fooled. If you fail to bluff an opponent for one temporary power you can try for another power. Any opponent who catches on to your bluff or knows of this power will stop it from working.
summary: The ability to temporarily have any single power you want if you can convince an opponent.
strengths: Any power you heard of and understand can be yours for a short time.
weaknesses: This power is useless if you can't keep it secret.
Opponents who know you are lying.
Only works on one opponent.

name: Toximaniacal Form
description: With this ability, you can transform into a sludge which grows and gains power from toxins, gases, and pollutions. The sludge brakes down, and consumes with powerful enzymes, and it can break down anything it chooses while in contact. It can throw, release, or hurl its toxic pollution. It can also breathe a dangerous toxic gas which can make people unconscious, or even disintegrate them, depending on how strong the user has become.
summary: The ability to transform into a state which grows and gains power from consuming toxic waste, gas, and pollution
strengths: Grow and gain strength by consuming toxic waste, gas, and pollution.
You have a variety of sludge abilities, strengthening the larger you become.
You have enzymes which can disintegrate objects, becoming stronger as you enlarge.
weaknesses: The enzymes can be suppressed, but cannot be completely be turned off at will.
You are vulnerable to fire and ice.
Once you revert to normal form, you lose all the effects of this ability.

name: Pillow Manipulation
description: You can have the pillow be any size and shape you want. You can only create the pillows in a 50 metre radius around you and can control pillows within 100 metres of you. You can only gain this power by sleeping 16 hours or more per day for 1 week. You must willingly choose to sleep all those hours and cannot be knocked out, have fainted or be in a coma.
summary: The ability to create and control pillows
strengths: You can easily win any pillow fight.
weaknesses: This is really only useful in a bedroom...

name: Goldworks:The Apple Of Gold
description: The Apple of Gold is exactly what it sounds like. A golden apple. However, whoever takes one bite of the Apple, gains total immortality. When the Apple is planted, it quickly grows into a tree bearing more Golden Apples, all with the same power. The Golden Leaves of the tree have powers too. All who hold them are blessed with good fortune. Only the planter of the Apple can pick apples or leaves from the tree. Anyone else will feel sharp pain from touching the fruit or leaves on the tree.
summary: The ability to wield the Apple of Gold
strengths: Immortality and good fortune
Only the planter can pick from the tree.
The tree will respond to and obey it's planter.
weaknesses: Others can steal the original Apple from you
Immortality is sometimes a curse

name: Rise Of The Experiments
description: With this power you can turn into any of Dr. Jumba Jookiba's alien experiments from the show Lilo and Stitch. When you turn into an experiment you retain your intelligence level, personality and ability to speak along with the powers and abilities of the experiment you turned into. You can stay in experiment mode for as long as you want.
summary: The ability to turn into any of the experiments from Lilo and Stitch
strengths: You can turn into any of the experiments from Lilo and Stitch
You have tons of powerful forms
You retain all of your intelligence, skills, personality and ability to speak
weaknesses: Most of your forms are short
You might get captured by the government for being an alien

name: "Speak Animals!"
description: With this power you can give animals the ability to speak any human language that you personally know. All you have to do is point at an animal and say "Speak animal! " and the animal well then learn all of the languages that you know and be able to speak them perfectly. You can use it on as many animals as you want.
summary: The ability to give animals the ability to speak human languages
strengths: You can give animals the ability to speak human languages
weaknesses: You have to know the language to be able to grant the animal the ability to speak it
Only works with human languages

name: Plant Animation
description: You can make plants walk, like in Day of the Triffids. But they can talk too. How they act, depends on how they are treated.
summary: The ability to animate plants
strengths: Walking plants
Talking plants
Great gift
weaknesses: Angry plants.
How they act, depends on how they are treated

name: Super Costume
description: This is an interesting superpower. You are able to put a cape, a pair of boxing gloves, and a mask on anything and give it superpowers. This means that if you put these things on a tree, it will become the eco-avenger Treeman! If you give these to an inanimate object, they will come to life.
summary: The ability to put super clothes on another thing, granting it super powers
strengths: Create the eco-avenger Treeman
They will always be good
They'll protect you
weaknesses: Their ways of being good may be bad.

name: Uplift Pet
description: By concentrating on an animal that likes and trusts you, you can permanently raise that animal's IQ to 100 - the human average. The animal will retain all skills and memories it had previously, and will now understand your spoken language fully, but will now also be able to learn complex feats.
summary: The ability to give your pet a human-level intelligence
strengths: Nobody expects the dog to know lockpicking
Intelligence gathering galore - animals usually ignored.
They use the toilet now.
weaknesses: Still an animal. Smart, but no powers
May change mind about loyalty when it remembers paper training.
Except for monkeys, no opposible thumbs.

name: Four Eyes: Supernatural Sight
description: This power is gained by not using the Four Eyes power but having all the eyes open. The Four Eyes power will slowly turn into this power. Whenever all of your eyes are open you can see anything supernatural. It does not matter if the being or item is invisible or see-through, in your vision it will be opaque.
summary: The ability to see anything supernatural with one's eyes
strengths: You can see the supernatural.
You can still use the other Four Eyes powers.
This is an evolved form of Four Eyes.
weaknesses: Must have Four Eyes power and not use it's powers and have all eyes open.
Just because you can see them doesn't mean you can do anything about them.
You cannot get the other Four Eyes evolutions anymore.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Growth1)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of plant growth. As such, channeling Hegemone (Soil, Healthy Plant Growth) allows one to psychically perceive and manipulate soil, at will. In addition, one can psychically teleport to anywhere with soil, at will, as well as gain physical power by standing in soil. Furthermore, one can psychically prevent plant growth or manipulation, at will. One can even psychically summon plants through space-time, to help self/allies, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of plant growth and production
strengths: Psychically perceive, manipulate and teleport to any location with soil, at will
Gain physical power by standing in soil; Psychically prevent plant growth/manipulation
Psychically summon plants through space-time to help self/allies, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically manipulate plants (Agrokinesis), other than summoning them for help (NCN)
Pro #3 does not allow one to perceive and communicate with plants until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demeter's Touch and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Constellation Animator
description: With this power you can bring any constellation of stars to life it doesn't have to be a known constellation just any shape or figure you happen to see in the stars
summary: The ability to bring constellations to life
strengths: You can have some really cool things
weaknesses: You could have some really lame things (like dippers in assorted sizes)

name: Life Soundtrack
description: Your life now have a soundtrack it goes wherever you go and it always fits the situation you're in, you can make also other people hear the soundtrack. However, you cannot stop hearing the soundtrack yourself.
summary: The ability to have a soundtrack in your life that always fits.
strengths: Soundtrack always fits.
It can help you focus on something.
It can raise your awesome level in eyes of your friends.
weaknesses: You cannot turn it off, you don't hear it only when you sleep.
It can distract you sometimes.

name: Snap You're A Monster
description: With this power you can turn anybody into a mythical creature, cryptid or monster just by snapping saying their name and the desired creature eg. "John Doe, Dragon". Once in creature form they are not under your control and might even attack you but you can change them back by snapping and reversing what you said earlier eg. "Dragon, John Doe". All damage sustained in creature mode transfers over to human mode.
summary: The ability to turn people into mythical creatures, cryptids or other monsters
strengths: You can turn anybody into a mythical creature, cryptid or other monster by snapping
You can change them back
All damage sustained in creature mode transfers to human mode
weaknesses: They are not under your control

name: Induce Necrosis
description: You're able to induce the disease through touch, saliva, blood and breath. You can infect someone's lungs through breath, pass it into water supplies by using blood or saliva and kill someone in a matter of seconds (as the cells multiply and infect other cells quickly) by touching them. You're also able to reverse the process in your body and others' and can target specific cells in a body (e.g. fat cells).
summary: The ability to induce the disease necrosis (the death of living cells).
strengths: Ultimate assassin.
Able to affect someone from a distance.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to mundane ways of killing.
Cells die in air after a few minutes.

name: Babushkian Cloning
description: This power sort of lets you be like a russian nesting doll. You make one slightly smaller clone of yourself. That clone can make one clone slightly smaller than himself and so on and so on. The smallest clone of a clone can be no smaller than a nanomachine. If one clone in the clone chain is killed all the clones vanish. If a growth power is used on any of the clones,all the clones vanish. Using other copying powers on any of these clones also causes the chain of clones to vanish.
summary: The ability to make smaller and smaller copies of yourself.
strengths: A microscopic or smaller version of yourself could be useful.
A half-sized version of you could be helpful.
weaknesses: It takes time to get the smallest version of yourself.
One clone dies,all the clones die.
You can't make these clones any bigger in size.

name: Bioacoustic Disruption
description: Bioacoustic Disruption is the psionic ability to disrupt mechanisms of communication within species. One with this ability could psionically disable a foe's ability to speak or to hear, making communication extremely difficult. This ability could be used to render a person deaf (so that he can't hear warnings or understand people who try to talk to him) or mute (so that they can still hear, but they cannot respond back to what they are being asked or told).
summary: The ability to disrupt the ability to speak and/or hear
strengths: Girlfriends don't seem like such a bother anymore
Boss doesn't seem like such a bother anymore
May even disrupt communication mechanisms within machines so they cannot be used to type on, etc.
weaknesses: If you can't undo your power
If you can't control your power, it may backfire
If your boss's computer suddenly stops working, or responding to voice commands, you'll be blamed

name: Were Animal
description: At night after you pet a dog you turn in to a were-dog until sun-up. You can communicate with other animals of the same species, but follow instinctes of that animal
summary: The ability to turn into the last animal you petted at night
strengths: Find out what it's like to be a animal
weaknesses: Have to pet it

name: Cut Clone
description: Lets say you lose a finger. Not only will it grow back, but in about three days it will have grown a fully functioning clone of you! If you lose an arm or an entire lower half the wait time will decrease considerably. The more material and pain involved, the shorter the wait will be. Clones have all of your memories and skills and have a psychic connection to you.
summary: The ability to grow duplicates from severed limbs
strengths: Might save you from a normally mortal wound
Nifty free clone!
weaknesses: No help against bullets and the like
Still stand a good chance of dying if cleft completely in twain
Choosing between the pain or the wait

name: Fullmetal Alchemists:Envy
description: By gaining the abilities of Envy one gains numerous benefits. The first is a great shapeshifting ability, you are able to shape shift into a real or fictional person as long as they way less. You also gain incredible speed and strength, no matter what form you are in.
summary: The ability to gain the abilities of Envy.
strengths: Transformation.
Speed and strength.
weaknesses: If others become better than you, your envy shall get to the better of you.
Your eyes are your greatest weak spots.

name: Glucokinesis
description: Glucokinesis, also called Sucrokinesis, Saccharokinesis or Sugar Manipulation is the ability to manipulate sugar crystals. This includes moving it, moving substances containing it, forming it into crystalline constructs, changing it into various physical states, altering its presence in bodies (including within humans and plants) and the like. One could even whip it at foes with force enough to flay flesh, if enough is gathered.
summary: The ability to manipulate sugar
strengths: Sugar and anything sugary/sweet can now be used as a weapon
Flavor (sweeten) foods or remove excess sugar from foods (don't betray your diet)
Extract sugar from various sources (including from living organisms, and out of foods)
weaknesses: Eating too much sugar can be unhealthy
Crystallokinesis, when developed, can overpower this ability
People with Sugar Rush are immune to this ability

name: Neutrophil Granulocyte Mimicry
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers: an elastic body, the power to clone yourself while in combat mode and the power to distinguish friends from foes on a molecular level. You can detect hurt friends and enter combat mode as soon as you find them. In combat mode, you can stick to and absorb foes, killing them. You can absorb up to 25 foes, before you die. You can also produce a poisonous gas which only affects foes, paralysing them and slowly killing them.
summary: The ability to be attracted to harmed friends, stick to/absorb foes and produce a foe-specific poisonous gas.
strengths: You can sense if a friend is hurt and locate them. It even works if you are already in combat mode.
When you touch a foe, your body will stick to theirs on a molecular level until you absorb them.
You enter combat mode as soon as you find your hurt friend in order to defend them.
weaknesses: Once in combat mode, you're stuck in this mode.
If you absorb too many foes, you'll die.

name: Spiritual Converse
description: The gifted person can see, hear and communicate with ALL spirits (living and dead) from ALL forms of life. Spirits of deceased (both human, animal and plant), Spirits from nature, Spirits from the Elements, Angels, Demons, Gods, small spirits from All forms of energy, Spirits residing in flowers, trees, and anything living. The user can communicate both verbally and telepathically.
summary: The ability to see, hear and communicate with ALL spirits.
strengths: The user is gifted to be the diplomat between the natural and the supernatural.
The user can negotiate with troublesome ghosts and malevolent spirits of natural disasters.
The person is never alone and can use the spirits as intuitive messengers, and protectors.
weaknesses: Negotiations are not always 100%
The person has this uncontrollable ability to attract ALL spirits (good and bad).
Everything is making sounds. There is NO privacy or quiet time.

name: Gift Of Ezechiel
description:
It is said in the Bible that the prophet Ezechiel ate a scroll containing some divine prophecies: the scroll tasted like honey and after eating it he was able to report word by word everything was written there. 
Everyone who possess this power can eat every text (written on papery or another digestible support): in this way, the subject can learn by heart the text and repeat it word by word. Useful for students (XD).
summary: The ability to memorize every written text by eating it.
strengths: The subject is able to learn a big quantity of texts;
He also learns all the information contained in these texts;
He can bring back to memory every page or paragraph learned during his life by association of ideas.
weaknesses: Not every support is digestible, and also eating too much paper is not so healthy.
The text must be totally readable;
The risk of "information indigestion" is high; if taken too much information at once you risk coma.

name: Foe Cloning
description: When you defeat someone in battle you gain their shadow (a perfect likeness of him/her with all their powers). A few problems are: though you can collect any shadow, you can use only one at a time and you can't move while using it. If an enemy beats you you don't get their shadow, and magical people seem to be immune to it.
summary: The ability to contol any a clone of anyone you defeat
strengths: Control anyone you ever fought
You will be in two places at once
Instant shadow switches
weaknesses: If they beat you you'll NEVER get their shadow
Totally frozen in place while using
Most magic users are immune to having shadows stolen

name: Gift: Plants
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling plants than other beings. Thus their plant-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of plants from them. However, someone with this power can only receive plant-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of plants
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over plants as someone with this power.
Plant-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only plant-based powers now.

name: Half Tanuki
description: You will have racoon-like ears and a racoon-like tail. Your physical strength and speed will be higher than that of a normal humans. Your magical power will be boosted especially for shapeshifting and healing magic.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-tanuki
strengths: People will continuously want your help for healing.
weaknesses: People will hate the tricks you play on them.
Very obvious that you're not normal.

name: Gigantization
description: The opposite spectrum of shrinking. You can make things behemoth size--be it a person, building, animal, plant. They will grow to a max of 25,000 feet in height. Weight & mass all depends on what is growing. You use this power by touching whatever you want enlarged and it will increase size every second you touch. Living things might find it hard to breathe with increasing altitude & there's the whole "giant rampage" issue that could occur. The object retains its huge size for 12 hours.
summary: The ability to make objects or people larger in size
strengths: Make objects huge with physical contact
The max height is 25,000 ft (almost the size of Everest)
Clothes on people will grow too
weaknesses: Must keep touching for whatever to grow; can't grow yourself
Living things will find it difficult to breathe when growing too tall
People & animals might crush things

name: Leaf Form
description: With this power you can transform any part of your body into leaves, which you can then control freely. You can change your entire body into a pile of leaves and then move about freely as though sailing on the wind, reforming by bring the leaves back together. You can control what type of leaves you become, reform the parts of your body that the laves make up independent of your whole body, and heal yourself by applying real leaves to any wound to replace the part you lost.
summary: The ability to turn your body into leaves.
strengths: Heal yourself with leaves.
Change yourself into poison oak and fly around.
Midigate damage by transformin into leaves when struck.
weaknesses: Any leaves caught or lost will not be able to reform.

name: Superpower Trap
description: You have to be holding or touching an empty closeable container to activate this power. You can only capture superpowered beings and they must be in the vicinity. Once you have decided on your victim, every nearby superpowered being will hear the tune to 'Pop Goes the Weasel' in their head. At a random moment, the tune will stop and a clown will quickly emerge from the container, grab the victim and pull them inside. It works even with small containers and they can't escape until it is opened.
summary: The ability to capture superpowered beings.
strengths: Fun and suspenseful way to capture a superpowered opponent, regardless of the origin of their power.
The clown has depowering effects on the victim. So, it can even capture intangible beings.
The tune can hint at who may have a superpower as only they can hear it.
weaknesses: Only works if the designated victim has a superpower.
You don't know when the clown will emerge. So, the victim may have the time to flee.
Don't accidently designate yourself.

name: The Terrorizer
description: Imagine if you had the invisibility of Hawley Griffin, the vile methods of Mr. Edward Hyde, the vampirism of Count Dracula, and the immortality of Dorian Gray. With all of that, you can become a monster that'll strike fear into the hearts of good and evil alike. You can drain your opponent's blood, can spy on your enemies, could have brute intense strengh, and never die for a long time.
summary: The ability to transform into a horrifying being with dark various powers.
strengths: Nothing good can come from this ability.
weaknesses: Can accidently kill your family and friends.
Can forever become a vile lunatic.

name: Space Vehicles
description: With this ability you can turn your body into any type of space vehicle real or fictional such as a Space Shuttle, Star Ship, UFO etc.
summary: The ability to transform into any kind of space vehicle
strengths: You can travel through space
weaknesses: You can only travel through space while in vehicle mode

name: Sword Of Damocles
description:
A person with this power can create the sword of damocles that hangs above people's heads and drops when ordered by the user. 

Only the target and the user can see the sword. 
The sword grows bigger the more fear is exerted but not vice-versa. 

This power can be spammed.
summary: The ability to materialize a sword above the heads of enemies
strengths: Sword(s) always follows target and swords change direction to always hit the enemy
Can be spammed-tons of swords over a person or tons of swords over an army
With training, the Damocles sword can fall on other parts of the body or form a cage of swords
weaknesses: Sword(s) is only as big as a person's fear
If the sword becomes too big it will fall regardless of the user's commands

name: Super Acute Hearing
description: Your hearing, at will, becomes so acute that you can hear specific conversations across a sports stadium. You can hear a cats footfalls from a block away.You can hear an owl flap his wings from 1/4 mile away. With mastery, allows you to pick up other frequencies too.
summary: The ability to hear a pin drop from 1/2 mile away
strengths: You can hear what people are saying about you after you leave the room.
You can hear the tumblers on a safe drop into place.
You will hear people arrive at your door long before they ring the bell.
weaknesses: You can hear what people are saying about you after you leave the room.
You might not like everything tht you hear.
Loud noises can become deafening!

name: Super Squad: X Ray Heat Vision
description: See through things (again not clothes) and see heat. Owned by fictional superhero "Vision".
summary: The ability to see through things (not clothes) and see heat.
strengths: See through walls.
See heat in complete darkness.
Can see through skin to see diseases.
weaknesses: Can't see through clothes. (To some, it's bad. )
Can't see through mirrors.
The heat you see will be the heat your eyes are.

name: Eagle Shifting/Attributes
description: The Haast Eagle was the most powerful Eagle ever in the world. This eagle standing was 6ft tall and its wingspan was the size of a small air plane(2. 7m). It had a powerful beak and talons and it was very fast even though it was big like all birds it had amazing vision.  These are the attributes of the Haast Eagle
summary: The ability to shift into an Eagle and have the attributes
strengths: The user can shift into the actual versions of the Eagle or smaller ones
The user can have the attributes of a haast Eagle
weaknesses: Opponents can see the user clearly in the air even if its the smaller version
The smaller version of the Eagle is 6ft wingspan 3ft height (yikes)

name: Tetris Shift
description: With this power you can turn people into pieces from tetris. You can turn them into any of the pieces but to play the game you're gonna have to throw the people in the air and hope they fall in the right place.
summary: The ability to turn people into tetris pieces
strengths: You can turn people into tetris pieces
weaknesses: You cannot play the actual game Tetris with them

name: Doomsday Energy
description: A person with this power has a doomsday device planted in their body. However, their body has adapted to slow down the activation of the device and harness energy contained within the device for superhuman feats. The doomsday device is like a parasite that attaches to a person's heart and nerves. The user is given the ability to either slow down the timer for the device or hasten it and gain power. If the user dies before the device activation, the device recalibrates and looks for another host.
summary: The ability to harness the power of a doomsday device planted in your body
strengths: You can instantly vaporize anything you want-and I mean anything
You also gain enhanced strength and speed and the ability to travel and survive in a vaccuum
The timer is actually very long-about a zettayear and it recalibrates to a zettayear each time
weaknesses: If you overuse this ability, you will blow up the universe(no joke)
Stopping the doomsday device will kill you-heart stops and doomsday device will recalibrate anyway
The allure of power-hastening the device gives the user access to more power and abilities

name: Amber Eyes
description: Amber is a fossilized tree resin; some pieces of amber have prehistoric insect trapped inside the sticky sap. With this power, if you stare at someone for a long period of time, their body will be trapped inside your eyes like an insect in amber. They can be trapped there for as long as a month, and during that time, they cannot escape. You can trap a maximum of two people (one for each eye). This comes with a price; it will become slightly harder for you to see clearly.
summary: The ability to trap people inside your eyes
strengths: You can trap your enemies just by staring at them
You can keep them there for a maximum time of one month
They cannot escape their prison
weaknesses: They may try uselessly to escape, causing minor eyestrain
You can ONLY keep them trapped for a month
While someone's trapped, your vision gets slightly less clear

name: Messy Minions
description: You can create a number of useful organisms in any shape or form to do your bidding. They are fully aware and need no controlling but do require orders.
summary: The ability to create helpful sentient minions from ash, dirt, dust or soot.
strengths: You can have small tasks done without worrying about it.
You can spy on people without them realizing.
You can basically make your minions anywhere.
weaknesses: They are made of dust or dirt, they don't stand well in a fight.
They can't speak, so keep questions to yes or no.
They are dirty.

name: Xl
description: With this power you can turn anything into a version of itself that is ten times larger than the original object. Anything, food, clothing, animals, even people (although this is probably not healthy). You cannot however reverse the effects of this power.
summary: The ability to make anything into an extra large version of itself
strengths: Make things ten times larger
weaknesses: Can't reverse the effects of this power

name: Summoning To Shapeshifting
description: With this power you can change any summoning power that you have in your arsenal into an ability to shape shift into whatever it was that you were able to summon.
summary: The ability to change a summoning power into a shapeshifting power.
strengths: You can change your summoning powers into shape shifting powers.
weaknesses: You cannot reverse the effects of this power.

name: Bane To The Piggy's Existence
description: Have you ever wondered what something was made of? Well be glad you found this power! Bane to the Piggy's Existence is the ability to inhale anything (doesn't matter how big or small) and spit out everything it is comprised of in its original state. For example, if you inhale a table you will spit out a full grown tree and some metal! Now doesn't that make you want to huff and puff!
summary: The ability to inhale objects and spit out the elements those objects are made of.
strengths: Really helpful if you are in need of a specific material.
Since the objects shrink going in and coming out it doesn't matter how big your mouth is.
Also really useful for combat purposes. Inhale something on fire and you'll be spitting fireballs.
weaknesses: Obviously, it doesn't work if your mouth is covered.

name: Inverse Shapeshifting
description: With normal shapeshifting, you can turn into other creatures or objects. With Inverse Shapeshifting, you can turn other people into your look-alikes. They will have their own memories and personality, but they will look exactly like you.
summary: The ability to turn anyone into your identical twin.
strengths: You can confuse your enemies.
No quantitative limits: you can turn the entire mankind into your twins.
You can turn a more powerful enemy into your twin and make the chances equal.
weaknesses: They will get back to their original shape after 24 hours.
They will have your biological structure, so they can have some of your superpowers.
Your face will be well-known, if you use this power a lot.

name: Long Distance Sex
description: The ability to have sex with another person or partner in a different location, and yet it feels like real sex. They can feel, see, hear, taste, and smell you as if you were actually present in their location.
summary: The ability to make someone feel like they are physically having real sex with you at a distance
strengths: You can have sex with anyone
No possible way to get pregnant
Could greatly improve the success of your long distance relationship
weaknesses: Can't get pregnant from doing it
Person isn't actually there with you

name: Taste No Evil
description: You can enjoy eating the oddest foods and drinking things that aren't beverages, but you could sense spoiled snacks and spiked drinks by using your red-glowing taste buds and if it detects them you can devour them.
summary: The ability to be immune to tainted & poisonous foods while eating them.
strengths: You can't get poisoned and sick while trying to eat and drink anything else.
weaknesses: Some people might try to see you as disgusting and weird.

name: Bacterial Communication
description: Bacteria produce chemicals they use to communicate. With this power you can generate these chemicals to employ a variety of effects. You can program the bacteria with your powers to empower you or give you back your lost powers. You can make them join together and infect something, glow, aid bodily functions or attack. You can use this to create new strains and you can also make the bacteria form a cluster the size of a small dog to use as a weapon.
summary: The ability to control how bacteria and some cells communicate.
strengths: Versatile.
Heal yourself and others.
Make poisonous bacteria or ones that corrode things.
weaknesses: Healing is limited.
Try telling your friends that your job is bossing around germs.
Creepy.

name: Heart
description: If you love a person or creature enough, if they're not already immortal, and if you have this ability, you can immortalize that person or creature.
summary: The ability to make someone you love immortal
strengths: Cannot be reversed
The person you fall for can never die
You'll never lose your pets
weaknesses: Cannot be reversed
If you love someone and they dump you, you can't hurt them back
You and the ones you affect can still be murdered

name: Sensory Focus
description: With this ability, one can look in one direction, and focus on it to allow himself to hear everything in that specific location. Other sounds are faded out while the user is tuning. This takes minimal effort, however becomes difficult to do if the location is over 5,000 ft away. This also allows the user to see more vividly in that specific area, and he can zoom in closer to observe what he is looking at more easily.
summary: The ability to tune into sound and focus into a certain direction.
strengths: Tune in your ears and eyes to a specific location/direction.
Listen to faraway conversations.
Allows you to see objects more clearly.
weaknesses: May be triggered without much effort, causing it to switch on randomly.
Everything farther than 5,000 ft is much more difficult to tune in.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Growth2)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of plant growth. As such, channeling Auxo (Auxesia- Increase) allows one to psychically grow plants, and prevent or reverse plant growth, at will. In addition, one can psychically grow and replicate plants and plant matter (wood, paper, cotton, etc), at will. Furthermore, one can can grow roots, to ground oneself or absorb nutrients, at will. One can even psychically tap into trees, by touch, to grow in size, strength and durability.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of plant growth and production
strengths: Psychically grow plants, as well as prevent or reverse plant growth, at will
Psychically grow and replicate plants and plant matter, at will
Grow roots (ground oneself, absorb nutrients), and tap into trees' power to grow in size/power
weaknesses: Cannot psychically manipulate plants (Agrokinesis), other than manipulating growth (NCN)
Part 2 of Pro #3 cannot be shared with others, by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demeter's Touch and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Witch Species: Benandanti
description: In ancient Italy there was a type of witch called the benandanti, they had many abilities including. Sensing the good and evil in others, manipulating Karma, astral projection, super reflexes and super-healing
summary: The ability to have all of the powers of a benandanti.
strengths: An ancient and powerful race.
You can tell the kind of person someone is.
weaknesses: You don't have control over what happens to someone when you use karma manipulation.

name: Reptile Mimicry
description: Reptiles as a group are highly successful animals, having been around for millenia. A Reptile Mimic can manifest some of their adaptations at will, including scales, gecko-like climbing power, enhanced strength, a crocodile's bite, and a powerful tail. However, when they are in this form, they have slightly reduced intelligence and emotional capacity. They also are cold-blooded.
summary: The ability to manifest aspects of reptiles at will
strengths: Strength
Shock factor
People not wanting to start fights
weaknesses: All or nothing- all the aspects or none of them
Reduced humanity
May become estranged from loved ones

name: Fictional Vehicle
description: With this power you can turn into any fictional vehicle such as the Bat Mobile, the Goblin Glider, the Halberd, the Arwing, snow speeder etc.
summary: The ability to turn into any fictional vehicle
strengths: Can turn into any fictional vehicle
weaknesses: You can't turn into any real vehicles even if it has appeared in a movie, T. V. Show or comic book

name: The Balance
description: If you spot someone who is ill, injured and/or near death, you can miraculously heal them through touch and all their illnesses and injuries will disappear. However, there is a dire part to this power. As someone gets another chance at life, someone else in the vicinity will inexplicably die of something. You can heal that person too, bring them back to life, but again, someone else will die. You have a gift and a curse. It's a tease power of playing God. Order and balance must be set.
summary: The ability to heal anyone, but with a consequence
strengths: Can instantly heal or bring someone back to life
weaknesses: When you save someone, someone else will die

name: Bioluminescence
description: The ability to make the skin grow, also when cut the blood of a person with this power glows.
summary: The ability to make the skin (and your blood) glow
strengths: Great night vision
Skin doesn't break out
Able to create a visible path for others in the dark
weaknesses: If person doesn't know how to control it they glow all the time in the dark
Powers don't work well in light

name: Personal Power Deactivation
description: This power is very rare and very heard to find. Imagine having powers that you don't want and you want to torn them  of permanently. You choose any power you have and it is deactivated.  This power is not immune to ability cancellation or any ability that is similar to it. This power does not protect or defend you in any way.
summary: The ability to turn off any power you have at will
strengths: Make your self feel better
You can cheat very easily (pro & con)
You can use this power as much as you want
weaknesses: This power is nether offensive or defensive ( no con negation)
only the auther of the power can torn it back on (no con negation)
Only works on yourself

name: Prerecorded Precogition
description: When you record a video for someone to see or hear in the future, you're only saying your message. You don't know how the person would respond or what they would say. But that would change if you have this power. When you start recording, your vision moves to when the recording will be played. You will speak and act out your message, but you will see and hear only the future. You will know the future guy's responses, and so you could change your message accordingly, conversation-style.
summary: The ability to anticipate the responses to a recorded message
strengths: Have a conversation with your great-great-great-great-great-great (GASP! ) -great grandchildren.
Doesn't even have to be far into the future, it just has to be in the future.
You could look through the recording's eyes and see what the future is like.
weaknesses: People might think it's not a recording.
Others wanting to know about their great-great-great-great-great-great (GASP! ) -great grandchildren
Effectively useless in combat - More useful in a time capsule or something.

name: Bloodline Extreme
description: Can pass along one's power, knowledge, body form(shapeshift for this), etc through way of having another being consume one's blood. The only thing not passed along is your personality. The biggest possible cost is that the person has to drink an amount of blood equal to 52% of the blood in their body. The blood can be up to one week old.
summary: The ability to pass along almost everything about oneself to another by way of blood
strengths: All your power and knowledge get passed along.
Recipient can masquerade as you at boring meetings.
Blood doesn't have to be fresh.
weaknesses: You're most likely going to die unless it's a baby (50% of blood gone from body means death).
Vampires will love this.

name: Drug Mimicry
description: This ability can make the user become a liquid or gaseous drug. He be able to help heal people or give them the user's own brand of steriods. The user can give or take away side effects of the drugs that he gives out. He can heal himself and pump himself with steriods without feeling any side effects.
summary: The ability to mimic the properties of illegal or medicinal drug.
strengths: Have a liquid or gaseous form
Heal yourself and others of illness, pump them with steriod, or other drug uses.
Can give or take away side effects
weaknesses: Since you are chemicals, you are effected by temperature.
Just for a joke, People might do commercials about not taking you.

name: Double Vision
description: Have your opponent look you directly in the eye and he will see a complete double of whatever he is looking at. Like Naruto's Shadow Clone, with double vision, you can create a living clone that can hurt you even if it isn't the real one. But if the person decides to attack the wrong one, then it doesn't affect you.
summary: The ability to make your opponent see doubles
strengths: Can really confuse your enamy
Good if you are dealing in hand-to-hand combat
weaknesses: There is always a fifty-fifty chance of your opponant hitting you

name: Summoning Specialty
description: With this power whenever you use a power that doesn't normally summon something, you can instead choose to summon something based on the power's normal effect. Ex: 'Pyrokinesis' could summon a salamander, a phoenix, etc. 'Wolves to Werewolves' could summon wolves or werewolves.
summary: The ability to summon something with a power that normally does something else
strengths: You now have another choice on how to use each individual power.
You can control what you summon if you want to.
weaknesses: What you summon with a normally nonsummoning power is random.
Exception con 1: : "Rise of..." powers will summon what you would have transformed into.
Exception con 1: MythPowers: the channelled god.

name: I Can Hear You V2
description: With this power you will automatically be able to listen to any conversation that is about or in reference to you. The people talking do not even have to mention your full name for you to be able to listen in. You can turn this power on and off.
summary: The ability to be able to hear any conversation that is about you
strengths: You will be able to listen in on any conversation that is about you
The speakers do not even have to mention your name
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Craft Greater Semivif
description: You get craft material with this power by painlessly removing pieces of yourself by hand. Any lost pieces grow back in an hour. After this regrowth, you can start again. The semivif you make look like mannequins made of your guts and organs. They have your intelligence and are only affected by damage or powers if you are affected by damage or powers. You can have the invulnerability power and use this power. Any regeneration power will make the regrowth time for this power a second, not an hour.
summary: The ability to craft greater semivif servants.
strengths: These semivif can't be affected by anything unless you are first.
This power works with invulnerability.
weaknesses: If you're psionically stunned, all your semivif will be too.

name: Beauty's Scythe
description: Ever heard of how death is beautiful well this scythe lives to the name it grants the wielder incredible beauty and power. Though this scythe kills someone in a very beautiful way like the person will explode into flowers.
summary: The ability to wield the scythe of beautiful death
strengths: Can great beauty
Death is immortal
Do become death itself
weaknesses: Can only kill people who are meant to die
When all life dies so do you
Only the scythe's wielder get this power

name: Trees To Ents And Vice Versa
description: With this power you can turn trees into mythical tree monsters called Ents. The Ents are not under your control but may help you after much debilitating with the council. You can use this power on as many trees as you want and you can even turn Ents other than the ones you created into normal non monstrous trees.
summary: The ability to turn trees into Ents and Ents into trees
strengths: You can turn trees into Ents
You can turn Ents into trees
