weaknesses: The Ents are not under your control

name: Super Squad: Extra Vision
description: See cosmic powers, like that of the Silver Surfer, and magic, like that of Doctor Strange. Owned by fictional superhero "Vision".
summary: The ability to see cosmic and magic powers around you.
strengths: Can see cosmic and magic powers.
Can see if the cosmic or magic power is good or evil.
Can absorb it if it's a weak enough magic.
weaknesses: It feels as if your eyes are in chlorine.
Blind to all other things.
You go blind for ten seconds after using it.

name: I Can Hear You V3
description: With this power you will automatically know if someone is typing or writing something about you. You will know who the person is and what they are writing or typing. You cannot turn this power on and off.
summary: The ability to know when a someone is typing or writing something about you
strengths: You will know when someone is typing or writing something about you
You will know what the person typed/wrote and who the person is
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power on and off
You will not know who the person was writing or typing to

name: Ape Shift
description: Any change in your emotions or the emotions of anyone you care about will cause you to go Ape-Shift, transforming into a giant Silverback. You will be larger than any other ape and about 100 times stronger, optimally. Your sight, smell, taste and hearing will be off the charts. You will keep your intelligence. Well, as much IQ as any bipolar 8000 lbs gorilla can have.
summary: The ability to go Ape-Shift and transform into a super-strong 10-foot, 4 ton gorilla
strengths: When really frenzied, your already amazing strength doubles
All other non-human primates will look to you as their master & you can control them.
Leap and swing around any city like it is a concrete jungle.
weaknesses: Highly emotional in Ape-Shift. Any sudden change in emotions make you lose your mind
In a fight, you will not know when to stop & nothing but you can calm your beserker rage
The urge to throw your own feces is irresistible, even when you are human

name: Cytotoxic T Cell Mimicry
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers: an elastic body, the power to clone yourself while in combat mode and the power to distinguish friends from foes on a molecular level. While cloning, you can decide if the new clone stays in combat mode or reverses to normal mode. In combat mode, you will cause a foe's cells to die by touching them, but only if the foe is of the same species as you. Note that, with this power alone, you cannot enter into combat mode by yourself.
summary: The ability to kill cells through touch (only cells of the same species as yours and only in combat mode).
strengths: You can tell friends from foes on a molecular level, meaning you can't be fooled by shapeshifters.
You can kill or severely hurt a foe by touching their body.
Your elastic body makes you impervious to blows.
weaknesses: You can only kill the cells you're touching and only those of the same species as yours.
You cannot enter combat mode by yourself with this power alone.
You can't return yourself to normal mode and your killing ability is always active in combat mode.

name: Wudang Totem
description: The person with this totem is able to call upon the martial art skills of the animals that are inscribed on the totem, which is the tiger, the bat, the shark, the eagle and the fox. The ultimate form of this version is that the user will be able to change to the humanoid animal form of the animal that they are currently using. When you change to the humanoid animal form, you also gain that animal's natural ability.
summary: The ability to instantaneously learn the ways of the Wudang Warrior.
strengths: You know the ancient wudang martial arts.
You can transform into a humanoid animal form to give yourself more power to fight enemies.
weaknesses: Can only use one martial art at a time.
The humanoid animal transformation can last only for an hour.

name: Healer 7: Addiction Removal
description: With this power, the user creates a field 25 kilometers in radius which removes unwanted addictions in others. In addition, they can mimic the addictions of others within range they desire, such as exercise. The range expands by one meter each year and can be turned off at will.
summary: The ability to remove unwanted addictions and mimic desired ones.
strengths: Cure addictions such as alcoholism and tobacco addiction.
Mimic desired addictions.
No relapse into addiction.
weaknesses: Side effects are not cured.
Target needs to be willing to be cured.
If the target tries the substance again, they can become addicted once more.

name: Unwanted Effect Interception
description: With this ability, you can take on part of or all of an effect about to occur to someone as long as they do not want it. Underweight? Take some weight about to be gained over Christmas. Short? Take the effects of an unwanted growth spurt. This cannot grant you things such as superpowers or magic.
summary: The ability to intercept unwanted effects.
strengths: Fix the majority of your problems.
Take upon the failure of things, such as the failure to reproduce.
You can control what you take on and others benefit from this power.
weaknesses: You cannot gain things such as magic or superpowers.
This power may take a great deal of creativity.
This power cannot be modified by other powers.

name: Ventriloquist
description: This power allows you to make your voice come from another direction. It also allows you to perfectly mimic someone else's voice after hearing them speak. Though this takes focus & might be hard on your vocal cords at times.
summary: The ability to disguise your voice & make it appear to come from somewhere else
strengths: Fool people with your voice
Imitate someone else's speech pattern
Great for a ventriloquism act
weaknesses: Takes concentration
Your vocal cords may get tired

name: Poison Detection
description: With this power, you will be able to know when you're interacting with a poisonous substance. Poisons you are about to ingest will have an alarmingly bad taste to warn you. You will be able to smell any poisonous gases, even the odorless ones, like carbon monoxide. Dangerous radiations and colorless gases will have a color to you. You will be able to feel contact poisons through touch, even if the poison already attacked your nerves. The faintest gas leak will become audible to you.
summary: The ability to detect poison through your senses.
strengths: You will have a lot of clues to avoid poisoning.
You could save countless lives by warning people.
weaknesses: You're still vulnerable to poison.
You could be overwhelmed by the huge amount of poisons present in big cities.

name: Anger Augmented Shapeshifting
description: With this ability, you can shapeshift into any animal. However, it's harder to shift into more complex animals than it is simple ones unless you have enough anger. The strength of your forms also increases based on your anger.
summary: The ability to change into different animals / forms based on your anger.
strengths: Also allows you to shapeshift into human forms.
If you have other shapeshifting abilities, it also increases their power the angrier you are.
weaknesses: Doesn't become very strong until your anger rises.
The power itself doesn't include mythological / fictional entities.

name: Liquid Sweat
description: With this power you can turn your sweat into any kind of liquid. You can turn it into a drink so you can drink it or blood so you can make people think you're bleeding.
summary: The ability to turn your sweat into any liquid
strengths: You can turn your sweat into any liquid
weaknesses: You have to be sweating for this power to work

name: Legends: Anansi.
description: With this power, the user conjures the mythical forces of the legendary Anansi (literally meaning "spider"). As such, they become engulfed with the creature's magnificent might. The user can transform into a human-sized spider, possessing immortality, eight very long legs, metal-rendering fangs, superhuman speed and enhanced strength, adhere to any surface, shape-shifting, as well as generate magically-imbued illusions.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Spider God.
strengths: The power can be activated at any given moment.
The user becomes as powerful as Anansi himself.
The user is able to contend against the Gods with amazing powers!
weaknesses: The user may lose to a stronger God.
The user may grow insane due to the power of the Spider God.
The user may draw unwanted attention.

name: Wereliger
description: The curse of the wereliger. As such, your power is affected, but not entirely controlled by instincts. In your transformed state, you have increased strength, dexterity and agility, you also hold heightened senses and a healing factor, and last, you have razor-sharp claws and teeth. All of that and only you could be bitten or scratched by a radioactive Liger.
summary: The ability to transform into a beast that's half-lion and half-tiger.
strengths: Gain a new personality.
weaknesses: You can only acquire these abilities by being bitten or scratched by a radioactive Liger.

name: Myth Power: Persephone's Poise
description: Persephone (Kore), in Greek myth, was the goddess of bountiful produce in the spring and summer, and withdrawal of produce in the fall and winter. She was also Queen of the Underworld, alongside Hades. As such, channeling her allows one to accelerate/reverse plant growth, and communicate with plants, at will. In addition, one can mimic the powers of plants (photosynthesis, producing roots, thorns, leaves, plant-based pheromones and toxins, etc) at will. One even gains many underworld benefits.
summary: The ability to channel Persephone's command over the essence of spring's bounty and the depths of the underworld
strengths: Perceive, communicate with, grow, reverse growth of and mimic powers of plants; favored by nymphs
Withstand/disrupt all death-based, underworld-based or infernal powers (including MythPowers)
Offer a foe a pomegranate; the number of seeds eaten is the number of hours he will have bad luck
weaknesses: People with MythPower: Zeus Power and MythPower: Demeter's Touch are immune to this ability
People with strong death-based, underworld-based or infernal MythPowers can resist Pro #3
People with probability/chance/luck based MythPowers and Unpredictability are immune to Pro #3

name: Moon Blade 1st Form: Blood Red
description: Blade with a gold hilt, silver blade and a red jemstone set at the end of the hilt. To draw out say: "Moon Blade, First form Blood Red." Allows for blood manipulation abilities. Also, even a drop of blood on the red jem allows the sword to gain tremendous power against the owner of the blood.
summary: The ability to conjure a blade allowing blood manipulation.
strengths: Can be used with other moon blades. (same power)
Almost unstoppable once it has been exposed to the blood of the enemy.
weaknesses: Slightly less useful without enemy's blood.
Since it allows blood manupulation, the blood will most likely be yours, which will weaken you.

name: Thirteen Treasures: Whetstone
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. If a brave man would sharpen his sword on this whetstone, it would surely kill any man from which it drew blood.
summary: The ability to use the whetstone of Tudwal Gludwyd
strengths: Arm your friends with deadly swords.
Make any blade deadly.
weaknesses: Hard work.
Anybody can use the whetstone.
Won't work if you aren't brave.

name: Human Garden
description: With this power, you can become a human garden for anything that is put into your body. Whatever food you eat can start to grow out of your back, without taking any energy from you. This power works on objects that are not food as well, such as putting a blade in your mouth and then having blades sprout from your back. If you have part of an animal or person inside you, you can regrow their body but not their mind.
summary: The ability to grow from your body any object put into your body.
strengths: Have as much food as you need by regrowing what you eat.
Works on items that are not food, such as blades.
Can stop growing things at any point and detatch them from your body.
weaknesses: May be awkward to have many things growing from your body.
Speed of growth varies between people so you might be stuck with growing things incredibly slow.
Can only grow things that have recently been put into your body.

name: Prophet
description: With this power you can talk to God (whatever that means to you) and directly ask him/her/them anything you want; To gain insight into the past, the future and other vital information, to gain favors like healings and miracles, etc.; This power has no time limit and you can use it multiple times
summary: The ability to talk to your patron deity
strengths: You can talk to the god you worship
He might help you in battle if you become his friend
He might grant your requests
weaknesses: He might not want to talk to you
He might not grant any of your requests (a god can't be manipulated like an element)
He might want to smite you if you're corrupt (unless you worship an evil god)

name: 1 For The Money V2
description: With this power you can turn one object into the exact amount of money you or the person who most recently bought it for. You can only use this power once a day.
summary: The ability to turn one thing into its monetary value a day
strengths: You can turn objects into their monetary value
weaknesses: You can only use this power once a day

name: Blob Transform
description: Similar to blob mimicry, but different (and better). You can transform into a blob with something of a "cell membrane" (you can change and hold shape). You are blue and indestructible, and have a single eye. (your brain is combined with your cells that make up you). You can switch between your normal self and blob at any time.
summary: The ability to transform into a blob
strengths: Indestructible
Can eat things (anything)
You can see and hold shape
weaknesses: People can go through you
You have no muscle mass

name: Skeleton Key
description: Your fingers are the exact size, shape, and thinness to unlock anything you come across. The only thing you have to do is put your finger in the lock and turn.
summary: The ability to unlock anything with your bare hands
strengths: Never worry about locking your keys in a room.
Help the attractive damsel in distress who locked her keys in her car.
Pretty much unlock anything.
weaknesses: Horrifyingly mangled and hideous hands.
Hands so useless they can't do anything (pick things up, turn door knobs, hitchhike, etc.)
Combination locks baffle you.

name: Contained Blood
description: This power prevents your blood from leaving your body or, more precisely, your blood vessels. You could have a very bad cut or lose a limb, but at least you won't bleed. You can't even get bumps or hematomas. Since your blood doesn't leak from the blood vessels, it also coagulates more easily. However, it doesn't prevent things like poison or dirt from entering your body through your wounds.
summary: The ability to not have your blood leave your blood vessels.
strengths: Never lose any blood.
Great against mosquitoes, vampires and other blood suckers.
Never get internal bleedings, bumps, hematomas or black eyes.
weaknesses: You can't donate your blood.
You can't take blood tests.
Doesn't prevent your blood from being contaminated.

name: Eosinophil Granulocyte Mimicry
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers (cf. Other Leukocyte Mimics to know which ones). When you encounter a large foe (who can't be absorbed by Leukocyte Mimics), you enter combat mode. In this mode, you can release a corrosive gas. It can be used to dissolve foes to break them down and make them easier to absorb. You can also use it to crack walls to allow Leukocyte Mimics to come. Once you've released too much gas, you die. You also have protection against parasites.
summary: The ability to release a corrosive gas when faced with a large foe, one who can't be absorbed.
strengths: You can break down large foes to be absorbed by Leukocyte Mimics with eating powers.
You can form cracks on walls to create passages for Leukocyte Mimics (they have an elastic body).
This power gives you immunity against parasites
weaknesses: When you've released a lot of gas, you die.
The corrosive gas does not distinguish between friends and foes, so your friends can be affected.

name: Pokemon Trainer
description: Tired of playing pokemon for hours while constantly watching the girls next door, yelling at the t.v saying ''WHY CANT I BE HUGH!?'' Well, with this power you can have an army of pokemon at your disposal
summary: The ability to actually have any pokemon ever created in one pokeball
strengths: You dont have to fight
If one pokemon fails try another
Be the envy of all pokenerds
weaknesses: Can only have one pokemon at one time

name: Flower Walk
description: With every step you take flowers or plants grow in your footsteps. You can control which plant or flower grows if you concentrate but if you don't concentrate the flower will just depend on you mood or thoughts.
summary: The ability to create flowers or plants wherever you walk.
strengths: You hungry? Just concentrate on a fruit or vegetable and walk.
Plants and flowers grow instantly.
The plants and flowers survive and grow in any weather or condition.
weaknesses: Can't make up plants; they have to be real.
Looks kind of strange when flowers grow out of the sidewalk.

name: The Power Of Flowers
description: You can generate flowers (types of flowers may vary) that have a calming, pacifying effect on others. Some affected individuals may also become more affectionate and tolerant of others. The effects generally last an hour on average. The power may manifest in two ways: 1) a spray of flowers from the hands or 2) rapidly growing a bed of flowers under the target.
summary: The ability to generate flowers that calm and pacify others
strengths: A non-lethal, non-violent ability
Good for calming rioting individuals or crowds
weaknesses: Allergies
You may be called a hippie

name: Shapeshift: Kitten
description: Who hasn't wanted to change into a fuzzy little thing at some point in their lives? Well, now you can.
summary: The ability to transform into an adorable little kitten
strengths: If you're a guy, you know what girls do with little kittens, right? Right? =]
You still think like yourself when in kitten form.
Legally get high on catnip.
weaknesses: You can't really fight. At all.
You can't speak with your kitten mouth either.
Heaven help you if the animal pound catches you.

name: Critter Instinct
description: Your body is sort of like the animal you most resemble and you have all the same mannerisms. You don't turn into the animal, but you have the same instincts.
summary: The ability to be like an animal
strengths: If you're like a wolf, your vocal chords allow you to do a pretty wicked creepy howl.
Cat people can have night vision
weaknesses: It's uncontrollable: you never know which instinctive behavior is going to pop up next.
Froglike people inherit the amphibian's preferred diet...

name: Carbonylkinesis
description: Carbon monoxide is a colourless, odourless, and tasteless gas that can be lethal when inhaled. The gas can affect the user, but being able to control it they can keep it away from themselves.
summary: The ability to manipulate carbon monoxide.
strengths: Can speed up the process, force the gas into the victims blood.
It can't be detected by the victim, but the user can see it in a different colour.
The death can appear to be accidental.
weaknesses: The user must be very careful not to use it in a confined space, or inhale it.
It is harder to control, the more people the user is effecting.
It cannot be created nor destroyed, so it has to be gathered from the environment.

name: Myth Power: Priapus' Pride
description: Priapus (Priapos), in Greek myth, was the god of vegetable gardens and the fertility of animals associated with agriculture. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and manipulate vegetables, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command sheep, goats and bees at will. Furthermore, one gains physical power from eating vegetables and other garden-grown produce. Power use may cause involuntary erections.
summary: The ability to channel Priapus' command over the essence of vegetable gardens and fertility
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate with and manipulate plants that yield vegetables
Psychically perceive, communicate with and command sheep, goats, bees and other garden animals
Enhanced stats from eating vegetables; immune to MythPower: Aphrodisia and MythPower: Bacchanalia
weaknesses: Cannot root subjects to the ground (sprouting various vegetables) by touch until the higher levels
People with MythPower: Aphrodisia and MythPower: Bacchanalia are immune to this ability
People with plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Blades Of Pain
description: Basically, anytime one gets a wound it turns into a scar from which one can create a shadowy blade. The size of the blade depends on the size of the scar. However, one can still die from a losing their heart or being beheaded. This power can only be gained in one way: by being cut 10000 times in one day and surviving throughout all of the cuts.
summary: The ability to create dark blades from one's scars
strengths: Really powerful if used correctly.
Not truly immortality, but close enough.
weaknesses: Extremely dangerous to try to gain.
People will be scared of the one with this power.
You'll end up with lots of scars with this power.

name: Myo Virus
description: With this ability, you can infect people, plants, and animals with the Myo Virus. This causes them to grow, and become stronger until the user de-activates the Virus at will. Life forms with this Virus become increasingly aggressive the longer this virus festers. A life form can grow to a height of 1,000 feet before its heart stops, or dies. Once deactivated, they return to normal size and strength.
summary: The ability to infect life forms with a virus that makes them grow and become stronger the longer it festers.
strengths: Infect people, plants, animals, or yourself with this virus.
As the subject becomes larger, they will become stronger.
Can increase or decrease the speed of the Virus' effect.
weaknesses: Once the target exceeds 1000 feet, their heart fails, or they die.
Targets become increasingly aggressive as the Virus festers.
You can't deactivate the Virus unless you can see the infected target.

name: Snap You're An Animal
description: With this power, you can turn anybody into any animal by snapping, saying their name and the desired animal. For instance, "John Doe, Elephant". The person will then turn into the desired animal but is not under your control. You can turn the person back by snapping and reversing the phrase you said earlier. From the previous example, "Elephant, John Doe". All damages sustained in animal mode transfer over to human mode.
summary: The ability to turn people into animals
strengths: You can turn anybody into an animal.
All damages sustained in animal mode transfer over to human mode.
weaknesses: The animal is not under your control
If you do not know how to snap or are mute, this power is useless

name: A Life For A Life
description: If you have this ability, then you can use it to bring a dead person back to life or save the life of someone who's inches away from death ... if you allow someone else to die to replace them.
summary: The ability to give life to a dead or dying person in exchange for someone else's death
strengths: Save people's lives
Bring back the dead
weaknesses: Be responsible for a murder
Can only heal fatally wounded or diseased people

name: Zipper Shift
description: With this power you can turn any mode of opening something into a zipper. Door knobs, padlocks, combination locks, latches, etc. call all be turned into zippers for your opening and closing convenience. You can turn the zipper back into what it originally was whenever you like.
summary: The ability to turn any opening into a zipper
strengths: You can turn any opening into a zipper.
Great for bypassing locks.
You can turn it back when you're done.
weaknesses: This power has no effect on actual zippers.

name: Allergen Healer
description: With this power, you can cause any body to no longer have any allergies. You can "heal" them of their allergy to fur, pollen, tree nuts, peanuts, or anything else that they are/might be allergic to.
summary: The ability to heal people of their allergies
strengths: No more allergies
weaknesses: Allergists would be put out of work

name: Cat Morphing
description: You could turn part cat or become full cat. The cat you turn into is what fits your personality. You can be part cat or full cat any time you want and make other people part cat too!
summary: The ability to turn yourself or others into part cat or become full cat
strengths: Hearing better
Run faster
Have a real tail!
weaknesses: Out of control anger
Secret could be found
You could turn the world into cats!

name: Living Being To Toy Model
description: This power can affect plants and animals of any kind, but you must touch them first. It will be at a scale of 100 inches on the living being to 1 inch on the model.
summary: The ability to turn living beings into toy versions with a touch
strengths: An animal you dislike can be turned into a model.
Great with 'MythPower: Graces' Groove'.
Can reverse with 'Toy Model To Living Being'.
weaknesses: Cannot reverse without other powers.
Must touch the being in order to work.

name: Myth Power: Limos' Longing
description: Limos (Limus), in Greek myth, was the goddess of hunger and starvation. As such, channeling her allows one to accelerate metabolic processing of food, in self and others (productively, it can help maintain healthy weight; offensively, it can cause foes to rapidly starve to death, unless they eat constantly). In addition, one can induce or negate hunger at will (and sense and alter a person's appetite). Furthermore, one can totally withstand the need to eat and drink; it is impossible to starve.
summary: The ability to channel Limos' command over the essence of hunger and starvation
strengths: Cause foe to starve, and help self and allies maintain healthy weight
Induce or negate hunger (or hunger pangs) at will; sense and alter what a person is hungry for
Freedom from hunger or thirst; inability to starve, or suffer from malnutrition
weaknesses: Cannot cast illusions of what a person is hungry for until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot share hunger and thirst immunity by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Excalibulg
description: With this power, you wield an extremely powerful club that can smash and pierce through anything like butter, spraying tons of blood everywhere.   This weapon is also very heavy.   You can also resurrect anyone that you have killed this way, by reversing time afterwards then restoring everyone's memories.
summary: The ability to wield Excalibulg (the fusion of Gae Bulg and Excalibur)
strengths: Very very dangerous weapon
You can kill someone first and then resurrect them to heal them
If you kill yourself with Excalibulg, you can choose to resurrect yourself
weaknesses: Blood and guts
Need to be very strong to use

name: Rise Of The Alternate Legends
description: With this power you can turn into alternate or different versions of Legendary Pokemon. You can turn into Primal Dialga, Shadow Lugia, Baby Lugia (aka Silver), Shiny versions of legendaries, the Golden Ho-oh from the first episode of the anime, Green Gem Deoxys and the monster Groudon from Jirachi: Wish Maker. In Pokemon form you retain your personality, intelligence and ability to speak.
summary: The ability to turn into alternate forms of Legendary Pokemon
strengths: You can turn into powerful forms
You retain your personality, intelligence and ability to speak
weaknesses: You cannot turn into the normal forms of the Legendaries

name: Poison Dart Strike V3 Monsters
description: With this power you can shoot poison darts from your hands but they only effect monsters (werewolves, vampires, Bigfoot, zombies, dragons etc. ) the darts paralyze the victim for up to twenty minutes
summary: The ability to shoot poison darts from your hands
strengths: While the monster is paralyzed you can easily slay it or save somebody from it
weaknesses: After the twenty minutes the monster will probably kill you

name: Know Demons
description: With this power you will know when a demon is nearby. The location of the demon must be within 10 kilometres. You will know how powerful the demon is, what type of demon it is, what powers it has, what it looks/sounds/smells like, and what it eats. This information pops into your head and disappears when the demon is out of range.
summary: The ability to know when a demon is near
strengths: You know when a demon is nearby.
Knowing where a succubus/incubus is to avoid her/him.
If you can counter the demon's powers and fight it on even terms(do this only if strong enough).
weaknesses: This power doesn't help with combat.
You have to research how to get rid of or keep the demon away on your own.
This power isn't really useful except for demon hunters.

name: Shape Journal
description: With this ability, any form you take is recorded, allowing you to assume it once more. This applies not only to shapeshifting, but also things like Reincarnation Determination and even transfiguration curses; you can change back at will and assume the cursed form as you choose. Partial shifts are also possible, but they may require more practice.
summary: The ability to record all forms you have taken in the past and shift into them at will.
strengths: Perfectly replicate any form you have ever taken.
This power will allow you to return to your old form if you lose other shapeshifting powers.
Makes your default form easy to remember.
weaknesses: You'll need experience before you can do partial shifts between forms with this power.
You need to have been altered in the past, by yourself or an external force.
Does not apply to mundane changes, such as aging.

name: Evolution Vision
description: The power to see a animal's future form just by looking at it. You can see any next evolution, as well as any next change in the environment; the reason an animal evolves. It makes a picture in your mind of the animal's or the environment's next evolution.
summary: The ability to see a animal's future form
strengths: See all kind of cool animals
weaknesses: May not like what you see

name: Cartoon Looks
description: Kinda like shape-shifting. You can look like any cartoon character. The complex part is that it's a real life version of the character.
summary: The ability to look like the real life version of a cartoon character
strengths: Good-looking cartoons characters
Don't have to worry that your disguise is a person that already exists
weaknesses: Ugly cartoon characters

name: Phrase Replacement Service
description: There are many powers that require you to say, write, sign or hear certain words or phrases to activate or cause an effect. This power allows you to assign a new word or phrase to those kinds of powers, entirely replacing what you needed to say before. For example, with Object Summoning, you could assign the phrase "my wife" to replace the word "anvil", so you'll summon an anvil whenever you say "my wife". However, you won't summon anvils by saying "anvil", nor your wife when you say "my wife".
summary: The ability to assign new words or phrases to powers involving the use of words or phrases.
strengths: Assigning a new word to a power will only affect that power, not the other ones you may have.
Trick your enemies by causing effects entirely unrelated to the contents of the word or phrase.
You can replace a single word with a phrase and vice versa.
weaknesses: Assigning a new phrase means the old phrase lost its use and the new phrase lost its old use.
You may complicate the activation of those powers, as they had a certain logic to which word to say.
You can only change the word or phrase, not the way it must be used (spoken, signed, heard,... )

name: Screamer
description: Every note on the scale you scream induces a different effect upon those who hear it. Low C-low level anxiety and shortness of breath, D-high level anxiety and panic attacks, E-dizziness and vertigo, F-nausea and stomach cramping, G-severe headaches and fatigue, A-blindness, B-euphoria and eventual stupor, high C-the listener to visually hallucinate. By rapid oscillation between two notes one can combine effect.
summary: The ability to cause varying physiological effects by screaming musical notes
strengths: What do you think?
weaknesses: What do you think?

name: Enhancement: Healing (B)
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. While attached, it changes the effect of the power to cause it to heal physical bodies instead of the original effect. Can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to change the effect of a power to healing physical bodies
strengths: Easy to do mass healings with Omni-Directional Blast.
Destructive powers can now have a second use.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
A fireball that heals might be a little odd.

name: Rise Of The Yeti
description: With this power, whenever you're in trouble, you can just into the super powerful Yeti of the Himalayans to fight crime.
summary: The ability to turn into a yeti at will.
strengths: you are super strong
You're always warm in yeti form because of all of that fur
weaknesses: People might mistake you for a monster and attack you

name: Living Clothes
description: Clothing will only resemble actual living creatures if it is shaped like one. When it's not fed, the creature will hibernate until it is worn, at which point it becomes a parasite and feeds off of the host until they've eaten sufficiently. However, it will enhance body functions like respiration and immunity.
summary: The ability to turn clothing into living creatures
strengths: Clothing is still wearable
Will benefit the host while acting as a parasite
Each can have an ability given to it by its creator
weaknesses: Reduces Stamina when acting as a parasite
Feeds off of fabrics
Cannot be turned back into regular clothing

name: Rise Of The Demon
description: With this power you can turn into a powerful fire breathing demon at will
summary: The ability to change into a demon at will
strengths: Scare enemies
Super strong
Breath fire
weaknesses: Sometimes the change happens unexpectedly and against your will
Sometimes the demon gains a mind of it's own

name: Closed Book Reading
description: You would have the power to read books which are closed. You could read any book without ever touching it.
summary: The ability to read closed books.
strengths: No tired arms or sore necks.
No page turning.
Read in secret.
weaknesses: Still read at a normal pace.
Not incredibly useful?
Can't see through anything else.

name: Artifact: Sica Shishikushiro
description: Whenever you say "Adeat", a sword appears. You can split this sword into 15 copies and control them in anyway you want.
summary: The ability to summon a blade and clone it into 15 copies.
strengths: Can fight multiple people at the same time.
Can hit a target more than once.
Have extra weapons just in case one gets broken.
weaknesses: Takes concentration to control all of them at once.
You may have more swords than you know what to do with.

name: Lazarus Egg
description: It has the ability to permanently heal the injuries of another, revitalize anyone's youth, and in many cases, resurrect the dead. For maximum efficiency, a side effect, unlikely however, was that it will make you clinically insane.
summary: The ability to use it for healing and extended life.
strengths: Could be a use for healing and resurrecting yourself and others.
weaknesses: It can make go you insane once you are healed or brought back from the dead.

name: Needle Grass
description: When this power is activated, every grass in your surrounding straightens up and becomes as hard and as sharp as a metallic needle. Fortunately for you, the grasses against which you're are pressing will soften so you can't get hurt. With enough experience, you can affect a specific area of grass with your power. It doesn't work on artificial turf.
summary: The ability to cause grasses to be as sharp as needles
strengths: Your enemies are going to hate fighting on a lawn
A perfect partner for a user with a plant growth inducing ability.
weaknesses: Urbanization makes areas of grass rarer, so you have to become more environmentally aware
Fighting against a flying enemy or a witherer

name: Celeb Shift
description: With this power you can turn into any famous person including athletes, writers, movie stars, singers, actors, producers, comedians, animators, artists, coaches, inventors, developers etc. As long as they're still alive when you're using the power
summary: The ability to turn into any celebrity
strengths: You can get into Hollywood parties
You can get into almost anything if you turn into the right person
weaknesses: People might realize that you're not the real deal

name: Were Hyena
description: When you are bitten by a cursed hyena, you can transform by laughing real hard by night (you cannot even stop yourself from doing it). You'll forever be a cannibalistic monster which terrorizes people, especially lovers.
summary: The ability to shape-shift into an anthropomorphic hyena.
strengths: You could mesmerise victims with your eyes or sometimes with your pheromones.
Become a blood-thirsty anti-hero or a sarcastic villain.
weaknesses: You can't stop youself from laughing real hard when transforming.
Can be a threat to both good and evil alike.

name: Home Planet Shift
description: Whenever you use this power you are teleported to a lifeless part of your universe and you turn into an exact copy of your home planet with exact copies of all of the people and places from your home world. The clones are exactly identical to the originals, except there is no clone of you. You control all the clones and things that happen on your world. You can control what people think, change the weather and cause natural disasters etc. When you're done you're sent back home and changed back.
summary: The ability to turn into a copy of your home planet
strengths: You can turn into an exact copy of your home planet and you control everything that happens on you
When you're done you're turned back to normal and sent back to your real home planet
weaknesses: You're not actually controlling people or things just clones of them

name: Weapon Provider Shift
description: With this power you can turn into anybody who has ever provided you with a weapon, weather it be your father who gave you your first bebe gun or the arms dealer who sold you your first shotgun or anybody else who has ever given or sold to you any type of weapon. While in this form you get any of their powers (if they have any) and skills while retaining your normal intelligence and knowledge
summary: The ability to turn into anybody who has ever provided you with a weapon
strengths: You can turn into anybody who has ever provided you with a weapon
You have all of their powers and skills
You keep all of your knowledge and intelligence
weaknesses: It does not work if you stole the weapon from that person
Only works with items normally classified as weapons (guns, swords, arrows) not anything that can be
Used as a weapon

name: Wendipire Shapeshifting
description: This ability is both a gift and a curse. You have all the powers and abilities of both a wendigo and a vampire, plus you will possess their weaknesses, except for sunlight. You have the curse of the wendigo, not the vampire.
summary: The ability to shapeshift into the hybrid of both a vampire and a wendigo
strengths: You can turn people into wendipirse too, but only if they survive the attack
You possess the powers of both a wendigo and a vampire
You will be powerful in time
weaknesses: You drink blood and eat the hearts of lovers and people who have good hearts
Good-hearted people and lovers will be afraid of you

name: Cookakinesis
description: Cookakinesis is a funny power that lets you create any kind of food you want using any kind of object around you.
summary: The ability to create any kind of food from any object around you.
strengths: You'll never go hungry
You could end world hunger.
Great at barbecues.
weaknesses: You usually become over weight.
To much and you'll upchuck
Just dont use the power on the ground or else the whole earth will turn into a giant cheeseburger

name: Sound Vision
description: Can see where all sound is coming from
summary: The ability to see sound
strengths: Always know who's talking
Can locate people hiding
You know when sombody's faking a voice
weaknesses: If too many people talk, you can temporarily be blinded.

name: Conversation Skip
description: In the overview.
summary: The ability to skip any converstion between one human and another.
strengths: You can skip arguments.
weaknesses: You have to be listening to the conversation.
You might miss something important

name: Myth Power: Horae (Agriculture)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of plentiful production. Channeling Pherusa (Pherousa- Substance), one can psychically generate organic matter, at will. Channeling Euporia (Euporie- Plenty, Abundance), one can psychically increase the size and/or amount of present organic matter, by touch, at will. Channeling Orthosia (Orthosie- Agricultural Prosperity), one can psychically increase the quality of any organic matter, healing animals and plants, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of agriculture and bountiful, abundant produce
strengths: Psychically generate organic matter, at will
Psychically increase the size and/or amount of present matter, by touch, at will
Psychically increase quality of organic matter, to heal plants/animals, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically decrease or degenerate organic matter (NCN)
Cannot make living creatures TOO much larger than normal until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically create or replicate living creatures until developed (NCN)

name: The Demon Bloodline
description:
Only a selective few have this power in my fictional saga Eternal Myths. It can:
1. utilize the same properties as The Ultimate Light, only demonic versions.
2. automatically gives the user wings and horns.
3. allows anyone who comes into contact with it's DNA to possess the Demon Bloodline.
summary: The ability to possess demonic powers and to control the darkness
strengths: said to be one of the most powerful power
who needs fear of heights when you got demon wings
weaknesses: powerful negative forces will corrupt you
lack of control can cause global destruction

name: Rise Of The Transformers
description: With this power you can turn into any Transformer from any kind of media (TV, comics, games etc.) You can even change into the triple changers in order to fight (or commit) crimes however the downside if you can only turn into their robot forms
summary: The ability to turn into any Transformer.
strengths: Transformers!!!
If you turn into a Decepticon or an Autobot, you don't turn good/evil
weaknesses: you cannot turn into their vehicle/alternate modes

name: Staircase To Escalator
description: With this power you can change staircases into escalator (and vice versa). This could be useful if you like moving in upwards or downwards directions without actually moving.
summary: The ability to change staircases into escalators (and vice versa)
strengths: You can change staircases into escalators (and vice versa)
Laziness!
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Default Form
description: With this power you can see a person's default or normal form. If the person is a shapeshifter you have the ability to see their normal form, if they're in disguise you can see what they look like normally, if they're hidden behind a hologram or mirage you can see through it. If a person is an extension or puppet of a third party force you can see that person. You can turn this power on and off. You can also cause a person to revert to their normal or default form.
summary: The ability to see a person's default/normal/true form and then make them return to it.
strengths: You can cause a person to revert to their normal form.
You can tell if a person is a shapeshifter.
If someone is being possessed by something you can see that thing.
weaknesses: Not good to use at costume parties.
Not much use in physical combat.

name: Cloning Bite
description: Typically possessed by some insects and some arachnids, one with this ability must bite a living host. After a period of incubation, a dozen duplicates will emerge from each bite wound. If the duplicates are extracted before they are fully formed, they will die and won't be replaced. Humans and big animals are not usually meant to have this power as they need be able to open a wound with their teeth and find a big enough host to bring their clones to term. It won't work if the host is too small.
summary: The ability to clone yourself by biting a living being and having your clones emerge from the bite wound.
strengths: Fast and creepy way to reproduce yourself.
Since the human population is increasing, it's very easy to find a host.
The duplicates will be at the same metamorphosis stage as you when you bit the host.
weaknesses: Since the duplicates are identical to you, you all have the same weaknesses, especially pesticides.
You could disturb the balance of an ecosystem.
If you're a big animal, there won't be many situations where this power will be useable.

name: Superhuman Olfaction
description: In comparison to other animals, humans are blind. A person with Superhuman Olfaction can enjoy a whole new spectrum of experience. Their sense of smell is as a scenthound's; 6 million times human strength. As such, they can track an object coonhound-style, draw minute details from scents, find food from miles away, and actually sort of smell the chemical mix that is fear. However, they are more sensitive to incapacitating smells, like sulfur or drying tar.
summary: The ability to possess an incredible sense of smell
strengths: 6 million times normal strength
Determine tiny details from a single whiff of the scene
Find food or track foes
weaknesses: May rely a bit too much on smell and not on other senses
Sensitive to unpleasant smells
Explaining to others how you know that the A-1 sauce is generic brand

name: Star Reclassification
description: With this power you could make the sun an O class star(a blue super-giant) or the lowest class, an M red dwarf. The planets automatically change orbit, so life on Earth is always safe. Life adapts to the new light spectrum. Plants survive under the new sunlight. All animals may just see infrared (if living under a red dwarf). The new sun, if a normally unstable star, is perfectly stable under this power.
summary: The ability to change a star's spectral class without harm to life on any planets.
strengths: Make a day on Earth last hundreds of hours or more.
Make a year last thousands of years or more.
A summer that last years.
weaknesses: Imagine winter that last a 100 years...
Sunlight fearing creatures will be a big problem when there's weeks of nighttime.

name: Herbology
description: Herbology is the art of using and caring for magical plants. Anyone with this ability will have full knowledge of all sorts of magical plants and herbs. Also, they will possess a sort of magical green thumb. Whenever they plant a magical seed of any kind, it will grow faster than normal, growing to full size in a fourth of the time. The user can use these herbs for many things, suchs as breathing underwater, healing, or fire-starting.
summary: The ability to employ the art of herbology
strengths: Will have full knowedge of herbology (what they need to grow, where they can be found,etc. )
Other powers can be gained
weaknesses: Very hard to find magical plants
Caring for hundreds of herbs and plants

name: Weapon: Sword Of Tristain
description: With this sword, the user can heal themselves from any injury as long as they are fighting for love.   Poisons and anything that does continuous damage are only delayed, not permanently healed
summary: The ability to wield the sword that was used by Tristain
strengths: Almost invincible, except against poisons and the like
Sharp enough to slay dragons
weaknesses: If you are not fighting for love, then the effect is negated and the sword can break
Not a divine class or magic class weapon

name: Phone Fingers
description: All you need to do is make like you're holding a phone using your thumb and pinky finger, think of whoever you want to call, and boom, their phone will ring.  You can have a full conversation with perfect reception, and worldwide coverage. No dropped calls and no battery to worry about! When someone calls you, your fingers will ring--unless of course you have them on vibrate or silent mode. And to top it off, you can change your number to whatever you want (as long as it isn't already taken).
summary: The ability to call anyone just by holding your fingers in the shape of a phone.
strengths: Emergency calls during common situations like avalanches, meteor storms and stampedes of goats
Prank calling Santa Clause and Paris Hilton
Drunk dialing
weaknesses: You never have the excuse of "I couldn't find my phone"
You might look funny talking into your hand
Drunk dialing

name: Chemical Reanimator
description: This power gives you retractable needles from your hands that can inject a glowing green liquid into a dying or dead person. There can be no brain damage. The reanimated will lose 10% of their IQ for each hour after their death. There can be a loss of basic civilized behavior -- even if you inject a dying person -- that causes loss of feeling guilt or lack of conscience. You could make someone zombie-like in behavior. These reanimated won't decay, age or heal.
summary: The ability to reanimate someone with a glowing green liquid.
strengths: A way to help someone cheat death. A horrible way, but still cheating death.
You can use this power on yourself if you're that desperate not to die.
weaknesses: You actually use this power on yourself.

name: Taste Warp
description: With this power you can change the taste of any food this is good for making the disgusting food you're eating taste like pizza or something or to make the delicious food your enemies are eating taste like something gross
summary: The ability to change the tastes of any food
strengths: The pros are listed above
weaknesses: No use in combat

name: Communicate With Dogs
description: With this power you can speak to and be fully understood by canines. Also, you can comprehend exactly what a dog is saying. That means you can carry on a conversation with a dog or you will understand what the dog behind the fence is yelling(barking)about!
summary: The ability to speak to dogs and hear what they are saying
strengths: You will know which well Timmy is in.
You will know which food your pet likes best.
You can explain why chasing cars is a bad idea.
weaknesses: You'll hear French Poodles accents !!
Needy pooches that want to talk amd talk and talk
Bitchy lap dogs

name: You Are What You Eat.
description: With this power you become like anything you are able to eat. This can range from plants to animals or even items that are normally not food. You will not directly turn into the object that you eat, but gain some of its characteristics. So if you somehow are able to eat a house, you would be able to open up your body and have dollhouse-like rooms inside you. You can only take on the characteristics of one thing at a time and can choose when the power activates.
summary: The ability to change your body so that you become like anything that you eat.
strengths: Gain the characteristics of whatever you eat.
Works on nonfood items as well.
Effect lasts for as long as you wish.
weaknesses: Need other powers to be able to eat non-food objects.
Can only gain the characteristics of one thing at a time.
Usefullness of this power depends on what you are able to eat.

name: Robot Detector
description: With this power you can detect is somebody or something is a robot just by looking at them. The robot will look bright green to the person with this power thus signifying that it is a robot. This power does not work on shapeshifters taking the form of robots but it does work on alien robots.
summary: The ability to detect if somebody or something is a robot just by looking at them
strengths: You will know if there is a robot near you
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power off so any robot you see will always look bright green to you

name: X Slash
description: Using this power, anything you cut, gets cut in an X pattern. Depth and length of the X are determined by depth and length of original cut. This makes more blood flow out so that the person faints/dies faster. This power is automatic and will not turn off.
summary: The ability to make it look like something was cut in an X-pattern
strengths: Faster kills.
Works with anything that can slash or cut.
weaknesses: Have to spend more time and bandages to keep a captive alive.

name: Beta Cell Mimicry
description: This Mimicry belongs to the islets of Langerhans. You can produce insulin, which lowers the level of blood sugar, and amylin, which prevents nutrients from entering the bloodstream. You can inject a dose of any in anyone through touch. You can also force Hepatocyte, Myocyte and Adipocyte Mimics to store sugar (as fat for the third one), and stop Adipocyte Mimics from using their fat and Hepatocyte Mimics from releasing their sugar, but giving the latter the power to release sugar as fatty acid.
summary: The ability to produce and inject insulin and amylin, as well as trigger new abilities in other Cell Mimics.
strengths: You can help people suffering from hyperglycemia or type 1 diabetes.
You can give new abilities to Hepatocyte, Myocyte and Adipocyte (both white and brown) Mimics.
You can use the insulin and amylin you produce on yourself.
weaknesses: After a while, the body of those injected with insulin can counteract its effects.
It only works on humans and other species with a genome similar to human's, such as mice.
You can only undergo mitosis when united with all the other Mimics of the islets of Langerhans.

name: Rooster
description: With this power it's close to the power of the werewolf accept it's during the day and your can easily control the changes to fit your willpower. You morph into a hybrid form with the legs and spurs of a rooster you grow wings which help you run really fast. Plus you can create shock waves by crowing which acts as a good long range weapon. Your overall form will be mostly human though. Feet can grab things like hands and with the wings you can glide for short distances, fall great height safely
summary: The ability to crow Super sonic shock waves and take on a hybrid human/rooster form.
strengths: Super Sonic shock waves, annoy the neighbors every morning and controling the power.
Wings and legs help you run really fast, Glide and fall far without injury
Great balance and feet can be used like extra hands,Spurs on your feet act like peircing weapons.
weaknesses: You look like a chicken/man!
People think you may be tasty when fried and smothered in Bull's Eye.
Feathers are itchy.

name: Dog Shift
description: This power changes you into a dog. The type of dog you change into will determine on your personality. Ex. If you're a tough cop with an angry attitude, German Shepard. If you're a sissy, a poodle. If you're a cute little baby, a puppy! However, you will have animal urges. You can switch to dog form any time you want, but you may be so happy in it you'll never want to change back. (I have nothing against cats or poodles.)
summary: The ability to change into a dog
strengths: Sniff around for fun
Run really fast
weaknesses: Doggy urges
Avoid cars
Bad news for cats

name: Exclusive Uniqueness
description: For reasons still unknown, the universe cannot acknowledge more than one of you, meaning that no one who intentionally looks like you can ever exist. So, any clone, shapeshifted version, doppelganger, look-alike of you disappears the moment they are created. The copies must have been created with the purpose of copying the user. If it was accidental or a coincidence, nothing happens. Same thing if you copy someone or something else's appearance, unless someone then tries to copy your new look.
summary: The ability to have only one of you in the whole universe.
strengths: Protection against shapeshifters and cloners.
Don't worry about impersonators.
A combo with Inverse Shapeshifting would be deadly.
weaknesses: Only works if your appearance is copied.
If you are split into copies of you (in which case the original you disappears), you cease to exist.

name: Biological Manipulation
description: With this, you can manipulate cells and DNA. You can heal injuries of any extent, cure diseases of any kind no matter how severe, change any physical deformation, change the actual genetic structure of living organisms, create clones, accelerate child growth, etc. A beginner can only affect through touch, but an advanced user can project beams. These beams you usually warp the air, making the beams partially visible. People may be enraged that you're using God's power.
summary: The ability to manipulate the aspects of living organisms.
strengths: Be a famous doctor
Can take away superpowers
People might worship you as a God
weaknesses: People might go into a rage by your presence
Can only take away superpowers embedded in the genes
Must know what you are doing

name: Animal Power Gifting
description: This power may sound silly but think of it like this: If your pet got lost in the woods, wouldn't you be worried that they might die out there? Well, with this power you can give them super powers once you realize that they are lost. You can give them powers and when they come back, you can take the powers away.
summary: The ability to temparly give animals super powers no matter were they are
strengths: You don't have to worry as much about your pets.
Your dog can defend you better.
Your pet will be number one.
weaknesses: You can't use this power on humans or your self.

name: Rise Of The Ghostfreak
description: With this power you can turn into a ghost-like alien that resembles Ghostfreak from the 'Ben 10' Series.
summary: The ability to turn into a Ghostfreak like alien
strengths: Invisibility
Intangibility (possibly also the power of Possession)
Flight
weaknesses: You may lose control of this form and harm innocent people

name: Usurpation: Demon
description:
This power allows you to temporarily usurp all powers of a single demonic entity, leaving it completely powerless in the process. Your appearance will change to reflect the demon whose powers have been borrowed for the time (i. E. : growing of claws, tails, horns,.. )
You gain their powers at exactly the same level of the original demon. Line of sight is required, otherwise you will gain the powers of a random being who could be anywhere at the moment. You have no knowledge when Usurpation ends.
summary: The ability to temporarily usurp all powers of a single demonic entity.
strengths: Channel infernal powers without selling (or endangering) your immortal soul
Strike fear into the hearts of mortals
Knowledge what you can and can't do with "your" powers
weaknesses: Depending on the strength of the demon, usurpation may only last a few minutes
Demons will try to kill you, unless you use the powers for nefarious evil deeds
Angels might consider you a demon yourself, or will try to recruit you to fight the demons

name: Whisper Point
description: With this power you can cause people to whisper instead of talking or yelling by pointing at them. This is useful if your enemy has discovered your secrets and is announcing them to the world you can point at him so he whispers so nobody can hear him and then beat him up later with a different power or something.
summary: The ability to make people whisper by pointing at them
strengths: You can make people whisper just by pointing at them
weaknesses: As soon as you stop pointing at them they continue talking at the volume they were talking at before

name: Trash Into Trees
description: With this, you can help the environment and hit people all at the same time! You would be the new Mother Nature.
summary: The ability to turn trash into trees.
strengths: No one can hate you for helping the environment.
Eight master weapon abilities come with the power.
Power becomes stronger the more you train and use it.
weaknesses: Have to carry stinky trash with you.
Most powerful in a landfill where no one will battle you.
Might hurt somebody or destroy a building if not well trained.

name: Usurpation: Inheritor
description:
This power allows you to temporarily usurp the powers of a single being whose power are genetic in nature, leaving them completely powerless in the process. Clothing will change to reflect the person whose powers have been stripped for the moment. 

You gain their powers at exactly the same level of the original owner. Line of sight is required, otherwise you will gain the powers of a random being who could be anywhere at the moment. You have no knowledge when Usurpation ends.
summary: The ability to temporarily usurp all powers of a single being which are genetically inherited in one way or another
strengths: Surprise your opponent(s) with new powers
Knowledge what you can and can't do with "your " powers
weaknesses: If no Inheritor is in sight, the target is chosen at random
Random inheritor powers might be useless in your current situation

name: Odor Sight
description: All odors left behind can be "seen," allowing you to track down an object. No odors have the same color, and the color fades away when the odor fades away. Once you've mastered identifying smells, you can easily track down a certain something, like pie.
summary: The ability to see different smells and odors, using your eyes.
strengths: Allows to see odors human noses can't detect
Excellent for tracking
weaknesses: May clutter field of vision

name: Ashes Ashes
description: With this power you can turn people into piles of ashes just by looking at them and saying "Ashes Ashes". Once they're a pile of ashes you cannot turn them back to human form and they pretty much die.
summary: The ability to turn people into a pile of ashes
strengths: You can turn your enemies into piles of ashes
weaknesses: You cannot turn them back
If you're mute this power has no effect

name: Toxic Spit
description: With this power you can spit toxic waster from your mouth at your enemies. The wastes will burn or mutate your enemies and most likely kill them. The user of this power cannot be effected by his own toxins or any other toxic wastes.
summary: The ability to spit toxic waste
strengths: You can spit out toxic waste at your enemies
You cannot be effected by your own or other toxins
weaknesses: This power is useless against other people with this power

name: Zombie Healing
description: Everyone has heard of healing, but this is healing with a twist. If you find a sick or injured person, you can make them a zombie which slowly heals and, when recovered, turns back to human. Also, if they bite someone, they become a zombie in a similar state. These zombies do not need sustenance and they can't be killed, unless completely destroyed. Further injuries prolong their condition, they are immune to disease and don't age whilst a zombie. You can control and talk with them anywhere.
summary: The ability to heal others by turning them into zombies that serve you.
strengths: Get servants.
Heal others.
People will pay to be your slave (temporarily).
weaknesses: You could start a pandemic.
If you die, they all turn back.
You have to talk for them.

name: Celtic Invocation: Beltane
description: Beltane is the festival of fertility and growth, and so are its powers given. The invoker can increase all fertility in the area, for soil, plants, animals and humans. They can also subtly increase the growth of plants in the area, increasing it by about five. They can also heal all non-lethal illnesses and wounds, in animals and humans. They can create feelings of lust and love, and for their final ability, can create a fire that when a hearth-fire is lit by it, brings good luck and happiness.
summary: The ability to use the power of Beltane, the first day of spring.
strengths: Everyone will love you, due to the overflow of power Beltane brings.
Plants and animals will be especially sensitve to your wants and needs and may obey you.
You'll be the life of the party!
weaknesses: Only available once a year.
Sometimes, the emotional aspect can get out of hand and affect the invoker severely.
You'll be in high demand due to people wanting you to ensure a good crop and herd.

name: Zero's Scroll: Absorption
description: A highly useful, and very dangerous spell. Using this will allow you to absorb the energy and life of plants and animals, and even humans who you can overpower with your will. With this, you can use spells with less drain on yourself, and replenish your energy more easily. However, your body won't be cured, and will be burdened by the intruding energy.
summary: The ability to use Absorption.
strengths: Quickly replenish your energy.
Great for mages.
weaknesses: Affects your body, causing you to fatigue.
Hard to maintain.

name: Rise Of The Jabberwock
description: With this power you can turn into the powerful Jabberwock from Carrol Lewis's book "Through the Looking Glass and What Alice Found There"
summary: The ability to turn into the Jabberwock at will
strengths: You can fly
You have strong teeth and claws
You can survive without your head (As seen on the Muppet Show)
weaknesses: The Jabberwock is really ugly

name: Megakaryocyte Mimicry
description: This power allows you to create clones of yourself, except they don't have Megakaryocyte Mimicry; it is replaced by Thrombocyte Mimicry. To create clones, you must lose parts of your body. They will regenerate and the separated parts will grow to become identical clones of you. Hepatocyte Mimics can boost your power if they want to.
summary: The ability to create clones with the power of Thrombocyte Mimicry by losing parts of your body.
strengths: Thrombocyte Mimics are very effective to create barriers and even more effective when they are many.
Hepatocyte Mimics can boost your power, allowing you to create clones more rapidly.
If you unwillingly lose parts of your body, they will regrow and the lost parts will become clones.
weaknesses: You don't gain the power of Thrombocyte Mimicry, only your clones do.
Your clones can't get the power of Megakaryocyte Mimicry; it is replaced by Thrombocyte Mimicry.
If not boosted, your powers of regeneration and clone creation are slow.

name: Play Fetch
description: If your holding a stick and an opponent sees it you can make him or her behave as if s/he was a loyal pet dog of yours. If an opponent can shape shift or morph into a dog s/he will do so. This power stops working if your throwing arm gets tired,the stick breaks,you choose not to throw the stick,if you pretend to throw the stick or the stick is lost after you throw it. You can only affect a person once a day. This power will not work on anyone who is resistant or immune to mind control.
summary: The ability to make an opponent behave like a pet dog and play fetch the stick with you.
strengths: Give your worst enemy the mind of a loyal pet if only for a short time.
Sticks are free.
weaknesses: Someone immune to mind control.
You run out of sticks.
Your throwing arm gets a cramp.

name: Turkeytality
description: The move allows you to turn your opponents into turkey versions of themselves. Regardless, the regressed character's attire is basically a wild turkey version of the clothes he or she wore when fully-grown, complete with smaller versions of his or her accessories, the incarnation where the turkey would just walk around looking stupid and obliviously make a fool of themselves usually involving a humiliating action with a signature trait of theirs to drive the point home even in death.
summary: The ability to turn your foes into turkeys.
strengths: You can have yourself an early thanksgiving feast.
Might find it hysterical.
weaknesses: None, except for the foe you cast it on.

name: Snake Bite
description: This is the ability to create toxins in ones mouth that are spread into anything you bite. It comes with an auto-inmunity to ones own poison and the gravity of the poison may change depending on what the biter wants. One would also have retractable fangs to inject the poison better, which are also unbreakable. The only bad thing is that by itself it may be difficult to apply since most opponents won't let one bite them too easily.
summary: The ability to create toxins in ones mouth that are spread into anything you bite.
strengths: Auto-inmunity to poison
Retracktable and unbreakable fangs
Able to change the gravity of poison to ones will
weaknesses: Difficult to bite opponent
Needs to be combined with another power like increased agility.

name: Wolves To Werewolves
description: With this power you can turn ordinary wolves into much more powerful werewolves. But you don't have them under your control, unless the wolf was under your control when you used the power on it.
summary: The ability to turn regular wolves into monstrous werewolves
strengths: You can turn wolves into man eating super strong werewolves
You essentially create life (the human form of a werewolf)
weaknesses: They're not necessarily under your control
The human form of the werewolf has no ID or official evidence of existence

name: Summon The 4 Horsemen
description: Pestilence, War, Famine, & Death. You can summon them to do your bidding. Bring chaos & apocalypse onto your enemies. Give them disease, make them turn on each other in bloody rage, starve them, or merely vaporize them dead. The Horsemen are under your control for a day, but once 24 hours are up & you haven't dismissed them, they are no longer subject to you & will continue the end of the world.
summary: The ability to bring about the bringers of the apocalypse
strengths: Control apocalypse for a day
Destroy your enemies in an armageddon way
weaknesses: Can only control them for 24 hours
If you haven't expelled them before time runs out, they will continue blood shed

name: Enhancement: Holy
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power more effective at harming evil beings and healing pure-hearted beings. This power cannot be attached to powers that are evil in origin. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power more pure than normal
strengths: Pure-hearted allies.
100% evil enemies.
Objects are affected also if the attached-to power could affect them originally.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Evil allies.
Pure-hearted enemies.

name: Blood Zombies
description: Once your blood is on the outside of your body, it will turn into humanoid blood zombies that you control. You may suck them back inside of you and they regenerate from physical damage (other than natural elements. )
summary: The ability to have blood that turns into humanoid blood zombies.
strengths: Vampires cannot feed off of you.
Perfect protection.
Control an army of your own blood.
weaknesses: Blood loss if you create to many.
A big blood zombie may come out of a papercut or nosebleed unwillingly.
They're hunger for human blood may be greater than your control.

name: Myth Power: Adephagia's Avarice
description: Adephagia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of gluttony. As such, channeling her allows one to safely ingest nearly any physical matter, with superhumanly powerful digestive tract, teeth and unhinging jaws. In addition, one can project a powerful prehensile tongue for assistance, at will. Furthermore, one can have as much food and drink as desired, at will. One can also withstand food-based illness and unhealthy food-based weight gain. One can even psychically receive taste sensations, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Adephagia's command over the essence of gluttony
strengths: Access Matter Ingestion (safely ingest any matter) and Hyperbite (superhuman digestive tract, teeth and unhinging jaws)
Prehensile Tongue; eat/drink indefinitely, at will; withstand food-based illness/unhealthy food-based weight gain
Psychically receive taste sensations (from past, present and future, etc), at will.
weaknesses: Cannot psionically project disembodied mouths (with same powers as Pro #1), until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically dominate neutrals' mouths (bestowing same powers as Pro #1) until developed (NCN)
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Animalinator
description: With this power you can turn any stuffed animal or beanie baby into a real animal. Your newly created animals are completely under your control. However, you are unable to return the animals to their former plushy selves.
summary: The ability to turn beanie babies or stuffed animals into real animals
strengths: You can turn stuffed animals into real animals
The animals are under your control
weaknesses: You cannot turn the animals back into their stuffed animal forms
The animals can be killed

name: Marked Kiss Of Death
description: I know it was you.  You broke my heart.  I cannot bring myself to kill you myself, but with this kiss, I mark you for death.  Upon seeing you, all others from this point on will feel compelled to hate you, to harm you, to ripe you to pieces, to want to destroy you.  Even if they cannot reach you themselves,they will call on others to get you and cheer them on.  Even those loved ones with the will to resist cannot help but feel satisfaction upon seeing you suffer.  You schmuck!
summary: The ability to kiss someone, marking him for death, thereby compelling others to kill him
strengths: Let others do your dirty work for you
Sit back and watch the show
weaknesses: Must kiss them on the lips
Hope you don't kiss your mother with that mouth

name: Shinchintetsu Jizaikon
description: When you say "Adeat", a staff appears. This staff can increase in size and length.
summary: The ability to summon a staff that can grow longer and bigger.
strengths: The bigger and longer it is, the stronger it is.
Can be used to attack enemies that are far away.
weaknesses: Hard to control when too large and/or long.
Enemies can see it coming.

name: Demonic Resonance
description: The resonance wil only work if the person has hatred in the heart. The more hatred they have the more powerful of a demon they will become. Appearances change dependant on the person becoming a demon.
summary: The ability to resonate with a person in such a way that they turn into a demon
strengths: Better against heroes than villains, usually.
Can make heroes hated and feared by the superstitious.
weaknesses: Never ever use this against a villain.
Can't use this on yourself.

name: Rise Of The Fiskerton Phantom
description: With this power you can turn into the Fiskerton Phantom. You are four feet tall with primate and cat like features. You have advanced climbing skills and have superhuman strength. You have also have sharp teeth and claws. You have advanced night vision as well. You retain your ability to speak, your personality and your intelligence while in this form.
summary: The ability to turn into the Fiskerton Phantom
strengths: You can turn into the Fiskerton Phantom
weaknesses: You might get hunted due to being a monster

name: Fat/Famine
description: With this power, you touch someone who is either obese or very thin and they soon become opposite weight of what they are in 3 days. If overweight, they will start to shed pounds instantly, even if they eat a lot, until they are anorexically thin and look like a living skeleton with saggy skin flaps. For a thin person, the smallest 0 calorie foods will make them gain 50 lbs. Even if they don't eat, they still gain 5-10 lbs. and grow more morbidly obese. Healthy weight could go either way.
summary: The ability to make someone obese or skeletally thin
strengths: Make either fat or skinny person become opposite weight
weaknesses: It's really a cursing power

name: Sarsakinesis
description: This power allows you to create and manipulate rootbeer with your mind. You may move rootbeer, like you have hydrokinesis but with only rootbeer, with your mind. You can divinate the present or future by looking into a puddle/full can of rootbeer. Rootbeer heals your injuries and illnesses when you drink it. You can make rootbeer adhesive, acidic, hardening, frothy, poisonous or freezing.
summary: The ability to manipulate rootbeer with your mind
strengths: Regenerate by drinking rootbeer
Manipulate rootbeer ultimately
Rootbeer is good
weaknesses: If you don't like rootbeer
It may take time to master all of the types of manipulation

name: Four Word Death
description: Say a word to your intended victim. After this you will be rendered mute, but after that person hears the word you said three more times they will drop dead. You will not be able to speak until after the victim's death.
summary: The ability to cause someone to die after hearing a word 4 times.
strengths: Kill someone stealthily, and in a way that can not be traced back to you.
weaknesses: You are mute for however long in takes for your victim to die.
Your intended victim must be able to hear.

name: Methanogenesis
description: A form of anaerobic respiration, the possessor of this ability is able to survive in oxygen-poor environments by using carbon dioxide as the electron acceptor in cellular respiration rather than oxygen. While not as efficient as aerobic respiration, it will allow the person to survive. As aerobic respiration has carbon dioxide as its byproduct, methanogenesis' byproduct is methane gas. Might also breathe in side-products and/or smells.
summary: The ability to breathe in Carbon Dioxide and exhale methane
strengths: Allows survival in oxygen-poor environments
Good for survival in enclosed spaces, e.g. sealed in by your foe
Collect the methane for fuel
weaknesses: None.

name: Crazy Hair
description: Never have a bad hair day again.  Losing a little bit up top?  Not any more!  Take control of that bed head, 100% of the time.
summary: The ability to control your hair color, length, volume, and style to exactly how you want it.
strengths: Never have a bad hair day
Always look good up top
No more expensive hair cuts
weaknesses: Your hair stylist will miss you

name: Tail Limb
