description: With this power, you have an added limb: a tail. With a tail, you could use it to hold yourself upon tree branches and swing away, etc. Of course, as with any other limb, you have to exercise it to grow more muscular and have more strength. This applies to the tail too.
summary: The ability to have a tail limb.
strengths: Can use it to swing from branches and hold yourself up.
Spinning while jumping gives you more airtime.
weaknesses: Inconvenient when sitting.

name: Crying Point
description: With this power you can make people burst into tears whenever you point at them. They will cry until you stop pointing at them. The tears will blur their vision so that you can easily defeat them or make a quick getaway.
summary: The ability to make people cry when you point at them
strengths: You can make people cry by pointing at them
The tears will blur their vision
weaknesses: They only cry when you're pointing at them

name: Transferable Hearing
description: Your normal hearing and any other modes of hearing can hear through another set of ears. This set of ears can be the ears of someone in a drawing to the ears of a living creature. If the other ears you're hearing through are damaged in any way you instantly begin hearing through your own ears again.
summary: The ability to transfer all your modes of hearing to another set of ears.
strengths: Hear through any set of ears. A portrait's,a toy with ears,etc.
weaknesses: Vision powers are better hearing powers.

name: Poison Dart Strike V5 Animals
description: Ith this power you can shoot poison darts from your hands, but they can only hurt animals. These poison darts will paralyze the victim for about twenty minutes.
summary: The ability to shoot poison darts from your hands
strengths: You can paralyze animals for up to twenty minutes while you run away from or kill them
weaknesses: Only works on animals (not including humans)

name: Wand: Birch
description: A user of this wand focuses in purification, fertility and divination. They may use their wand to clear an area or person of negative forces. This includes exorcism of possessed people. They can also purify spoilt food or water. They may increase the fertility of any person, plant or animal in the area, increasing the chances of conception. They can also bless the soil, increasing plant growth. A Birch-Bearer may also bless items and make them sacred so as to use them for divination.
summary: The ability to use a wand made of one of the nineteen sacred trees: Birch
strengths: Anything can be blessed to be able to tell the future.
If you're a farmer, you'll have some of the best crops and herds around.
You're effectiveness is increased from Dec 24 – Jan 21.
weaknesses: Spirits, demons and other possessive beings may begin to hate you.
People will begin to pester you to tell their futures. All. The. Time.
Infertile couples may begin to pester you also.

name: Photovideo Reproduction
description: If you choose to use this power then ten minutes after a picture of you is taken,it will become you. A cellphone would burst apart releasing a another you. A photo will expand into a full-sized version of you. A video recording requires 10 minutes of continuous play. A DVD could hold a dormant version of you for yourself or someone else to play. Youtube videos work for this power.
summary: The ability to have photos and videos of you become you.
strengths: Practically every cellphone can take pictures.
Make DVD copies of yourself.
Upload yourself to Youtube.
weaknesses: Anyone that knows this power will avoid taking your picture or recording you.
Videos or DVDs take ten continuous minutes of play.
Useless if you travel back too far in time.

name: Complete Stupidity!
description: The user of said ability can use a completely random power at will. However, they have absolutely no choice of what power they receive. It could range from the ability to fly, to shape-shift, etc.  The power that has been received can only be used once. However, though there is a very small chance of getting the same power twice, it is completely possible.  Mutations that can be caused by this power are only temporary, and will vanish when a new random power is received.
summary: The ability to randomly use any superpower imaginable!... Once.
strengths: Could potentially be a great help in combat.
The opponent will never be able to anticipate your next move!
Can be well hidden.
weaknesses: The random power might be completely useless!
It might randomly destroy the world.
May cause self harm.

name: Wood Mimicry
description: Trees are some of the most sturdy living things; some live 500 years and stand 200 feet tall. Wood Mimics can take on some of their characteristics. At will, their internal organs and tissues become wood while their skin turns to bark, their feet turn into root-like things, their blood becomes sap, and their strength is multiplied 20 times. When they are in tree-mode, however, they are vunerable to fire, have a slower thought process, and are not as agile.
summary: The ability to turn your tissues into wood at will
strengths: Thick bark-skin, wood innards, sap-blood
Root-feet that can be locked in for immobility
Strength multiplied by 20 times
weaknesses: Vunerable to fire
Slower thought process
Not as agile

name: Poison Dart Strike V1 Mortals
description: With this power you can shoot poison darts from your hands but they can only hurt mortals (i. E. Normal people with no super human abilities) these poison darts will paralyze the victim for about twenty minutes
summary: The ability to shoot poison darts from your hands
strengths: You can paralyze people for up to twenty minutes while you attack them or rob them
weaknesses: Only works for twenty minutes though you can shoot them with numerous darts at a time
Doesn't work on people with super powers

name: Forced Transformation Use
description: Don't you hate those powers that force you to become something else? Well now you can use those forms you have been forced to take on as though they were originally transformations you were able to naturally use. You can also as a side effect of this power use your original form.
summary: The ability to use forms one was forced to become
strengths: Being transformed against your will can now help you gain new identities.
You can still use your original form for ID purposes.
The gained forms will never age or change looks from what the other people intended them to be like.
weaknesses: No use if you have shapeshifting, immutability, and a few other powers.
Only works if you're transformed against your will.

name: Morphing Time
description: All you have to do is some silly dance and the morphing will begin. Being a ranger comes with a ranger issued weapon, zord and bright coloured silly looking costume.  Depending on which ranger you pick, you will also have a special ability that matches the colour and animal you choose.
summary: The ability to turn into a power ranger.
strengths: You're a protector of all that is good and are loved by millions of powerless civilians.
Change into any ranger you want, but can't change while morphed (also see con 3)
You are able to do all kinds of super kungfu and other fighting styles without learning them.
weaknesses: You're going to be attacked by misformed mutants pretty much every week.
After you defeat those mutants they turn into a huge version of themselves.
If you're beaten you have to wait 2 hours before you can morph again.

name: Staff Of Moses
description: With this power you can instantly change any stick into a snake at will and the snake will be under your control. The type of snake varies on the type of stick. If the snake dies, it reverts back to the stick.
summary: The ability to change any stick into a snake
strengths: You have a snake to fight enemies with
If the snake dies you can always hit your enemy with the stick
After a cooldown period, you can transform the stick into a snake again
weaknesses: The snake can die

name: Denim
description: With this power you can turn any article of clothing or any piece of cloth into denim. You can have jean sweatshirts, jean sweatpants, jean sweat rags etc. Once you turn things denim though you can't change it back.
summary: The ability to turn any cloth into denim
strengths: You can turn any cloth into denim
weaknesses: You can't turn it back

name: Heart Eater
description: The ability to eat a heart and gain any powers that the being who originally had the heart had. Also this power cannot be altered by other powers.
summary: The ability to gain any powers of the being whose heart you eat.
strengths: Can gain lots of powerful powers over time.
weaknesses: It's disgusting.
Have to find the hearts first.
The whole heart has to be eaten in order for this power to work.

name: Pacman
description: A person with this power has the ability to shift into Pacman and eat anything in front of them except ghosts. As Pacman you see the world like a computer video game screen allowing you to track your enemies. You can also see but dots which give you powerups to eat ghosts.
summary: The ability to turn into Pacman or Mrs. Pacman and eat anything in front of you
strengths: You can eat/chew almost anything
You don't get fat as Pacman and food is not transferrred
You can get powerups
weaknesses: You must keep on moving
You cannot eat ghosts without powerup
You cannot fly

name: Cheetah Summon
description: With this power you can summon cheetahs out of nowhere. However, you cannot make the cheetahs disappear, and you can only summon three cheetahs in a 24 hour period. The cheetahs start out as babies, and grow at the normal rate. They are very loyal to you, and view you as a parent.
summary: The ability to summon cheetahs out of nowhere.
strengths: You can raise your own companion.
Your friends will be jealous when they find out you have a cheetah for a pet.
Your cheetah friends can protect you in dangerous situations.
weaknesses: Only three per day.
Cannot make them disappear.
You might have trouble finding enough red meat to fed them each day.

name: The Savior's Ears
description: Whenever someone in danger is crying for help, you will hear them if they are within a certain radius from you. That radius depends on your power level; the more powerful you are, the longer the radius. Also, the closer they are from you, the more accurately you will be able to locate them. Moreover, if they are people you know, you can know their identities as well. However, whether or not you will be able to save them is totally up to you.
summary: The ability to hear and locate cries for help
strengths: If you want to play hero, this is the power for you!
If you're worried about your loved ones being in danger, you can know for sure.
weaknesses: If you don't care about anyone but yourself, this power will irritate you a lot!
This power is always active, you can't turn it off, unless you use another power.
How depressing would it be to want to save someone but to be unable to?

name: Morbid Transformation
description: Morbid Transformation allows you to turn into a corpse, meaning that you can either: one, fake your own death and trick everyone you know; or two, you can turn into someone is already dead, like George Washington or something and just have fun pretending to be that person XD. Fun, and creepy!
summary: The ability to shift or turn into a corpse or anyone who is now dead
strengths: Turn into another person as long as they are dead
Turn into a corpse or even fake your own death
weaknesses: You can only turn into people who are already dead
You are not immortal and people can double-tap you.

name: Chiropractic Swarm
description: You can have your spine crawl out of your body as a centipede like monster you control that spits corrosive spinal fluids. As it roams, after about 14 minutes you grow a new spine and regain conciousness. That spine can be a monster as well.
summary: The ability to eject your spine from your body as a living monster you control.
strengths: You can regenerate an infinite amount af spines.
They fit in tight spaces.
They can crawl up walls
weaknesses: You are unconcious and vulnerable until you regenarate.

name: Blood Scythe 2 Form The Wheel
description: The blood from the blade flows to the end of the handle, and transforms into a blade the same shape and size as the main blade of the scythe, except it is facing a different way. Now, the scythe can be thrown at opponents, and it will spin as it flies.
summary: The ability to transform the blood scythe
strengths: Great range weapon.
Strong attack.
Boomerang-like capabilities.
weaknesses: Difficult to use in close combat, for fear of being hit by one of the blades.

name: Mercury Emesis
description: You can spew liquid metal up to 6ft at will. It can poison your enemies and make all sorts of cool weaponry and sculptures made of mercury. You will not choke. You will not die. However, it could give you a nasty gag reflex. You also have to master it or it will harden in your mouth (if held in long enough before release).
summary: The ability to project liquid mercury from your mouth at will
strengths: Immunity to mercury poisoning
Easy gifts and entertainment (If you're creepy like that)
Kill your enemies ruthlessly.
weaknesses: You could drown in your sleep if you can't control it
If this is involuntary, could make for very awkward social situations

name: Snap You're A Vehicle
description: With this power you can turn people into vehicles by snapping and saying the person's name and the desired vehicle Ex: "John Doe, Motorcycle" The person loses all sentience when in vehicle form but you can turn them back by snapping and saying what you said before in reverse Ex: "Motorcycle, John Doe". All damage sustained in vehicle mode transfers to human mode so its an easy way to defeat powerful enemies just tun them into vehicles and crash them a couple of times before turning the back.
summary: The ability to turn people into vehicles by snapping
strengths: You can anybody into any vehicle.
Once in vehicle mode they lose all sentience so you can ride them or use them to attack people.
All damage sustained in vehicle mode transfers to human mode.
weaknesses: If they get destroyed in vehicle mode they die.

name: "Speak Humans!" V2
description: With this power you can give humans the ability to speak to animals. They will be able to speak to any fish, bird, mammal, reptile, insect, amphibian etc. And understand what the animals are saying as well.
summary: The ability to give humans the ability to speak any animal language
strengths: You can give humans the ability to speak to animals
weaknesses: You can't use this power on yourself

name: Enhancement: Perverted
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power more effective at healing evil beings and harming pure-hearted beings. This power cannot be attached to powers that are good in origin. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power more evil than normal
strengths: Pure-hearted enemies.
100% evil allies.
Objects are affected also if the attached-to power could affect them originally.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Evil enemies.
Pure-hearted allies.

name: Puppet Power
description: With this power you can turn people into puppet versions of themselves and control them
summary: The ability to turn people into puppet versions of themselves
strengths: Turn your enemies into puppets so they can't cause any more harm
weaknesses: Once you turn a person into a puppet you can't turn them back

name: Lymph Manipulation
description: A person with this power can control lymph at the cellular level. This means that they can control the immune system of anything as well as use it like blood manipulation. With this power you can cure many diseases as well as cause symptoms of disease. In addition you can also trigger or stop allergies in people.
summary: The ability to manipulate lymph at the cellular level
strengths: Can use to cure people from edema and stop allergies
Can also cause edema and allergies including anaphylactic shock
Can use similar to blood manipulation
weaknesses: Lymph is less common than blood ie less to manipulate
Need to study how lymph works

name: Chihuahua Summoner
description: Summon 3 Super evolved assassin Chihuahua's that upon death disappear and can be re summoned after a 12 hour recharge period. These Chihuahua's are the same size but speak English, and are trained with knives and small arms. They have paws that morph into hand with three fingers and one thumb. They are good assassins because after a kill they can trot out without raising suspicion. They obey your commands even if they are not happy about it or give you some sarcastic remark.
summary: The ability to summon assassin Chihuahua's
strengths: Cute killers
Die but return in 12 hours
Obedient-ish
weaknesses: Small
Not good for general fighting
All assinations must be suprise attacks.

name: Anubis Shift
description: With this power you can shape shift into Anubis at will. You can speak Egyptian and understand Egyptian. You don't get his powers, memories or skills. You will be worshiped as long as you are in this form, though you'll smell of corpses. Lastly, dogs will like you.
summary: The ability to shape shift into Anubis at will
strengths: You speak and understand Egyptian
Dogs like you
Scare people to death
weaknesses: You don't have his powers
You don't have his memories
You don't have his skills

name: Pheromone Detection
description: Pheromones are produced by animals (mainly insects) and plants to communicate between them. Even humans produce some. There are alarm pheromones, food trail pheromones, sex pheromones... It is considered the sixth sense of animals.
summary: The ability to detect pheromones of all animals.
strengths: Allows you to discover a large amount of informations about an animal just by smelling it.
Detect the presence of animals.
weaknesses: Humans produce less pheromones than other animals.
You need to smell to discover informations.

name: Immortal Urn
description: It is unclear where the urn came from, but what is known is that of one's heart is placed inside he or she will be immortal as long as their hear is inside. After that time, any injury will heal instantly and only ash will spill from the wounds. Person remains the same age they were when the heart was placed inside. Person can travel as far away from the urn as they want which makes hiding it easier to hide the urn.
summary: The ability to become immortal if your heart is placed into the urn.
strengths: You're immortal as long as your heart is inside.
Urn can be hidden and you can go anywhere.
No pain when injured and healing is quick.
weaknesses: You have no added strength or speed so there's that. You will look as pale as a dead person.
Your body, excactly as it was when you become immortal so if you're fat, thin, whatever you're stuck
If someone find your urn, they can enslave you if they want, until you get it back. Or they kill you

name: Forced Snake Head Hands
description: With this power you can turn other people's hands into snake heads. The snakes have indestructible skin, sharp fangs and a poison tipped tongue. The snakes are also under your control so you can turn your enemy's hands into snake heads and then cause the snakes to bite your enemy, poisoning and eventually killing him. Additionally only you can turn the snakes back into hands.
summary: The ability to turn other people's hands into snake heads and have complete control over the snake heads
strengths: You can turn other people's hands into snake heads
You have complete control over the snake heads
Only you can turn the heads back into hands
weaknesses: You cannot turn your own hands into snake heads

name: Ally Shift V2
description: With this power you can turn into any of your friends and if they have any you get all of their powers. You also retain all of your intelligence and personality. You can stay in ally mode for as long as you want.
summary: The ability to turn into any of your friends
strengths: You can turn into any of your friends
You retain your intelligence level and personality
You can stay in ally mode for as long as you want
weaknesses: You can only turn into people who are your friends

name: Mace Hand(S)
description: With this power you can turn your hands into maces. You start off by only being able to turn your left hand into a mace but if you train a lot you will eventually be able to turn your right hand into one too
summary: The ability to turn your left hand and if you have enough practice your right hand into maces
strengths: You can turn your hands into maces
weaknesses: If you're not a lefty the training process can be hard and annoying

name: Being: Blood Warrior
description: Blood warriors are excepetional warriors made by Hades, they are Omni-creatures capable of becoming more and more powerful by every victim they absorb gaining all statistics and abilities then adding it to their own, having 2 blades for hands and 2 blades on their elbow,they can be fearsome opponents,however although being very intellectual they also absorb the sickness or disorder and even personality creating another split personality,this may cause insanity in the worst degree
summary: The ability to transform into a blood warrior
strengths: Become an Omni-Creature
Very smart
weaknesses: May be absorbed by the transformation itself making you insane
Also absorb's sickness,disorders,personality etc.

name: Virus: Virobacteriosis
description: The user of this ability is gifted indeed. The virus released is properly called Virobacteriosis-itis Syndrome Disorder, and when it is released, no living thing may resist it. Combined with animal viruses, plant viruses and synthetic viruses (including the Legacy virus, for those of you familiar with X-men), it causes the afflicted to randomly display symptoms of every disease present on that planet. The effects last for typically a week, although, as the power develops, it goes up to a month.
summary: The ability to release a virus that causes symptoms of every disease to pop up randomly
strengths: Release a virus that transcends species
Make foes suffer symptoms of every disease known to man
Release and alleviate the virus at will
weaknesses: Computers aren't living, so they just glitch up, and become really susceptible to malware/viruses
Plants don't display emotion, so emotional disorders just make them change color
Aliens may die from this virus (immune system not as effective against earth diseases/viruses)

name: 1000 Needles
description:
With this ability you can shoot exactly 1000 needles at once from your back towards your enemies.
These needles are poisonous and deadly.
The needles aren't homing and can only shoot 1000 at any one time. The bonus is there s not pain felt by use of this ability.
summary: The ability to shoot 1000 deadly needles from your back to your enemies.
strengths: Needles are poisonous and instantly kill enemies.
Needles shoot out all at once and consecutively.
You feel no pain when using this ability.
weaknesses: Can only shoot from your back.
Can only shoot 1000 needles at any one time.
Needles are not homing.

name: Toy Soldier Affect
description: This power is much similar to the Toy-gun Affect, except instead of turning weapons into toys you can turn people or animals into toys. The power lasts for one hour, and while the person is a toy, you can hear them talking in your thoughts. However, you have to touch the person (with your hands, not touching them by spitting on them) in order to turn them into a toy.
summary: The ability to turn anyone into a harmless toy
strengths: Turn anyone into a toy.
Also fun for the whole family XD
weaknesses: You have to touch them in order for it to work, and not with something like your spit.
Only stays as a toy for 1 hour before changing back
You could get a major headache from hearing all the 'toyified' people talking at once

name: Venom Spirit
description: You can control the venom spirit from every part of your body for instant, if you want to poison something trhough your breath a black and green light will come out of your mouth and poison whatever you want.  You can also set the spirit free for some time but you might not be able to control him.
summary: The ability to control a venomous spirit.
strengths: You can poison every single byological thing that existes.
The venom spirit will protect you even in your sleep or when something unnexpected attacks you.
Drinking poison will boost the spirit power.
weaknesses: You'll only get some control of this spirit after you reach 16 years old.
Before you can control him he will free himself and attack whatever he wants to.
Even when you reach 16 it's unlikly that you'll control him when you temporarly free him.

name: Bustance
description: 1. You have to actually be able to see what you are busting.  2. The process may take a while depending on the size of the object.  3. Try not to bust yourself.
summary: The ability to cause something to grow so massively that it busts
strengths: You can destroy anything in your way
Can cause things to bust for fun
Your own fireworks!
weaknesses: Takes a while so you might get beat up if using it during battle
You cannot deflate what you've inflated
You can't just inflate an object when you use the powers. It goes until it busts

name: Likeability
description: You know that stinky smell that comes from your neighbor? With this power, you can decide (permanently) that you like it, to the point that you are crazy about it. This also works in a reverse fashion, allowing you to decide (again permanently) that you don't like something.
summary: The ability to like anything you want
strengths: Have no hates and grudges
Helps with self control
weaknesses: If you accidentally activate it, you may find that you are crazy about drugs or other bad things

name: Meat Eatingu
description: After eating meat your healing rate will speed up but only enough that the meat you ate heals an area equal to what it fills. Ex: Eat a chicken leg and you can heal wounds equal to that chicken leg's size or eat a human's leg and you can regenerate your own leg.
summary: The ability to have a faster healing rate after eating meat
strengths: You can regenerate from horrible wounds.
Mortal wounds aren't so bad anymore.
weaknesses: People will think you're evil if you go cannibalistic.

name: The Monkey's Paw
description: When you use this power, you turn into a monkey's paw, and just the paw. You can then feel your way around but you can't smell, see or taste; only feel and hear. As the monkey's paw, you automatically make any wish you hear come true!
summary: The ability to turn into the monkey's paw
strengths: Hiding is easier.
Record your wishes and make them come true!
weaknesses: Must grant other people's wishes.

name: Vampire Ring
description: The ring possesses people. The first person who puts on the ring turns into a vampire. They can never take it off. They are given the powers of immortality, bringing other vampires to them and controlling them, shape-shifting, super strength and gaining power when they drink blood. However, it makes the wearer completely insane.
summary: The ability to call for a ring that turns you into a vampire and summon vampires to you
strengths: Control other vampires
Immortality
Shape-shifting
weaknesses: Go completely insane
Can never take it off

name: 5 Faces Of Darkness V2
description: With this power you can turn into a Shattered Glass Quintesson, you can change your form at will, can summon all kinds of alien technologies. You can also make peace with any alien species.
summary: The ability to turn into a Quintesson from the Shattered Glass Universe
strengths: You can turn into a Shattered Glass Quintesson
You can change your form at will
You can make peace with any alien species
weaknesses: You can't turn into positive universe Quintessons

name: G1 Trypticon's Transformation
description: With this power, you can turn into a city just like the giant Decepticon Citybot Trypticon. In city mode, you act like a normal city, albeit a smaller one that you can use as a storage for your things or a hideout for your allies and friends. You can still speak in city mode and you have a defense mode, meaning you can have lasers sprout out of every building and giant walls rise up from the ground. Note: when you turn back to human mode, the items you were storing vanish until you turn back.
summary: The ability to turn into a city
strengths: You can store stuff or help your allies hide in your city mode
You can shoot lasers from your buildings
You can still speak to the people and see what is going on in your city mode
weaknesses: You cannot turn back to human mode if you're in defense mode
You can't turn back when you have people inside you

name: Zippers
description: With this power, simply picture that something has a zipper on it, grab the tab, and pull. When you do, the object or person will "zip up" or "unzip" as if they were really cloth being held together by a zipper. Kill and destroy by unzipping. Heal and repair by zipping things up.
summary: The ability to "zip up" and "unzip" people and objects
strengths: "Unzip" enemies or obstacles blocking your path.
Fix what's broken by "zipping up" wounds, cracks, and breaks.
Make a door anywhere you like.
weaknesses: You must physically grasp the visualized zipper to "zip" anything.

name: Poison Water
description: The water will be as deadly as a wandering spider's poison. The poison effect will last for 24 hours or until the living being the water touched is dead, whichever comes first.
summary: The ability to make any water one touches poisonous to the next person it touches
strengths: You can always have a poison ready.
You are always immune to the poison effect.
weaknesses: You cannot use atmospheric water (humidity) for this power.

name: Summon Nylda
description: Nylda look like a 40-foot-long mix of praying mantis, millipede and horseshoe crab. They have ultrasonic hearing, an ability to produce a large cloud of deadly hydrogen cyanide, slow motion vision (it can see a hummingbird's wings in slow motion), a lightning-fast arm strike/grab and cuprumo-kinesis (manipulation of copper). It can build up to a speed of 90 mph. It has average intelligence and can pull 600 tons. It isn't made to use weapons, but it could carry things for you.
summary: The ability to summon a poisonous-gas-using kystian.
strengths: A hydrogen cyanide attack.
A lightning-fast arm strike.
It can drag 600 tons.
weaknesses: It can't use weapons.
You need space if you're not going to unsummon it.

name: Name Killer
description: The moment anyone knows your birth name they drop dead. You can kill people by simply stating "We haven't introduced ourselves, I'm. " They can hear your name be said, but the moment they know of your existence as well, they become dead. It is pretty simple actually, and works with all languages including brail, sign language, and extraterrestrial (but you have to learn them first). You like to wear sunglasses, be mysterious, and are "bad" at public speaking. You are completely unknown to gov't.
summary: The ability to instantly kill people who know your birth name
strengths: All your enemies must avoid learning about you, and unknown to all governments
You can kill entire populations by saying your birth name on television/internet (Its not Ian)
It happens to be a very embarrasing name, so this ability prevents humiliation
weaknesses: Your weakness are many, including windowless/soundproof jail cells and blind/deaf people

description: The thathan from Kyst: Emergency Power #4, a 130-foot-tall bipedal dinosaur-like creature. You can lift 7000 tons, smash, crush or go through just about anything you want to. If you want a weapon, you'll need to make one that will be big enough for your new form. This power leaves you unconscious when deactivated.
summary: The ability to become a unsummonable kystian.
strengths: Be a 130-foot-tall monster with a gun (if you made one).
You can lift 1,400,000 lbs.
weaknesses: You'll need an ally you can trust when you revert to human form.

name: Meat Eater
description: With this power you will be able to mimic the sounds an animal makes after eating its meat. By using the animal's call you can attract the attention of other members of the species and possibly befriends them.
summary: The ability to mimic an animal's call when you eat its meat
strengths: You can mimic an animal's call by eating its meat
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
This is not a power for vegetarians

name: Smell Warp
description: WIth this power you can change the way things smell. Make camel poop smell like roses and vice versa. Make your breath smell "minty fresh", make yourself "smell like a man" without even using Old Spice etc. You can change the scent of anything as many times as you want.
summary: The ability to change the scent of things
strengths: You can change the smell of anything
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat unless you make everything around the enemy smell bad so he retreats

name: Bee Keeper
description: This power allows you to BEE able to control and angry hoard of bees. They live inside your honey-comb-shaped pores.
summary: The ability to control a hoard of angry bumble-bees.
strengths: Easily overwhelm your enemies!
weaknesses: Honey-comb pores are itchy.
The constant buzzing in your head gets annoying.

name: High Fructose Mutation
description: Due to diets based entirely on high fructose corn syrup, mutants have appeared with cell cytoplasm and blood plasma consisting entirely of gooey corn syrup. These mutants can stretch to ridiculous lengths in their pursuit of justice/vengeance. Sharp objects are known to be lethal since they have no more platelets, just sugary goo. Low temperatures decrease their stretching ability, and high temperatures increase likelihood of overstretching, again being quite lethal.
summary: The ability to be Stretch Armstrong.
strengths: Make leaps and bounds like no other!
Save cats, put ladder companies out of business.
Experimental cannibals will love you.
weaknesses: Advanced form of hemophilia.
No holidays in exotic locales.
Totally sterile.

name: Rabid Wrath
description: Rabies is a disease that is transmitted by animal bites and is Very Very VERY deadly if not treated directly after the bite. This power allows you to inflict a very powerful and fast-acting rabies virus onto someone, and to cure someone of rabies. You can also infect animals with rabies as well. Since rabies is a VERY deadly disease if not treated, this should be a last resort.
summary: The ability to inflict rabies on someone
strengths: You can inflict a powerful, fast-acting rabies virus on an enemy.
You can also cure someone who has rabies
You can infect animals as well
weaknesses: Rabies can be VERY VERY VERY Deadly
Use with caution
This can be a last resort

name: Rise Of The Zords
description: With this power you can turn into of the Power Rangers Zords. You are unable to turn into the Megazords with this power but if you can find a bunch of other people with this power you can form them together.
summary: The ability to turn into any of the Power Ranger zords
strengths: You can turn into any of the power rangers zords
weaknesses: You can't turn into Megazords

name: Rat Control/Mutation
description: With this power you can control and mutate any species of rat. When you mutate it, it becomes six feet tall gains super strength, sharper teeth and it can spit poison it can also launch its claw at people like some sort of projectile and have new claws grow in right after. Its tail also becomes super sharp and the rat can use it as a sword. When you're done with the rat you can just unmutate it and send it away.
summary: The ability to control and mutate any species of rat
strengths: You can control and mutate any species of rat
When you're done you can unmutate the rat and send it away
weaknesses: Only works for rats not mice or any other rodent

name: U.C.S.
description: This power is more of a curse because it's shapeshifting with two twists. 1/You cannot control which form you transform into but they will only be human forms. And 2/You shapeshift every few seconds from the moment that you are born and so on even after you die (if you do die. ) This is great for being a spy or thief however no one will know or love you. You're new bodies may have different skin color, eye color, hair color, voice tone, biological age, gender and various other qualities.
summary: The ability to uncontrollably and continuously shapeshift into different human forms.
strengths: Be the best spy since your fingerprints/features will continuously change.
Become immortal since you will keep shifting to another form that could be younger.
Regenerate from any physical injuries. (Not while something like a bullet is stuck inside of you)
weaknesses: You can never be loved, known or remembered (Since you can't control the power. )
You might turn into a 115 year old and die.
If you are completely obliterated, you're dead since no one can survive that.

name: Kiss Me Deadly
description: You can gain the ability to poison people through a kiss, you can even poison your weapons by breathing on them.
summary: The ability to poison anything in your path, by kissing or touching whatever they came into contact with.
strengths: You could even exhale a poisonous mist at your foe, which kills them.
weaknesses: It can only work for females.

name: Rise Of The Mummy
description: With this power you can turn into the mummy from Wizards of Waverly Place in order to fight crime. This means you can turn people into your minions and trap them in hieroglyphs
summary: The ability to turn into a mind controlling mummy
strengths: You can control any number of people
You can store them in hieroglyphs when you're not using them
weaknesses: You have a strong addiction to cookie dough ice cream
If your gauze gets unwrapped you automatically turn back into your human form and lose this power

name: Creepy Clone
description: You can clone an evil version of yourself and let the clone do your chorus/work for you. You can decide if and which of your powers the clone posesses.
summary: The ability to clone an evil clone of yourself
strengths: You have your very own clone living your life and you can do whatever you want to do!
You can grant the clone powers and take them away from the clone.
Only 1 clone at any given time.
weaknesses: The clone is evil.
The clone may turn people against you.
The clone may have an obsession to rule the world.

name: Herbology: Immemor Arbor
description: While the Immemor Arbor may be beautiful, its fruits are bittersweet. It looks to be a normal tree, with thorned blue flowers sprouting from the branches. The tree gets its name from the toxin within the flowers. The toxin grants its victims temporary superhuman strength, speed, agility, and reflexes, it also causes total memory loss. The toxin begins to kill after the superhuman abilities wear off.
summary: The ability to summon an Immemor Arbor
strengths: The toxin can be separated into a poison, a superhuman serum, and a memory loss potion.
The flowers and their toxins can be very valuable.
The other parts of the tree (the bark, wood, leaves) all have their own properties.
weaknesses: This ability can be hard to discover without herbology, let alone use it properly.

name: Summon Carnallure
description: Carnallures are cousins of the norrs. If you die or they hurt you, they're unsummoned. They grudgingly accept they can't harm or kill you. Everyone else is fair game. Their favorite killing method is to look like a good looking human to lure a victim to his/her slow and painful death. A carnallure's real form is a 6-foot tall column of quivering flesh-like substance. Nothing will hurt them. They are strong as four normal men. Seeing them shape change is the only way to kill them.
summary: The ability to summon a shapeshifting half-alive thing.
strengths: A majority (?) of people are safe from them.
They won't hurt or kill you.
A shapeshifting (if somewhat Hannibal Lecter like) helper.
weaknesses: You've summoned a shapeshifting serial killer to this world.

name: Old One Power: Zalgo
description: Zalgo is the god of and source of a force that we have no name for save Zalgo, created by the interaction of the hivemind called "Anonymous" with the forces of the Old Ones. Zalgo's force causes corruption, mutation, insanity, hatred, violence, and death. Fully unrestrained, it would cause the apocalypse. You can control this force and use it to achieve virtually any effect of corruption. While Zalgo is presently sealed from this universe, you can contact him. He is very intelligent.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the (Old One? ) Zalgo
strengths: You can control (very loosely) the beasts that result from life + Zalgo force.
The Zalgo force works on inanimate objects too. A building might have impossible architecture.
Zalgo himself can be contacted, may provide useful advice, and protect you from his apocalypse.
weaknesses: The force cannot move through walls, believe it or not. It can move through openings, though.
There is essentially no beneficial use of your power, except selectively killing evil.
Zalgo will be in your head, trying to get you to help break down the wall keeping him out of reality

name: Fovea Displacement
description: A fovea (plural foveae) is a small area inside each eye responsible for sharp central vision. Usually, when you look at something, you can pick out its details only if it's in the center of your visual field. Otherwise, it's just a blur. This power allows you to shift your two foveae so you can pick out details of things that you're not directly looking at. However, a human fovea is usually deprived of rod cells, so this power is useless in a situation where there's not enough light.
summary: The ability to change the position of your foveae.
strengths: Freak out people by being aware of your surrounding without moving your eyes or your head.
weaknesses: You can see something if it's in your visual field.
This power is useless in dim lights.

name: Head Needles
description: Shoot needles out of your head. They are poisonous.
summary: The ability to shoot needles out of your head
strengths: Deadly assassination
Thin hard-to-see needles
weaknesses: Could look weird
May hurt your head
Could hit yourself

name: Celeb Shift V2
description: With this power you can turn into any famous person who ever lived. You can get into parties, get free stuff, make celebrities look bad, scare people by turning into dead celebrities etc. You can stay in celebrity mode for as long as you want.
summary: The ability to turn into any celebrity who ever lived
strengths: You can turn into any celebrity dead or alive
weaknesses: People might realize that you're not the real deal

name: Rise Of The Talking Monkey
description: With this power you can turn into a super smart talking monkey in order to fight crime
summary: The ability to turn into a talking monkey
strengths: You're super smart in this form
You're a monkey!
weaknesses: You might get put in a zoo

name: Enhancement: Poisoned
description: This is a sister power to Enhancement: Double and also a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it 'poisons' the power. The poison will hurt the enemy and potency is set at TTD. If you train enough you can change the potency. If someone tries to steal this power it permanently poisons the attached power and gives this power to the ability thief.
summary: The ability to 'poison' a power by attaching this power to it.
strengths: There are mental poisons. 3 Buddhist Poisons - Wrath, Greed, and Ignorance.
This can be added on to those previously useless powers hopefully.
TTD is highly poisonous. (Might be con). (It is a real poison for those who think I made it up).
weaknesses: You might not want a power poisoned. E.g. Poisoned Healing Touch.
The power might not be of any use poisoned.
Useless without another power.

name: Eye Grenades
description: You can use your eyes like grenades. Just pull one out and throw it. It will explode on contact or when you wish it to. Your eye grows back but only after your blow up the old one. Explosions very, The further away you are the more powerful you can make the grenade. If you're too close it wont explode at all. You can also use your eye as a spy camera for a short time but eventually it will explode or dry up. If your eye dries up it will be a while before you get a new one and it WILL hurt like,,
summary: The ability to pull out either eye and it explodes just a grenade on contact or whenever you want it to.
strengths: Eyes can explode, Great long range weapon, Eyes grow back, Eye can be used to spy for a short time.
It's a real hit on the 4th of July at parties. Built in safety, You wont kill youself by accident.
You gross out little kids at the same time scare their mothers.
weaknesses: Eye grows back after old one explodes, can't pull out both eyes at the same time (kinda obvious).
If eye dries up, you'll be blind on that until it grows back, plus it will hurt growing back.
You see the explosion; if this power is new to you, you will feel the explosions for about 1000 eyes

name: Rise Of The Unicronians
description: With this power you can turn into any Unicronian (a minion of Unicron) that is not a Transformer. You cannot turn into any of the Cybertronian minions of Unicron because they are covered by Rise Of The Transformers. You still have some pretty powerful forms such as Hook, Line and Sinker, Carcass and the Piranacons. You can stay in these forms for as long as you want and Unicron will have no control over you whatsoever (unless of course he actually brainwashes you or something).
summary: The ability to turn into any of the non transformer unicronians
strengths: You can turn into any non-Cybertronian Unicronian
Unicron has no control over you unless he brainwashes you
weaknesses: You can't turn into any Cybertronians with this power

name: Tint
description: With this power you can change everything to a single color and everything will turn that color, people, the sky, objects, animals, everything. You can change the color as many times as you want and to make it normal again you just have to shout out "Normal".
summary: The ability to cause the entire world to be one color
strengths: You can change everything in the world to one color
weaknesses: It all or nothing you can't turn certain things certain colors and other things other colors

name: Super Sniff
description: Hypersensitive smelling ability, enabling you to pick out individual smells (odors) from a distance.
summary: The ability to smell distinct odors from a distance.
strengths: You can track anyone from a distance without having to listen to or look at them.
You can impress your girl by noticing she's using a different perfume.
weaknesses: You're not immune to bad odors

name: Cold Blood
description: You have the basic ability to start pumping out reptilian blood cells in your body, giving you cold blood. It takes roughly 3-5 miniutes for all your blood to become cold (the warm blood cells need to die first) You need to sleep for 4 months straight to get your blood back to normal. :-(
summary: The ability to change your blood in your body from warm blood to cold blood.
strengths: People with heat-sensing powers can't feel you.
In fact, any heat-sensing device can't detect you.
You get a free forked tongue BTW.
weaknesses: You can't get warm unless it's hot weather.
This power will only wear off after hibernation.
Too much cold kills you.

name: Foe Shift V2
description: With this power you can turn into any person that you don't like. When you do this you gain all of their powers and skills while keeping all of your knowledge, intelligence level and personality. You can stay in foe mode for as long as you like.
summary: The ability to turn into anybody that you don't like
strengths: You can turn into anybody that you don't like
You gain all of their powers and abilities
You retain your personality and intelligence
weaknesses: If you don't have any enemies this power does nothing for you

name: Word/Number Solidification
description: With this power, all you have to do is say a word or number, and it becomes solid, letters, digits, & all! Each letter or digit becomes a solid shape once you say the right word or number. You can then use the solid symbols as toys, shields, weapons, or whatever.
summary: The ability to make words or numbers you say solid
strengths: Create solid symbols with your own voice.
You can also rearrange the symbols to spell anagrams of the word or number.
The louder your voice, the bigger & harder the symbols.
weaknesses: Be careful! If the symbols become solid over your head, then they could fall on you & hurt you!
After a certain time period, the solid symbols melt away.
Bigger, harder symbols will be more difficult to lift, unless you have super strength!

name: The Pinocchio Theory
description: You can cast it on a foe by releasing a tannish mist through your index finger which is pointing at your opponent of course. Then, all of a sudden, the person starts to look and feel strange, their nose starting to grow straight across, but they don't know they are lying since their nose isn't growing really fast.
summary: The ability to cast a spell on a person that causes their nose to grow straight if they lie.
strengths: A good thing for utter humiliation.
weaknesses: None.
Well maybe except for the villain that you cast it on.

name: Super Smell
description: The ability to emit any odor for an undetermined amount of time.
summary: The ability to emit any odor
strengths: To create confusion or divert an adversary.
To escape from tracker dogs.
To form an attractive perfume or smell cleaned.
weaknesses: Your nose is not immune to bad odors.

name: Cactus Plant Shift
description: With this power you can turn any plant into a cactus just by looking at the desired plant and saying "You'd look better as a cactus. " You can turn any kind of plant into any kind of cactus. The cactus will be the same size as the plant so if you use this power on a big tree you get a big cactus and vice versa for grass and small flowers. This power can be used on cactuses to turn them into different kinds of cactuses as well. You cannot reverse the effects of this power.
summary: The ability to turn any plant into a cactus
strengths: You can turn any type of plant into any type of cactus
You can even turn one species of cactus into another species of cactus
The plants remain the same size in cactus mode
weaknesses: The plants remain the same size in cactus mode
You cannot reverse the effects of this power
You have to be able to say the phrase "You'd look better as a cactus"

name: Cat Breed Shift V2
description: With this power you can turn any wild/jungle cat into any kind of domestic house cat. The affects of this power are irreversible.
summary: The ability to change jungle/wild cats into domestic house cats
strengths: You can change jungle/wild cats into domestic house cats
weaknesses: The affects of this power are irreversible

name: Kingdom Hearts Summon
description: You can summon any Organization 13 character or any other character from kingdom hearts to aid you in battle! The power can be reversed!
summary: The ability to summon a character from Kingdom Hearts!
strengths: You can just muck around and learn stuff about this character!
You will be helped in battle!
Character will have all his abilities and possessions on him!
weaknesses: Character will need a place to stay until you reverse the power!
Character might not have the ability or possession you need!

name: Attack Of The Evil Clones!
description:
The clones you create will have the same abilities as their original versions, but their personality will be megalomaniac, destructive and... EVIL! 
You can create the evil versions of the most intelligent scientists and the most powerful superheroes (if they exist in your world).
summary: The ability to create evil clones of anybody
strengths: You can gratify your megalomaniac passion.
You can gratify your destructive passion.
You can gratify your EVIL passion.
weaknesses: If you don't enjoy destruction, you will be bored about this superpower.
Nothing guarantees that your evil army will be faithful to their creator.

name: Acid Blood
description: When activated, this turns your blood into acid and causes it to burn through your veins. Then, you can throw it in someone's face, burn through restraints, stuff like that. Of course, this power is crazy painful. If I didn't couple it with some form of regeneration, no one would want it, so I did just that. When deactivated, the lost blood turns into vapor and returns to your veins, which heal very quickly. However, if it remains activated for too long, you might melt down completely.
summary: The ability to turn your blood into acid.
strengths: Acid melts through anything.
Easy to activate and deactivate.
Friggin' METAL.
weaknesses: Difficult to keep under control.
Friggin' PAINFUL.

name: Squid Powers
description: After being bitten by a radioactive squid, you have gained several considerable abilities. You can breathe underwater, turn your arms into extendable tentacles, shoot ink from your wrists, and even shapeshift into a squid.
summary: The ability to do everything a squid can do.
strengths: You can swim for as long as you want.
The ink-shooting will help you escape deadly situations.
weaknesses: You will seem slightly ridiculous.

name: Forced Kenny Mc Cormick Morph
description: You have the ability to change someone into Kenny and watch them be killed in under thirty minutes. Your victim is stripped of any powers that would ensure his survival. Nothing he does will save himself. Mice will carry off any remains after your victim's horrible death. Once you kenny-morph someone you have to wait until the first Kenny is dead before using your power again.
summary: The ability to turn someone into Kenny McCormick from South Park
strengths: Watch an enemy run around in panic as he knows he's doing to die.
weaknesses: You can make only one Kenny at a time.
You don't know when a Kenny will get killed.

name: Potpourri
description: With this ability you can make anything or anyone smell delicious. Cover up any bad scent and create a more relaxing enviorment.
summary: The ability to make anything smell nice
strengths: Make a nice smelling enviorment
Never have to take a shower
weaknesses: Pretty useless most of the time.

name: Lego Minfig Shift
description: With this power you can turn people into Lego Minifig versions of themselves. The will shrink down to the size of an average Minifig but they will still be alive and be able to move around and talk and whatnot. Even if you take them apart they will not die and their bodies will be able to move while their head can still talk and see and hear and smell and burp and stuff.
summary: The ability to turn people into Lego Minfig versions of themselves
strengths: You can turn people into Lego Mini Figure versions of themselves
weaknesses: It's hard to kill them in mini figure mode

name: Stuffed Animalinator
description: With this power you can turn any animal into a stuffed animal/beanie baby version of it. You can use this power on as many animals as you want buy you cannot reverse the effects of this power.
summary: The ability to turn animals into stuffed animals/beanie babies
strengths: You can turn any animal into a stuffed animal/beanie baby version of it
You can use this power as many times as you want
weaknesses: You cannot revers the effects of this power

name: Greater Kystian Morph #7
description: The uba. A perfect fusion of elephant, rhino, whale and sauropod dinosaur. You're 400 feet long, your tail is 80 feet of that. Your trunk is 80 feet long. Your tusks are 120 feet long. Your horn is 30 feet long. You stand 80 feet high at the shoulder. You can temporarily stand upright. You weigh 2100 tons. You possess a limited geokinesis that lets you strengthen the earth under you. You're strong enough to pull 16000 tons. You can emit sonar and hear subsonically.
summary: The ability to become the biggest land-bound unsummonable kystian.
strengths: Be a giant rampaging monster. As fast as a real rampaging elephant.
You can strengthen the earth under yourself.
You have a giant prehensile limb, tusks and horn.
weaknesses: You are only as fast as a real rampaging elephant.
There will be locations where you can't become this kystian.

name: Tree Turner
description: With this ability you can turn people into trees.
summary: The ability to turn people into trees
strengths: You can turn people into trees.
weaknesses: People might confuse you with Captian Planet.

name: G1 Grimlock's Transformation
description: With this power you can turn into a fire breathing robot T-Rex in order to fight crime or just roast marshmallows with your fiery breath./
summary: The ability to transform into a fire breathing robot T-Rex
strengths: You can breath fire
Robots are cool
Dinosaurs are cool
weaknesses: Your weakness is water

name: The Alex Silencer
description: If you are like me, then you also hate mary sue powers. With this power, you get the ability to cancel any of alexander121793's powers that he has created or will ever create. Even if he says they cant be canceled, this power will cancel them in some shape or manner that I deem fit in the comments sections.
summary: The ability to cancel any of alexander121793 and other related created powers.
strengths: No more powers that magically have adapting powers
To stop powers getting other powers
To stop people from making their powers too powerful
weaknesses: It only works on alexander121793's powers and other related powers
That I actually have to type alexander121793, just so he doesn't find some loopholes
If I truly have to redo all of this......... *puppy eyes... *

name: Lotion Mimicry
description: Never underestimate the power of topical medicine. This power gives you most of the benefits of Water Mimicry, but with additional health-related applications.  Furthermore, as the only lotion-based superpower, this automatically comes with lotionkinesis, the ability to mentally manipulate other lotion-like materials. Become an unstoppable force of skincare cosmetic medicine!
summary: The ability to convert all of your cells into an opaque emulsion of water and oils
strengths: Absorb damage, hide, wrap around foes the same as a water mimic
Transform into ointments that are appropriate for each situation
Soft to the touch, not to mention smelling nice
weaknesses: Can't stay in lotion form for too long, or the oils in your body will start to go rancid
Lotion form easily picks up particles in the air, so cleaning out your body will become a hassle
It's really unnerving to talk to people without any discernible facial features

name: Celtic Invocation: Blodeuwedd
description: By invoking the power of Blodeuwedd, the invoker can manipulate flower-bearing plants, can cause flowers to grow from nothing using their blood, and can even make animate structures and figures from flowers. The invoker may also have minor powers of restoration and healing, invoking the Maiden aspect of the goddess. While unable to heal anything above a small but deep gash or ease a small amount of pain in a human, the power is especially effective on flowering plants, and can even revive them.
summary: The ability to invoke the power of the Welsh goddess Blodeuwedd, the godess of flowers, and the Maiden.
strengths: Flowers are everywhere, and so is your power.
Expert users can even use flowers to manipulate emotions, by using the language of flowers.
The more you use this power, the more beautiful you become as you take on the aspect of flowers.
weaknesses: Some of your flower structures may become homocidal towards you.
Healing and restoration is only ever really effective for plants.
Your powers can be bound if you're surrounded by nine specific flowers.

name: Food Alive
description: With this power you can cause food to come to life. When you this power on a food they will grow a face and be able to talk, however they will not grow limbs and will have no way of moving around unless you move them or stick Mr. Potato Head pieces into it. You cannot choose what kind of personality the food gets when it comes to life and you cannot make inanimate again. The food will die if it becomes spoiled or if it is eaten. You cannot bring drinks or condiments to life with this power.
summary: The ability to bring food to life
strengths: You can bring food to life
Scare someone by making their food come to life right when they're about to eat it
You can make them mobile by sticking Mr. Potato Head parts into them
weaknesses: You don't choose their personality
Not much use in physical combat

name: Snake Head Hands
description: With this power you can turn your hands into snake heads. Your snake heads have sharp teeth and a venomous bite. The snake heads are also invincible so you can use them as shields. You can turn your snake heads back into normal hands when you're done.
summary: The ability to turn your hands into snake heads
strengths: You can turn your hands into snake heads
The snakes are invincible
They have a poisonous bite
weaknesses: If you keep your hands as snake heads for long periods of time you'll have to feed the snakes

name: Tickle Immunity
description: With this power, you are completely unticklish. This power is active all the time, so your friends and family can't get a good laugh out of you no matter how hard they try. In fact, as a safety feature, you don't laugh at all when someone is tickling you, even if you hear a funny joke or something. This power also works when machines are tickling you. You can only turn this power off by wearing a wool sweater.
summary: The ability to not be ticklish.
strengths: Never be ticklish.
Always win tickle fights.
Defeat dumb enemies who use tickling as their ultimate weapon.
weaknesses: Never get a good laugh while being tickled.
People may make fun of you by tickling you and cracking jokes at the same time.
On chilly nights, have to choose between a cozy wool sweater, and your tickle immunity.

name: Soylentgreeniztion
description: You get a human-sized pile of tasteless but nutritious green wafers. You start with this power requiring touch to turn a dead human into wafers. With practice you can turn dead animals or zombies in wafers. You can use the power at range. You can affect up 10 dead bodies at once. Zombie wafers have less nutritional value but are free of any zombie causing diseases. Dead animals will only give a animal-sized pile of wafers. You can make soylent green chips,pretzels,etc instead of wafers.
summary: The ability to turn a dead body into tasteless but nutritious green wafers.
strengths: Stop a zombie horde and make somewhat nutritious food.
Depose of dead bodies or road kill... And make nutritious food.
weaknesses: Soylent green is people.
And worse... Soylent green is zombies.

name: Condition Change: Blood
description: This power allows the user to change the condition(s) of activation so that the power also requires the user to drink the blood of who they are affecting with the power. This power is also tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power also require drunk blood in order to activate the power
strengths: Now your opponent has to drink the blood of what they want to affect.
If what the person wants to affect has no blood.
weaknesses: Have to touch the target.

name: Rise Of The Two Headed Monster
description: With this power you turn into a seven foot tall black hairy monster with two heads in order to fight crime
summary: The ability to turn into a monster with two heads
strengths: Two heads are better than one
